scripts.text:
[Investment Cat Helper]
You have a heavy load. Maybe you're a peddler? No peddlers in this area.
scripts.translation:
[投资猫助手]
您背了这么多东西，是来摆摊的吗？这一带可不许摆摊哦。

scripts.text:
[Investment Cat Helper]
Ohh!
You've come here to ask about investing?
You've come to the right place.
scripts.translation:
[投资猫助手]
哦！
您是来打听投资的吧？
找我就对了。

scripts.text:
[Investment Cat Helper]
I am here to invest in the Cat Paw Merchant Association.
Err-- I mean I'm here to help honest people like you.
Hehehe~
scripts.translation:
[投资猫助手]
我是来投资猫爪商会的。
呃——我是说，我是来帮助像您这样的正经人的。
嘿嘿~

scripts.text:
[Investment Cat Helper]
I can't remember everything because I've been here talking to you humans.
But I want to know first... Hold on.
scripts.translation:
[投资猫助手]
和这么多人类聊天，我都快记不清事情了。
不过我想先确认一下...请稍等。

scripts.text: smell... smell...
scripts.translation: 闻闻...闻闻...

scripts.text:
[Investment Cat Helper]
Ah?!
You don't know much about the Cat Paw Merchant Association, do you?
Hmm, you do not really smell like a cat.
scripts.translation:
[投资猫助手]
啊？！
看来您不太了解猫爪商会嘛。
嗯，您身上也没什么猫味。

scripts.text:
[Investment Cat Helper]
Good!!
You made the right decision to be here to invest in the Cat Paw Merchant Association~
scripts.translation:
[投资猫助手]
太好了！！
来投资猫爪商会，您可做了个明智的决定~

scripts.text:
[Investment Cat Helper]
First, you need to have ten pieces of Malangdo cans if you want to open an account.
scripts.translation:
[投资猫助手]
想开户的话，先准备10个绵绵岛罐头。

scripts.text: Open an account
scripts.translation: 开设账户

scripts.text: Ask about benefits
scripts.translation: 了解投资福利

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Investment Cat Helper]
Hmm!
I'd love to give you account for
free but as you know, this is for
advertising investers of the trader group, sorry.
scripts.translation:
[投资猫助手]
嗯！
我也想免费帮您开户，
可是这是为了宣传商人团体、吸引投资者...真抱歉。

scripts.text:
[Investment Cat Helper]
Good!
Write down here~ and
print your palm there,
ah!~ what's your name?
scripts.translation:
[投资猫助手]
好！
请在这里签名~
再在那里按个手印。
啊！~您叫什么名字？

scripts.text:
[Investment Cat Helper]
{0} you are~
scripts.translation:
[投资猫助手]
原来您叫{0}呀~

scripts.text:
[Investment Cat Helper]
Name: {0}
Number of accounts: 10
OK! Registered!
scripts.translation:
[投资猫助手]
姓名：{0}
账户数：10
好了，登记完成！

scripts.text:
[Investment Cat Helper]
You have an account now.
Will get an investment of a certain nunber of cans next time.
scripts.translation:
[投资猫助手]
您已经有账户了。
下次来时就能收到一定数量的罐头投资。

scripts.text:
[Investment Cat Helper]
I wish to get lots of investments
so you can have many services as well.
And, I also hope that we, the Cat Paw Merchant Association, will make much money.
scripts.translation:
[投资猫助手]
希望能有更多人投资，这样我们就能提供更多服务。
也希望猫爪商会能赚大钱。

scripts.text:
[Investment Cat Helper]
See you next investment~
scripts.translation:
[投资猫助手]
下次投资时再见~

scripts.text:
[Investment Cat Helper]
You want to know the benefits of investing?
Actually, we are a small group of cats and we don't think like humans.
scripts.translation:
[投资猫助手]
想知道投资能带来哪些好处吗？
其实我们只是一群小猫，想法和人类不太一样。

scripts.text:
[Investment Cat Helper]
There are lots of benefits based on how much you've invested in our services.
These include more warps, extra storage locations and price reductions of goods and services.
scripts.translation:
[投资猫助手]
根据您的投资金额，我们会提供不同福利，
例如更多传送服务、更多仓库空间，以及商品和服务折扣。

scripts.text:
[Investment Cat Helper]
I promise that if our trade is growing you will benefit from it as well.
scripts.translation:
[投资猫助手]
我保证，随着商会的贸易不断发展，您也会从中受益。

scripts.text:
[Investment Cat Helper]
Ahh~ You're just going to leave?
T_T~ Please open an account.
scripts.translation:
[投资猫助手]
啊~您这就要走了吗？
T_T~请开个账户嘛。

scripts.text:
[Investment Cat Helper]
I can't remember everyone since I meet so many people...
But I want to check first... Hold on.
Excuse me!
scripts.translation:
[投资猫助手]
来找我的人太多，我记不住每个人...
不过我想先确认一下...请稍等。
打扰了！

scripts.text: smell... smell...
scripts.translation: 闻闻...闻闻...

scripts.text:
[Investment Cat Helper]
This is a familiar smell!!
If it's so...!!
scripts.translation:
[投资猫助手]
这股气味好熟悉！！
如果真是那样...！！

scripts.text:
[Investment Cat Helper]
You are here to invest!!
Good!~~ Good to see you~
scripts.translation:
[投资猫助手]
您是来投资的！！
太好了~~欢迎欢迎~

scripts.text:
[Investment Cat Helper]
From your smell~ you are below 10,000 accounts.
Until then, you can get an account by investing ten cans.
scripts.translation:
[投资猫助手]
从您的气味来看，您还不到10,000个账户。
在达到这个数量前，投资10个罐头就能再开一个账户。

scripts.text:
[Investment Cat Helper]
Such a stong smell!!
Then it must be!!
scripts.translation:
[投资猫助手]
好浓的气味！！
那一定是...！！

scripts.text:
[Investment Cat Helper]
A VIP invester!!!!!!
You're here to invest? Welcome!
scripts.translation:
[投资猫助手]
VIP投资者！！！！
您是来投资的吧？欢迎！

scripts.text:
[Investment Cat Helper]
A VIP invester with over 10,000 accounts
can get another account with 20 cans.
A good investment!
scripts.translation:
[投资猫助手]
拥有超过10,000个账户的VIP投资者，
只需20个罐头就能再开一个账户。
这投资真划算！

scripts.text:
[Investment Cat Helper]
What will you do?
scripts.translation:
[投资猫助手]
您想怎么做？

scripts.text: Invest
scripts.translation: 投资

scripts.text: Check the number of accounts
scripts.translation: 查看账户数量

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Investment Cat Helper]
Ohh~ thank you for investing~
You can get a maximum of 10 accounts at one time.
Isn't it lovely?
How many will you invest in? Enter 0 to cancel.
scripts.translation:
[投资猫助手]
哦~感谢您的投资~
每次最多可购买10个账户。
是不是很棒？
您要买几个？输入0即可取消。

scripts.text:
[Investment Cat Helper]
Please invest next time~
scripts.translation:
[投资猫助手]
下次再来投资哦~

scripts.text:
[Investment Cat Helper]
You can get a maximum of 10 accounts~
scripts.translation:
[投资猫助手]
最多可以开设10个账户~

scripts.text:
[Investment Cat Helper]
Total {0} accounts, right?
The number of cans you need is {1} pieces.
Do you want to go through with this?
scripts.translation:
[投资猫助手]
您想开设{0}个账户，对吗？
需要{1}个罐头。
确定要继续吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Investment Cat Helper]
Oh? Is that wrong? Weird.
Please check again~
scripts.translation:
[投资猫助手]
咦？不对吗？真奇怪。
请再确认一下~

scripts.text:
[Investment Cat Helper]
Ahhh!
You don't have enough cans.
I'm a busy cat, you know.
scripts.translation:
[投资猫助手]
啊！
您的罐头不够。
你知道的，我可是很忙的猫。

scripts.text:
[Investment Cat Helper]
{0} accounts were invested in.
Thank you for your help~
scripts.translation:
[投资猫助手]
已为您投资{0}个账户。
感谢您的支持~

scripts.text:
[Investment Cat Helper]
Once we get more investments of cans,
our trader group will grow even more.
And you can get services as well~
A win-win strategy?
scripts.translation:
[投资猫助手]
投入的罐头越多，我们商会就能发展得越好。
您也能享受到更多服务~
这不是双赢吗？

scripts.text:
[Investment Cat Helper]
You can have 20,000 accounts max
according to the trader policy...
{0}'s accounts increase to 20,000.
Thank you so much for your investment~
scripts.translation:
[投资猫助手]
根据商会政策，账户最多可开到20,000个...
{0}的账户数已增加到20,000个。
非常感谢您的投资~

scripts.text:
[Investment Cat Helper]
Now, {0}, you can't invest further
but you can still donate some of your cans to the trader group.
Thank you so much~
scripts.translation:
[投资猫助手]
{0}，您现在不能继续投资了，
不过还是可以把罐头捐给商会。
非常感谢~

scripts.text:
[Investment Cat Helper]
{0} accounts have been invested in.
Thank you for your help~
scripts.translation:
[投资猫助手]
已为您投资{0}个账户。
感谢您的支持~

scripts.text:
[Investment Cat Helper]
With your big investment in cans,
this will help us meet our goals earlier.
Thank you again.
scripts.translation:
[投资猫助手]
您投入了这么多罐头，
我们能更早达成目标了。
再次感谢您。

scripts.text:
[Investment Cat Helper]
You want to check the number of accounts? Hmm, let's see~
scripts.translation:
[投资猫助手]
想查看账户数量吗？嗯，让我看看~

scripts.text:
[Investment Cat Helper]
Got it?
scripts.translation:
[投资猫助手]
明白了吗？

scripts.text:
[Investment Cat Helper]
You've made many investments. Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[投资猫助手]
您投了不少呢，谢谢您。

scripts.text:
[Investment Cat Helper]
Please invest next time~
scripts.translation:
[投资猫助手]
下次再来投资哦~

scripts.text:
[Investment Cat Helper]
{0}, welcome~
{1}~ I felt something upon your arrival.
scripts.translation:
[投资猫助手]
{0}，欢迎~
{1}~您一来，我就感觉到了。

scripts.text:
[Investment Cat Helper]
Want to donate?
scripts.translation:
[投资猫助手]
想捐点罐头吗？

scripts.text: Donate
scripts.translation: 捐赠

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 不

scripts.text:
[Investment Cat Helper]
Hehe~ then have fun in here~
scripts.translation:
[投资猫助手]
嘿嘿~那就在这里好好玩吧~

scripts.text:
[Investment Cat Helper]
Wow, thank you, {0}~!
scripts.translation:
[投资猫助手]
哇，谢谢你，{0}~！

scripts.text:
[Investment Cat Helper]
{0}~ with your help
the cans will be distributed to cats
in the Midgard area with honor~
scripts.translation:
[投资猫助手]
{0}~多亏了你，
这些罐头就能光荣地分发给
米德加尔特地区的猫咪们了~

scripts.text:
[Investment Cat Helper]
The can donation can range from a minimum of 20 to a maximum of 10,000.
scripts.translation:
[投资猫助手]
罐头捐赠数量至少为20个，最多为10,000个。

scripts.text:
[Investment Cat Helper]
The can donation can range from a minimum of 20 to a maximum of 10,000.
scripts.translation:
[投资猫助手]
罐头捐赠数量至少为20个，最多为10,000个。

scripts.text:
[Investment Cat Helper]
Hmm? You don't have enough cans.
scripts.translation:
[投资猫助手]
嗯？您的罐头不够。

scripts.text:
[Investment Cat Helper]
Ohh! Thank you~
scripts.translation:
[投资猫助手]
哦！谢谢~

scripts.text:
[Investment Cat Helper]
Dear {0} ~
I have only Increase AGI
and Blessing to give you.
Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[投资猫助手]
亲爱的{0}~
我只能给您敏捷提升和天使之赐福。
谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Storekeeper]
Hey, looks like you might be looking to unload some of your stuff from your pack.
Want to open storage? For free?
scripts.translation:
[店主]
嘿，看起来您想清理一下背包里的东西。
要免费打开仓库吗？

scripts.text:
[Storekeeper]
Hahaha~ Just kidding, of course it isn't free.
What do you take me for?
scripts.translation:
[店主]
哈哈哈~当然是开玩笑的，怎么可能免费。
您把我当什么了？

scripts.text: Pay with Can ----- 1 unit
scripts.translation: 用罐头支付 ----- 1个

scripts.text: Pay with Zeny ------- 1,500z
scripts.translation: 用Zeny支付 ------- 1,500 Zeny

scripts.text: Pay with Can ----- 2units
scripts.translation: 用罐头支付 ----- 2个

scripts.text: Pay with Zeny ------- 3,000z
scripts.translation: 用Zeny支付 ------- 3,000 Zeny

scripts.text:
[Storekeeper]
Ah, hold on!!
You need to have ^FF0000Basic Skill level 6^000000 to use the storage service!!
scripts.translation:
[店主]
啊，等等！！
要使用仓库服务，^FF0000基本技能必须达到6级^000000！！

scripts.text:
[Storekeeper]
You don't have enough cans...
scripts.translation:
[店主]
您的罐头不够...

scripts.text:
[Storekeeper]
You don't have enough zeny...
scripts.translation:
[店主]
您的Zeny不够...

scripts.text:
[Storekeeper]
Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[店主]
谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Samuel]
Ah, you mean the ad... well, you mean our village chief?
You'd better not bother him, since he's always busy.
scripts.translation:
[塞缪尔]
啊，你是说那个广告...我是说，您是来找我们村长的吧？
最好别去打扰他，他一直忙得很。

scripts.text:
[Samuel]
^0000FFBut it'd be impossible to talk without bothering him anyway......^000000
He is simply always busy.
scripts.translation:
[塞缪尔]
^0000FF不过，不去打扰他的话，恐怕根本没法跟他说上话...^000000
他总是忙个不停。

scripts.text: Village chief?
scripts.translation: 村长？

scripts.text:
[Samuel]
Ah, there was an admiral of this ship before settling in here~
Shining golden eyes like the sun!!!
Silvery beard fluttering with a rough sea breeze!!!
scripts.translation:
[塞缪尔]
啊，在定居到这里之前，这艘船上有位海军上将~
他的眼睛像太阳一样闪耀，金光熠熠！！！
银白色的胡须在狂乱的海风中飘扬！！！

scripts.text:
[Samuel]
Kha~ It was nice!!!!
I was fascinated by that attraction and took the ship, Navi!
This thing is called the romance of a guy. Hoo hoo~
scripts.translation:
[塞缪尔]
哈~那可真是太棒了！！！！
我被他的魅力迷住，就接手了这艘名叫“纳维”的船！
这就叫男人的浪漫。呼呼~

scripts.text:
[Samuel]
Well... His cuticle seems to have gone bad a bit with his village chief duty, since he settled in Malangdo. But his eyes are still the same.
scripts.translation:
[塞缪尔]
嗯...自从他在绵绵岛定居、当上村长后，看起来是有些憔悴了。不过那双眼睛还是老样子。

scripts.text:
[Samuel]
Umm, since it is Malangdo, will it be the Malangdo chief...?!
No, though it will be funny...
Malangdo village... umm... this... this is also not......
Well, this stuff is not that important.
scripts.translation:
[塞缪尔]
既然这里叫绵绵岛，那他该叫绵绵岛村长...？！
不，听着倒是挺有趣的...
绵绵岛村...嗯...这个也不对...
算了，这些都不重要。

scripts.text:
[Samuel]
Although there are many differences between admiral and village chief for sure, it feels like it won't be without Admiral Tomas anyhow.
scripts.translation:
[塞缪尔]
海军上将和村长终究不一样，但无论如何，少了托马斯上将总觉得不对劲。

scripts.text:
[Samuel]
All would think the same, not just me.
He's having a hard time thanks to this.
scripts.translation:
[塞缪尔]
不只是我，大家肯定都这么想。
也正因为如此，他才这么辛苦。

scripts.text:
[Tomas, Village Chief]
Ummm... Who are you?
Don't you think it's too early to come here?
scripts.translation:
[村长托马斯]
嗯...你是谁？
现在来这里，是不是太早了？

scripts.text:
[Tomas, Village Chief]
Samuel!
Are you coming to an end there?
scripts.translation:
[村长托马斯]
塞缪尔！
你那边快做完了吗？

scripts.text:
[Samuel]
Yes, Admiral!
Moved all 3 thousand boxes, including the one I just received, to the storage. The next boxes are expected to be delivered in 5 hours!
scripts.translation:
[塞缪尔]
是的，上将！
包括刚收到的那批在内，三千个箱子都已经搬进仓库了。下一批预计五小时后送到！

scripts.text:
[Tomas, Village Chief]
Samuel!
How many times should I tell you to call me Village Chief, not Admiral!
scripts.translation:
[村长托马斯]
塞缪尔！
我说过多少次了，要叫我村长，别叫上将！

scripts.text:
[Samuel]
Sorry! Village Chief!
I will correct myself!
scripts.translation:
[塞缪尔]
抱歉，村长！
我会改口的！

scripts.text:
[Tomas, Village Chief]
Hmm, hmm!
Get them sorted out and arrange them over there. Before the next boxes are here you must finish the work there!
scripts.translation:
[村长托马斯]
嗯，嗯！
把东西分类整理好，放到那边去。下一批箱子送到之前，必须把那边的工作做完！

scripts.text:
[Tomas, Village Chief]
Sea cucumbers, sea squirts, sea anemones to the right! Seaweed and kelp downstairs, and send anchovies and drums to the gathering place. Let the rest stack assortatively in the corner!
scripts.translation:
[村长托马斯]
海参、海鞘和海葵放右边！海藻和海带放楼下，鳀鱼和鼓鱼送到集合点。剩下的分类堆在角落！

scripts.text:
[Samuel]
Yes! Village Chief!
Seaweed, Sea cucumbers, sea squirts, sea anemones to the right! Seaweed and glasses downstairs! Send anchovies and drums to the gathering place! Let the rest stack assortatively in the corner!
scripts.translation:
[塞缪尔]
是！村长！
海藻、海参、海鞘和海葵放右边！海藻和眼镜放楼下！鳀鱼和鼓鱼送到集合点！剩下的分类堆在角落！

scripts.text:
[Tomas, Village Chief]
It it not.
Sea cucumbers, sea squirts, sea anemones to the right. Seaweed and kelp downstairs. Anchovies and drums to the gathering place. Let the rest stack assortatively in the corner.
scripts.translation:
[村长托马斯]
不是这样。
海参、海鞘和海葵放右边。海藻和海带放楼下。鳀鱼和鼓鱼送到集合点。剩下的分类堆在角落。

scripts.text:
[Samuel]
Yes!!
scripts.translation:
[塞缪尔]
是！！

scripts.text:
[Tomas, Village Chief]
Huuu...
It doesn't seem to end.
There are still piles of paperwork to do... I will be in trouble unless I finish them up before the next boxes arrive.
scripts.translation:
[村长托马斯]
呼...
好像永远也做不完。
还有一大堆文件要处理...要是下一批箱子送到前没做完，我可就惨了。

scripts.text:
[Tomas, Village Chief]
So, the amount of the next boxes is 1300....
And the next, the 700 boxes downstairs to load up the ship...
scripts.translation:
[村长托马斯]
所以，下一批有1,300个箱子...
楼下还有700个箱子要装上船...

scripts.text: Try to talk to him.
scripts.translation: 试着和他搭话

scripts.text: Stop since he seems busy.
scripts.translation: 看起来他很忙，还是先别打扰

scripts.text:
[Tomas, Village Chief]
Hmm, who are you?
You are not familiar. Sorry, but will you come again if it is not that urgent?
scripts.translation:
[村长托马斯]
嗯，你是谁？面生得很。抱歉，要是没有急事就请改天再来吧。

scripts.text: It's my first time to Malangdo.
scripts.translation: 我第一次来绵绵岛

scripts.text: Another cat told me to come over here.
scripts.translation: 另一只猫让我来找您

scripts.text: I will come around again later.
scripts.translation: 我过会儿再来

scripts.text:
[Tomas, Village Chief]
...So I told you your face was not familiar.
scripts.translation:
[村长托马斯]
...我就说你的脸看着眼生。

scripts.text:
[Tomas, Village Chief]
Hmm... Sorry, but as I told you before, would you talk to the other cats if it's not that urgent, since I have plenty of work left undone and no time to talk with you.
scripts.translation:
[村长托马斯]
嗯...抱歉，我之前说过了，手头还有一大堆工作没做完，没时间跟你聊。没急事的话，请去找其他猫谈谈吧。

scripts.text:
[Tomas, Village Chief]
...Anyway all are always good to leave me with the work.
Pitiless ones...
scripts.translation:
[村长托马斯]
...总之，大家总爱把工作都推给我。
真是无情...

scripts.text:
[Tomas, Village Chief]
Umm... Having said that, would you talk to the other cats if it's not that urgent, since I got plenty of work to do left undone and no time to talk with you?
scripts.translation:
[村长托马斯]
嗯...话虽如此，我手头还有一大堆工作，没时间跟你聊。不急的话，能去和其他猫谈谈吗？

scripts.text:
[Tomas, Village Chief]
Sorry for that.
Please come back to me again, though I don't know when I could be free.
scripts.translation:
[村长托马斯]
抱歉。
有空的话再来找我吧...虽然我也不知道什么时候能忙完。

scripts.text:
[Tomas, Village Chief]
These days I feel I'm pressed with work, although it's good to trust and rely on me as a village chief...
scripts.translation:
[村长托马斯]
大家信任我、依靠我这个村长，当然是好事...
可最近工作实在压得我喘不过气。

scripts.text:
[Tomas, Village Chief]
It is too much, since they send all visitors to me.
scripts.translation:
[村长托马斯]
访客全都被推到我这里来，实在忙不过来。

scripts.text:
[Tomas, Village Chief]
You're just in time. Go to the ^0000FFregular meeting^000000 being held now.
The meeting place is ^0000FFat the end of the corridor^000000.
scripts.translation:
[村长托马斯]
你来得正好。去参加正在举行的^0000FF例会^000000吧。
会议地点在^0000FF走廊尽头^000000。

scripts.text:
[Tomas, Village Chief]
Sorry for that.
Please come back to me again though I don't know when I could be free.
scripts.translation:
[村长托马斯]
抱歉。
有空的话再来找我吧...虽然我也不知道什么时候能忙完。

scripts.text:
[Tomas, Village Chief]
So, the next 1000 boxes to move to the upper side...
scripts.translation:
[村长托马斯]
接下来还有1,000个箱子要搬到上面...

scripts.text:
[Tomas, Village Chief]
400 boxes to give out as supplies....
And also...
scripts.translation:
[村长托马斯]
还有400个箱子要分发当物资...
另外...

scripts.text:
[Samuel]
Admiral!
Sea bass, sea jelly, sea sponge are well arranged on the right!
Seaweed and kiwi downstairs! Anchovies and cod to the gathering place! Let the rest stack assortatively in the corner?
scripts.translation:
[塞缪尔]
上将！
鲈鱼、海蜇和海绵都整齐地摆在右边了！
海藻和猕猴桃放楼下！鳀鱼和鳕鱼送到集合点！剩下的按种类堆在角落，可以吗？

scripts.text:
[Tomas, Village Chief]
....
scripts.translation:
[村长托马斯]
...

scripts.text:
[Tomas, Village Chief]
....
.....

[Tomas, Village Chief]
....
.....
......

[Tomas, Village Chief]
You!!
How many times did I tell you! Mew~
Huh?!
scripts.translation:
[村长托马斯]
你！！
我跟你说过多少次了！喵~
嗯？！

scripts.text:
[Tomas, Village Chief]
Sea cucumbers, sea squirts, sea anemones to the right. Seaweed and kelp downstairs. Anchovies and drums to the gathering place. Let the rest stack assortatively in the corner.
scripts.translation:
[村长托马斯]
海参、海鞘和海葵放右边。海藻和海带放楼下。鳀鱼和鼓鱼送到集合点。剩下的按种类堆在角落。

scripts.text:
[Tomas, Village Chief]
Huh?! If you really want to put Sea bass to the right that much, let yourself stand there all day long! Mew~
scripts.translation:
[村长托马斯]
什么？！你那么想把鲈鱼放右边的话，就自己站在那里一整天吧！喵~

scripts.text:
[Tomas, Village Chief]
I'm busy enough without you. You're getting on my nerves! Mew~
What about getting on the ship over there? Mew!
scripts.translation:
[村长托马斯]
没你我已经够忙了，你还来添乱！喵~
要不你去那边上船？喵！

scripts.text:
[Tomas, Village Chief]
Ooops!!!
!!!!!!
scripts.translation:
[村长托马斯]
哎呀！！！
！！！

scripts.text:
[Tomas, Village Chief]
Hmm, hmm...
Well... what are you still doing here?
Go to the regular meeting being held now at the end of the corridor.
Ahem....
scripts.translation:
[村长托马斯]
嗯，嗯...
你还待在这里做什么？
去走廊尽头参加正在举行的例会。
咳...

scripts.text:
[Tomas, Village Chief]
Hmm, hmm...
Well... what are you still doing here?
Go to the regular meeting being held now at the end of the corridor.
Ahem....
scripts.translation:
[村长托马斯]
嗯，嗯...
你还待在这里做什么？
去走廊尽头参加正在举行的例会。
咳...

scripts.text:
[Tomas, Village Chief]
How is the meeting going on?
It's been a long time since I visited, since I'm busy... Tsk...
scripts.translation:
[村长托马斯]
会议怎么样了？
我太忙，好久没去参加了...啧...

scripts.text:
[Tomas, Village Chief]
Hoh!
There have been such issues!
scripts.translation:
[村长托马斯]
哦！
原来发生了这么多事！

scripts.text:
[Tomas, Village Chief]
I felt uneasy since I couldn't take care of you, being so busy.
You already got used to Malangdo well enough by yourself.
scripts.translation:
[村长托马斯]
我一直忙着，没能照顾你，心里有些过意不去。
看来你已经很适应绵绵岛的生活了。

scripts.text:
[Tomas, Village Chief]
Then, as village chief and the admiral of the cat association, I'd like you to get along with me as well!
scripts.translation:
[村长托马斯]
那么，作为村长兼猫爪商会的上将，我也希望你能和我好好相处！

scripts.text:
[Tomas, Village Chief]
Ha ha ha!
How are you doing?
Come to me if anything difficult happens.
scripts.translation:
[村长托马斯]
哈哈哈！
最近怎么样？
遇到困难就来找我。

scripts.text:
[President of Meeting]
Please be silent, the regular meeting is getting started a moment later~
scripts.translation:
[会议主席]
请安静，例会马上就要开始了~

scripts.text:
[President of Meeting]
Wow~ wow~ Now we're having an incredible sale... well, no, but a meeting.
Please be silent.
scripts.translation:
[会议主席]
哇~哇~现在有超值大促销...不对，是要开会了。
请保持安静。

scripts.text:
[President of Meeting]
Today's main agenda is as always ^ff99ccStar Candy^000000.
Though I have traveled through numerous areas by now, it's my first time hearing ^0000FFsuch a difficult language to learn^000000.
scripts.translation:
[会议主席]
今天的主要议题还是^ff99cc星星糖^000000。
我走过许多地方，还是第一次听说^0000FF这么难学的语言^000000。

scripts.text:
[President of Meeting]
What she cannot communicate with at all is becoming a highly growing issue.
scripts.translation:
[会议主席]
她完全无法与人沟通，这已经成了日益严重的问题。

scripts.text:
[President of Meeting]
Please speak if there's any opinion on the next agenda.
scripts.translation:
[会议主席]
对下一项议程有意见的话，请发言。

scripts.text:
[President of Meeting]
Umm... Yes. Then, please say first, ^6666ccScottfold^000000.
scripts.translation:
[会议主席]
嗯...好。那么请^6666cc斯科特福德^000000先发言。

scripts.text:
[President of Meeting]
Umm... Yes. Please speak first, ^6666ccScottfold^000000.
scripts.translation:
[会议主席]
嗯...好。请^6666cc斯科特福德^000000先发言。

scripts.text:
[President of Meeting]
Please speak, Koon.... next.
scripts.translation:
[会议主席]
接下来请库恩...发言。

scripts.text:
[President of Meeting]
There will be a presentation by Dr. Devore on his study continuously.
scripts.translation:
[会议主席]
接下来由德沃博士继续介绍他的研究。

scripts.text:
[President of Meeting]
Please speak next, Dr. Mali.
scripts.translation:
[会议主席]
下面请马利博士发言。

scripts.text:
[President of Meeting]
Brie!! I understand the situation, but please be calm and tell us, since it is a meeting after all.
scripts.translation:
[会议主席]
布里！我知道你很激动，但这里毕竟是在开会，请冷静下来再说。

scripts.text:
[President of Meeting]
Well, let's have a break for a while now.
In time, Samuel brought Seaweed and tuna here.
scripts.translation:
[会议主席]
好了，我们先休息一会儿。
塞缪尔一会儿会把海藻和金枪鱼送来。

scripts.text:
[President of Meeting]
Huew... It gets you so tired to conduct a meeting.
I used to be called a tireless merchant who ranked 1st in sales...
scripts.translation:
[会议主席]
呼...主持会议真累人。
我以前可是销售冠军，还被称作精力永不枯竭的商人...

scripts.text:
[President of Meeting]
I feel really sick sometimes when the meeting is prolonged.
scripts.translation:
[会议主席]
会议有时拖得太久，我会觉得很不舒服。

scripts.text:
[Scottfold]
Attending the meeting is an important thing to do.
It is absolutely right that all responsible cats should attend.
scripts.translation:
[斯科特福德]
出席会议很重要。
所有负责任的猫都应该参加，这一点毋庸置疑。

scripts.text:
[Scottfold]
The meeting is starting soon.
So, shh~~
scripts.translation:
[斯科特福德]
会议马上就要开始了。
所以，嘘~~

scripts.text:
[Scottfold]
Yes, honorable president.
As for the communication with Star Candy, we have Biscuit, don't we?
scripts.translation:
[斯科特福德]
是的，尊敬的主席。
说到和星星糖沟通，我们不是有饼干吗？

scripts.text:
[President of Meeting]
Of course, though she is always with ^0000FFBiscuit, who speaks the official language a bit^000000, it seems to be difficult to have a conversation in depth.
scripts.translation:
[会议主席]
当然有，不过她总是和^0000FF只会说一点通用语的饼干^000000待在一起，似乎还是很难深入交流。

scripts.text:
[President of Meeting]
Besides, Star Candy is in a very important position that our Malangdo's existance depends upon. Many others think it's necessary to talk about our future direction directly.
scripts.translation:
[会议主席]
而且，星星糖的地位至关重要，绵绵岛的存续都与她息息相关。很多人认为，我们有必要直接和她谈谈未来的方向。

scripts.text:
[President of Meeting]
Then for the next... yes, Koon please speak now.
scripts.translation:
[会议主席]
那么下一位...好，库恩，请发言。

scripts.text:
[Scottfold]
Let's quietly listen to the other's presentation.
scripts.translation:
[斯科特福德]
我们还是安静听别人发言吧。

scripts.text:
[Scottfold]
...Though I say so, I also feel like saying something, somehow.
So, I always put my hand up first!
scripts.translation:
[斯科特福德]
...话虽这么说，我也总觉得自己有话想讲。
所以我每次都第一个举手！

scripts.text:
[Koon]
Though I'm busy, I always attend this meeting.
I'd like this to be held at times that don't disturb my work.
scripts.translation:
[库恩]
虽然工作很忙，我还是会来参加例会。
真希望能把会议安排在不影响工作的时间。

scripts.text:
[Koon]
I expect what comes up today.
scripts.translation:
[库恩]
我很期待今天会讨论什么。

scripts.text:
[Koon]
Scottfold is the one who participates enthusiastically.
They say that he'll be the next president of this meeting.
scripts.translation:
[库恩]
斯科特福德每次都积极参加。
听说他会成为下一任会议主席。

scripts.text:
[Koon]
Then, how's the study of Dr. Devore going?
scripts.translation:
[库恩]
那么，德沃尔博士的研究进展如何？

scripts.text:
[President of Meeting]
The language of Starfish is not undertandable even for the linguist, Dr. Devore...
scripts.translation:
[会议主席]
就连语言学家德沃尔博士也无法理解海星语...

scripts.text:
[Linguist Devore]
President! As for that matter, I'd like to speak for myself about the study.
scripts.translation:
[语言学家德沃尔]
主席！关于这件事，我想亲自汇报研究情况。

scripts.text:
[President of Meeting]
Yes. Carry on please.
scripts.translation:
[会议主席]
好，请说。

scripts.text:
[Koon]
I hope the study of Dr. Devore comes out soon.
I am very interested in the language as well!
scripts.translation:
[库恩]
希望德沃尔博士的研究能尽快有成果。
我也对这种语言很感兴趣！

scripts.text:
[Linguist Devore]
Most of our cats are especially talented in language.
This has a great effect on the prosperity of our merchants.
scripts.translation:
[语言学家德沃尔]
我们大多数猫都很有语言天赋。
这对商会的繁荣发展大有帮助。

scripts.text:
[Linguist Devore]
Because... it means you can do business in more areas if you know more foreign languages.
scripts.translation:
[语言学家德沃尔]
因为...懂得的外语越多，就越能到更多地方做生意。

scripts.text:
[Linguist Devore]
Hello everyone.
I am a linguist, Dr. Devore, in charge of the study on the Starfish language.
scripts.translation:
[语言学家德沃尔]
大家好。
我是语言学家德沃尔博士，负责研究海星语。

scripts.text:
[Linguist Devore]
Let me say the definite conclusion first. Since ^0000FFthe study on the Starfish language^000000 started from the time we settled in Malangdo, there's been no remarkable outcome yet.
scripts.translation:
[语言学家德沃尔]
我先说结论：我们定居绵绵岛后就开始研究^0000FF海星语^000000，至今还没有取得显著成果。

scripts.text:
[Linguist Devore]
Of course it is possible to talk with ^6666ccBiscuit^000000 somehow, but this is not close to the result we expected to solve the situation.
scripts.translation:
[语言学家德沃尔]
我们多少能和^6666cc饼干^000000交流，但这远远达不到解决当前问题的预期效果。

scripts.text:
[Koon]
Then, how's the study on the book we found last time?
scripts.translation:
[库恩]
那么，上次发现的那本书研究得怎么样了？

scripts.text:
[Linguist Devore]
This book we assumed to be written in the Starfish language. But when I asked Biscuit, it turns out that it's a textbook to learn the Starfish language...
scripts.translation:
[语言学家德沃尔]
我们原以为那本书是用海星语写的，问过饼干才知道...原来那是本海星语教材。

scripts.text:
[Koon]
Isn't it very helpful for studying the Starfish language, then?
scripts.translation:
[库恩]
那不正好能帮我们研究海星语吗？

scripts.text:
[Linguist Devore]
I surely thought that, but when I tried the conversation as it teaches, we ended up finding they couldn't understand it at all.
scripts.translation:
[语言学家德沃尔]
我起初也是这么想的。可照着书上教的内容试着交谈后，才发现他们根本听不懂。

scripts.text:
[Linguist Devore]
If you see the words on the first page of this book, there's a sentence seeming like short conversation.
scripts.translation:
[语言学家德沃尔]
这本书第一页上有一段文字，看起来像是简短的对话。

scripts.text:
[Linguist Devore]
It's like this, for the question, ���Ѭ� ���?, it says, ���� ���� �լ�Ҭ��, �ҬݬѬԬ�լѬ��. �� ���ڬ�?
scripts.translation:
[语言学家德沃尔]
比如，书上先提出一个问题：“...”，接着写道：“...”。

scripts.text:
[Linguist Devore]
Though I tried talking to Biscuit like this, there was no feedback.
scripts.translation:
[语言学家德沃尔]
之后我试着照书上的说法和饼干交谈，却没有得到任何回应。

scripts.text:
[Linguist Devore]
After that, as for this book, the existence of the book itself has been studied on the other side.
scripts.translation:
[语言学家德沃尔]
后来，我们还从其他方面研究了这本书本身的来历。

scripts.text:
[President of Meeting]
Ok, we listened well to what Dr. Devore said.
Then, let's wrap up the progress of the language study, and listen to Geologist, Dr. Mali.
scripts.translation:
[会议主席]
好，我们已经听取了德沃尔博士的报告。
接下来总结一下语言研究的进展，再请地质学家马利博士发言。

scripts.text:
[Linguist Devore]
Hoo...
The Starfish language is the hardest matter in my studying life.
scripts.translation:
[语言学家德沃尔]
唉...
海星语是我研究生涯中最棘手的难题。

scripts.text:
[Linguist Devore]
I should solve the puzzling Starfish language soon.
I'm ashamed to see you all like this as a result.
scripts.translation:
[语言学家德沃尔]
我应该早点解开海星语之谜的。
让大家看到这样的结果，我实在惭愧。

scripts.text:
[Linguist Devore]
Right...
This language world is so beautiful and mysterious.
scripts.translation:
[语言学家德沃尔]
是啊...
语言的世界真是既美丽又神秘。

scripts.text:
[Linguist Devore]
There are mysteries like why the same beings use totally different languages, or why very far kinds use similar languages.
scripts.translation:
[语言学家德沃尔]
为什么相同的生物会使用截然不同的语言？为什么相隔甚远的种族，语言却如此相似？其中有太多谜团了。

scripts.text:
[Linguist Devore]
I joined this group because I thought that traveling all around the world was much more helpful to study, not just reading a book at a desk.
scripts.translation:
[语言学家德沃尔]
我加入这个团队，是因为我觉得亲自走遍各地，比坐在书桌前读书更有助于研究。

scripts.text:
[Linguist Devore]
But this Starfish is just mysterious.
I cannot understand it at all.
I am rather doubtful to say it's actual 'language'.
scripts.translation:
[语言学家德沃尔]
可这只海星实在太神秘了。
我完全无法理解它。
甚至很难断定那真的是一种“语言”。

scripts.text:
[Linguist Devore]
I have no clue, though I study it in various ways.
Biscuit got used to our language, rather, and short talk is possible, but we cannot say it is conversation yet.
scripts.translation:
[语言学家德沃尔]
我试了各种方法，还是毫无头绪。
倒是饼干渐渐习惯了我们的语言，也能简单交谈，但还称不上真正的对话。

scripts.text:
[Linguist Devore]
I feel frustrated and more to study like this, but it should be solved to deal with the other matters.
scripts.translation:
[语言学家德沃尔]
这样下去，我既沮丧又想继续研究...可要处理其他问题，就必须先弄清楚这件事。

scripts.text:
[Linguist Devore]
I don't see what's wrong here!
Myself, who used to be called a master of language!
I've never expected to come across this untouchable stuff!
scripts.translation:
[语言学家德沃尔]
我实在想不出问题出在哪里！
我可是曾被称为语言大师的人啊！
没想到竟会碰上这种完全无法理解的东西！

scripts.text:
[Linguist Devore]
Wooaaa wooaaa ahhh!!!!
I don't see what's wrong here!
scripts.translation:
[语言学家德沃尔]
哇啊啊啊啊！！
我实在想不出问题出在哪里！

scripts.text:
[Linguist Devore]
Why are they here and what do they want!
I'd be good enough if I could just know it!
scripts.translation:
[语言学家德沃尔]
它们为什么会在这里？到底想做什么？
只要能弄清楚这些就够了！

scripts.text:
[Linguist Devore]
Wooaaa wooaaa ahhh!!!!
I don't see what's wrong here!
scripts.translation:
[语言学家德沃尔]
哇啊啊啊啊！！
我实在想不出问题出在哪里！

scripts.text:
[Linguist Devore]
Why are they here and what do they want!
I'd be good enough if I could just know it!
scripts.translation:
[语言学家德沃尔]
它们为什么会在这里？到底想做什么？
只要能弄清楚这些就够了！

scripts.text:
[Linguist Devore]
What?! What did you say?!
Fluently said!
How come!

- 用一只饱满的海鞘 -
- 填补裂缝。 -

scripts.text:
- Use a slithery sea cucumber -
- for the cracked gap.-
scripts.translation:
- 用一条滑溜溜的海参 -
- 填补裂缝。 -

scripts.text:
- Used the stapler for the crack -
- and fixed it well. -
scripts.translation:
- 用订书机固定裂缝， -
- 修补完成。 -

scripts.text:
- It seems the crack -
- is well filled. -
scripts.translation:
- 裂缝似乎 -
- 已经填好了。 -

scripts.text: - Let's get back to report this. -
scripts.translation: - 回去汇报吧。 -

scripts.text:
- Let's find -
- the other cracks. -
scripts.translation:
- 再去找找 -
- 其他裂缝。 -

scripts.text:
- I can see the crack. -
- It seems there's still -
- not enough supporters yet. -
scripts.translation:
- 找到裂缝了。 -
- 看来支撑力 -
- 还是不够。 -

scripts.text:
[Brie]
Sorry, but I don't feel like talking with you. Please leave me alone.
scripts.translation:
[布里]
抱歉，我现在不想和你说话。请让我一个人静一静。

scripts.text:
[Brie]
Sorry, President.
scripts.translation:
[布里]
抱歉，主席。

scripts.text:
[Brie]
Though Star Candy is supporting the ground of Malangdo,
we don't understand its purpose or reason at all.
Should we just expect not to find anything?
scripts.translation:
[布里]
星星糖一直支撑着绵绵岛的地面，可我们完全不知道原因，也不明白它为什么这么做。
难道只能坐等，什么也不查吗？

scripts.text:
[President of Meeting]
As Dr. Devore said, it's better to wait for the results, since he's still studying...
scripts.translation:
[会议主席]
正如德沃尔博士所说，他还在研究，我们最好先等等看...

scripts.text:
[Brie]
What would you do if Star Candy left, and you had only waited?
Malangdo may go under. I cannot just wait here like this.
scripts.translation:
[布里]
要是星星糖离开了，而我们只顾着等待，怎么办？
绵绵岛可能会沉下去，我不能就这么干等着。

scripts.text:
[President of Meeting]
But, Brie, we know there's nothing but waiting.
An enormous crack was made when Star Candy tried to make the support stand last time, as she seemed to be shocked and moved too much.
scripts.translation:
[会议主席]
可是，布里，我们现在只能等待。
上次星星糖试着立起支撑时，似乎受了很大冲击，岛上因此出现了一道巨大的裂缝。

scripts.text:
[Geologist Mali]
Besides, since ^0000FFStar Candy's location plays the role of pillar for this island, it seems the center would go down as you even set up pillars around her^000000, mew~
scripts.translation:
[地质学家玛丽]
而且，^0000FF星星糖所在的位置就像这座岛的支柱，即使在她周围立起支柱，岛屿中央似乎还是会下沉^000000，喵~

scripts.text:
[Geologist Mali]
Due to the nature of this large basement space, if the center were to collapse, we can't expect what comes next. Our researchers therefore think we should treat it as carefully as we can, mew~
scripts.translation:
[地质学家玛丽]
这里有大片地下空间，一旦中央塌陷，后果难以预料。
所以研究人员认为，处理时必须格外谨慎，喵~

scripts.text:
[Brie]
...

[President of Meeting]
We know that Rican's injury may affect the trade of Yggdrasil Berry, so don't worry too much.
scripts.translation:
[会议主席]
我们知道里坎受伤可能影响天地树果实的贸易，你不用太担心。

scripts.text:
[President of Meeting]
As for that matter, we're going to plan for it by discussing it with our chief, Tomas.
scripts.translation:
[会议主席]
这件事我们会和首领托马斯商量，想办法应对。

scripts.text:
[Brie]
Yes...

[President of Meeting]
Well, let's have a break for now.
In time, Samuel brought Seaweed and tuna here.
scripts.translation:
[会议主席]
好了，我们先休息一会儿。
塞缪尔很快就会把海藻和金枪鱼送来。

scripts.text:
[Brie]
What?!
I won't listen if you are nagging.
scripts.translation:
[布里]
什么？！
你要是又开始唠叨，我可不听。

scripts.text: About Rican.
scripts.translation: 关于里坎

scripts.text: I will stop.
scripts.translation: 我不问了

scripts.text:
[Brie]
As for my father?
He's the master of Yggdrasil Berry in this island.
scripts.translation:
[布里]
我父亲？
他是岛上最了解天地树果实的人。

scripts.text:
[Brie]
He can only do little things, like pushing the button of the dry machine, until his legs recover from the earthquake.
The amount of Yggdrasil Berry dramatically decreased.
scripts.translation:
[布里]
在双腿从地震中恢复之前，他只能做些简单的事，比如按烘干机的按钮。
天地树果实的产量因此大幅下降。

scripts.text:
[Brie]
I've been harvesting them instead of him, but...
scripts.translation:
[布里]
我一直代替他采收天地树果实，可是...

scripts.text:
[Brie]
Anyhow, I don't know very much about it, since I've just started this. If you want to ask about the Yggdrasil Berry, go to my house in the ^6666ccwest of Malangdo^000000.
scripts.translation:
[布里]
总之，我才刚接手这份工作，还不太了解。
想打听天地树果实的话，就去^6666cc绵绵岛西边^000000我家找我吧。

scripts.text:
[Brie]
My father will be staying there saying he's really bored today again...
scripts.translation:
[布里]
我父亲今天大概又会待在家里，嚷嚷着无聊...

scripts.text:
[Brie]
Hoo...

[Brie]
Anyhow, I don't know very much about it, since I've just started this. If you want to ask about the Yggdrasil Berry, go to my house in the ^6666ccwest of Malangdo^000000.
scripts.translation:
[布里]
总之，我才刚接手这份工作，还不太了解。
想打听天地树果实的话，就去^6666cc绵绵岛西边^000000我家找我吧。

scripts.text:
[Brie]
My father will be staying there saying he's really bored today again...
scripts.translation:
[布里]
我父亲今天大概又会待在家里，嚷嚷着无聊...

scripts.text:
[Brie]
Dr. Mali, please let me help to repair the cracks!
You called me more often long ago, but why do you say you can't give me the work now?
scripts.translation:
[布里]
玛丽博士，请让我帮忙修复裂缝！
以前你常叫我来帮忙，为什么现在却说不能把工作交给我？

scripts.text:
[Geologist Mali]
No, mew~
Brie, you have to help your father, mew~
scripts.translation:
[地质学家玛丽]
不行，喵~
布里，你得去帮你父亲，喵~

scripts.text:
[Brie]
But if this island goes down, all the fuss isn't useful at all!
scripts.translation:
[布里]
可要是岛沉了，做这些事也全都白费了！

scripts.text:
[Geologist Mali]
It's the same as the chicken and egg situation, mew~
If we have any problems selling Yggdrasil Berry, we cannot buy the tools to repair the cracks, mew~
scripts.translation:
[地质学家玛丽]
这就像先有鸡还是先有蛋的问题，喵~
要是天地树果实卖不出去，我们就没钱买修复裂缝的工具，喵~

scripts.text:
[Brie]
...

[Geologist Mali]
So, go back home and help your father, mew~
scripts.translation:
[地质学家玛丽]
所以，回家帮你父亲吧，喵~

scripts.text:
[Brie]
Ok, then I'll come back again if his legs have recovered.
scripts.translation:
[布里]
好吧，等他的腿恢复了，我再回来。

scripts.text:
[Geologist Mali]
Good.
I'll wait for you, mew~
scripts.translation:
[地质学家玛丽]
好。
我会等你，喵~

scripts.text:
[Geologist Mali]
Now as I get him back home, I'm going to find the participants, mew~
Cheers!
scripts.translation:
[地质学家玛丽]
我先送他回家，再去找其他人来帮忙，喵~
再见！

scripts.text:
[Brie]
Hew... I think I changed from being fussy, as I felt nervous.
Now I will think of only the harvest of fussy.
scripts.translation:
[布里]
呼...刚才太紧张了，说话都有点挑剔。
现在我只想好好收获天地树果实。

scripts.text:
[Rican]
Woo waa hoohoo...
Woowaa ahhh ahh ahh...
I'm impatient... to stay home like this!!
scripts.translation:
[里坎]
呜哇呼呼...
呜哇啊啊啊...
我真受不了...就这么一直待在家里！！

scripts.text:
[Rican]
When will my legs recover, when?!
They should be better soon, so that I can work like before...
But I can hardly move.
scripts.translation:
[里坎]
我的腿到底什么时候才能好啊？！
应该快恢复了吧？那样我就能像以前一样工作了...
可我现在几乎动不了。

scripts.text:
[Rican]
All I can do is press the button all day long~
This is not exciting at all~
I'm not willing to do anything more and more~ Doobie dooba~
scripts.translation:
[里坎]
我整天只能按按钮~
一点意思都没有~
越来越不想干活了~嘟比嘟吧~

scripts.text: Excuse me. Is this Rican's house?
scripts.translation: 打扰一下，请问这里是里坎的家吗？

scripts.text:
[Rican]
Huh?
Who are you!
I am Rican!
It's good to see you, since I'm so bored now...
Tell me what's happening right now! Now!
scripts.translation:
[里坎]
嗯？
你是谁！
我就是里坎！
正好我无聊得很，见到你真高兴...
快告诉我现在发生了什么！

scripts.text: Ask about Yggdrasil Berry.
scripts.translation: 打听天地树果实

scripts.text:
[Rican]
Yggdrasil Berry?
You... you know something!
Umm, hahaha!
Only a few cats know about Yggdrasil Berry!
scripts.translation:
[里坎]
天地树果实？
你...你知道些什么！
嗯，哈哈！
只有少数猫知道天地树果实！

scripts.text:
[Rican]
Well, before I traded them with human beings like you, Yggdrasil Berry was not thought to be a very remarkable fruit.
scripts.translation:
[里坎]
在人类开始向我们收购之前，天地树果实并不是什么特别的水果。

scripts.text:
[Rican]
It used to be spread out here and there in my old town. It doesn't have a good taste and causes indigestion, mew~
Cats need to eat fishes, naturally.
scripts.translation:
[里坎]
以前镇子附近到处都能找到。它味道不好，还会让猫消化不良，喵~
猫当然得吃鱼啊。

scripts.text:
[Rican]
But if human beings eat this, it gets you fully recharged.
scripts.translation:
[里坎]
不过人类吃了它，就能恢复全部体力。

scripts.text:
[Rican]
At first, I'd never thought it could be sold at all!
scripts.translation:
[里坎]
一开始，我根本没想过它能卖出去！

scripts.text:
[Rican]
Khhh~
It was just awesome at that time...
scripts.translation:
[里坎]
嘿嘿~
那时候可真是太棒了...

scripts.text:
[Rican]
Very long ago...
Our group left the town for a new course to trade.
scripts.translation:
[里坎]
很久以前...
我们一行人离开家乡，踏上新的贸易航线。

scripts.text:
[Rican]
Actually, we dominated the areas around our town, and it was like a challenge to find unexplored areas.
scripts.translation:
[里坎]
其实，我们已经把家乡附近都探索遍了，寻找未知之地成了新的挑战。

scripts.text:
[Rican]
But discovering the unknown is the romance of a man, isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[里坎]
不过，探索未知不就是男人的浪漫吗？

scripts.text:
[Rican]
Well, the beginning was quite nice, anyway.
After a month or two floating on the sea...
scripts.translation:
[里坎]
总之，一开始还挺顺利。
在海上漂了一两个月后...

scripts.text:
[Rican]
The sea has enough fishes in it, but it made me bored. I wanted to eat seasoning, like radish with chicken the most.
scripts.translation:
[里坎]
海里的鱼倒是不少，可我吃腻了。最想吃的是带调味料的菜，比如萝卜炖鸡。

scripts.text:
[Rican]
Though we drifted for a very long time, we couldn't land on any island. Rather, we met storms.
scripts.translation:
[里坎]
我们漂流了很久，却没能在任何岛屿靠岸，反而遇上了风暴。

scripts.text:
[Rican]
It was my first time seeing such a harsh tornado.
At that time I was out of my mind and thought I would die.
scripts.translation:
[里坎]
我从没见过那么猛烈的龙卷风。
当时我吓得魂飞魄散，以为自己死定了。

scripts.text:
[Rican]
I don't know the about the other ships, but this ship Navi luckily landed here in this island.
scripts.translation:
[里坎]
不知道其他船怎么样了，但纳维号很幸运地漂到了这座岛上。

scripts.text:
[Rican]
Khhh khhh!
Can you believe it?
^0000FFThat enormous ship just flied, vroom~~ like an airship and was dropped here in the middle of this island!^000000
scripts.translation:
[里坎]
呼哧呼哧！
你能相信吗？
^0000FF那艘大船竟然像飞空艇一样“轰”地飞上天，最后坠落在这座岛中央！^000000

scripts.text:
[Rican]
Anyhow, I survived, but most of the goods in the ship were swept and we were left with only Yggdrasil Berry.
scripts.translation:
[里坎]
总之我活了下来，但船上的大部分货物都被冲走了，只剩下天地树果实。

scripts.text:
[Rican]
Huh? Why did we load them, if we don't eat them?
It... it's the secret...
scripts.translation:
[里坎]
嗯？既然我们不吃，为什么还要装船？
这...这是秘密...

scripts.text:
[Rican]
Well, it's not important. As we sent reconnaissance groups there, we found out that there's a land where the other kind lives, not like us.
That was the land of you, human beings.
scripts.translation:
[里坎]
算了，这不重要。我们派侦察队出去后，发现了一片住着其他种族的土地。
那就是你们人类的家园。

scripts.text:
[Rican]
Regardless of the process, we found the new area to trade as we had first intended... we still have a small problem of not knowing how to get back to our howmetown yet...
scripts.translation:
[里坎]
不管过程如何，我们总算找到了最初想要开拓的新贸易区...只是还不知道怎么回家乡...

scripts.text:
[Rican]
We cats started selling with powerful viability.
But we had only Yggdrasil Berry, right?
We sold it with no high expectations, but could sell like hot cakes.
scripts.translation:
[里坎]
我们猫族开始大力推销天地树果实。
可我们手上只有这种果实，对吧？
本来没抱多大希望，没想到竟然卖得特别好。

scripts.text:
[Rican]
As rumors went, it was sold at very high prices among human beings and had a remarkable effect on them.
So we finally settled down to sell Yggdrasil Berry with growing profits.
scripts.translation:
[里坎]
后来传言渐渐传开，人类愿意花高价购买天地树果实，而且效果显著。
于是我们就在这里定居下来，靠卖天地树果实赚得越来越多。

scripts.text:
[Rican]
But we are selling the dried kind, which is ^0000FFa bit different from what human being originally know, and less effective, and hard to eat raw^000000.
scripts.translation:
[里坎]
不过，我们卖的是晒干的果实，和人类原先认识的那种^0000FF有些不同，效果也较弱，而且不适合直接生吃^000000。

scripts.text:
[Rican]
Since it disappears as we prepare, it's definitely the best for our group.
scripts.translation:
[里坎]
它在加工时会消失，所以对我们猫族来说，这种做法再合适不过了。

scripts.text:
[Rican]
By the way, as I got injured in this important season, it harms my credibility if I don't meet the deadline to deliver the amount ordered!
Trading is credibility!!!
scripts.translation:
[里坎]
对了，我偏偏在旺季受了伤。要是不能按时交货，信誉就毁了！
做生意，信誉最重要！！！

scripts.text:
[Rican]
For this reason, would you like to help me?
Though my son is helping me, the amount we can prepare is not enough.
scripts.translation:
[里坎]
所以，你愿意帮帮我吗？
虽然儿子在帮忙，但我们准备的货还是不够。

scripts.text: I'll help him.
scripts.translation: 我来帮他

scripts.text: I won't.
scripts.translation: 我不帮忙

scripts.text:
[Rican]
Khhh!
I had a good impression of you from the first time!
scripts.translation:
[里坎]
呼！
我第一次见你就觉得你不错！

scripts.text:
[Rican]
Harvesting Yggdrasil Berry is very easy.
You can get it when you just dig the ground, mew~
scripts.translation:
[里坎]
采天地树果实很简单。
在地上挖一挖就能找到，喵~

scripts.text:
[Rican]
Huh?
Doesn't it originally come from the ground?
scripts.translation:
[里坎]
嗯？
它不就是从地里长出来的吗？

scripts.text: Doesn't it grow on trees?
scripts.translation: 它不是长在树上的吗？

scripts.text:
[Rican]
Well, the Yggdrasil Berry in Midgard could do so.
But ^6666ccwe dig our Yggdrasil Berry here from the ground^000000.
scripts.translation:
[里坎]
米德加尔特的天地树果实确实是长在树上的。
但^6666cc我们绵绵岛的天地树果实是从地里挖出来的^000000。

scripts.text:
[Rican]
You can get it on Malangdo Island easily. Bring me about 30.
Ah! Keep the secret to my son for sure~
Then please^ff99cc!!!^000000 please^ff99cc!!!^000000 please~~~
scripts.translation:
[里坎]
绵绵岛上到处都能找到，帮我带30个来吧。
啊，千万别告诉我儿子哦~
拜托了^ff99cc！！！^000000拜托了^ff99cc！！！^000000拜托~~

scripts.text:
[Rican]
Oh? Then it's okay, if you can't help it.
My injured leg feels so bad... -groaning-
scripts.translation:
[里坎]
哦？那就算了，帮不了也没关系。
我的伤腿可难受了...（呻吟）

scripts.text:
[Rican]
You can get it on Malangdo Island easily. Bring me about 30.
Ah! Keep the secret to my son for sure~
Then please^ff99cc!!!^000000 please^ff99cc!!!^000000 please~~~
scripts.translation:
[里坎]
绵绵岛上到处都能找到，帮我带30个来吧。
啊，千万别告诉我儿子哦~
拜托了^ff99cc！！！^000000拜托了^ff99cc！！！^000000拜托~~

scripts.text:
[Rican]
Oh, oh!!
This fresh smell!!!
Haaa~ How fresh, good job!
You're good at harvesting Yggdrasil Berry?
scripts.translation:
[里坎]
哦，哦！！
这股新鲜的气味！！！
哈~真新鲜，干得好！
你很会采天地树果实嘛？

scripts.text:
[Rican]
Then would you put it in the machine in front of me?
scripts.translation:
[里坎]
那么，能把它们放进我面前的机器里吗？

scripts.text:
[Rican]
Oh, oh!!
This fresh smell!!!
Haaa~ How fresh, good job!
You're good at harvesting Yggdrasil Berry?
scripts.translation:
[里坎]
哦，哦！！
这股新鲜的气味！！！
哈~真新鲜，干得好！
你很会采天地树果实嘛？

scripts.text:
[Rican]
Then would you put it in the machine in front of me?
scripts.translation:
[里坎]
那么，能把它们放进我面前的机器里吗？

scripts.text:
- Notice !! -
 - Since you have too many items - 
 - you cannot get the item. - 
 - Let your body lighten - 
 - and try this again. -
scripts.translation:
- 注意！！ -
- 物品栏已满， -
- 无法领取物品。 -
- 请减轻负重， -
- 然后重试。 -

scripts.text:
- Notice !! -
 - Since your items are too heavy - 
 - you cannot get the item. - 
 - Let your body lighten - 
 - and try this again. -
scripts.translation:
- 注意！！ -
- 负重过高， -
- 无法领取物品。 -
- 请减轻负重， -
- 然后重试。 -

scripts.text:
[Rican]
Hoo hoo~ I feel at ease thanks to your help.
I had doubted if it was too much suddenly, but it turned out just right!
scripts.translation:
[里坎]
呼呼~多亏了你，我总算放心了。
本来还担心一下子要这么多会不会太过分，结果刚刚好！

scripts.text:
[Rican]
By the way, no news from my son yet, as he said he went to a meeting.
I hope he's not bothering Dr. Mali again...
scripts.translation:
[里坎]
对了，我儿子说去开会，到现在还没回来。
希望他没有又去打扰玛丽博士...

scripts.text:
[Rican]
He seems to have visited Dr. Mali more often since my legs got injured.
The study will get longer if he does so...
scripts.translation:
[里坎]
自从我腿受伤后，他好像更常去找玛丽博士了。
这样下去，研究进度也会被拖慢...

scripts.text:
[Rican]
If you see my son, please tell him to get back soon~
And this is for you to buy something delicious with, since you did hard work.
scripts.translation:
[里坎]
如果见到我儿子，告诉他快点回来吧~
你辛苦了，这些钱拿去买点好吃的。

scripts.text:
[Rican]
He seems to have visited Dr. Mali more often since my legs got injured.
The study will get longer if he does so...
If you see my son, please tell him to get back soon~
scripts.translation:
[里坎]
自从我腿受伤后，他好像更常去找玛丽博士了。
这样下去，研究进度也会被拖慢...
如果见到我儿子，告诉他快点回来吧~

scripts.text:
[Rican]
You need exactly 30 to get a set!
scripts.translation:
[里坎]
凑成一套正好需要30个！

scripts.text:
[Rican]
Very reliable!
Don't you want to do your business with Yggdrasil Berry?
scripts.translation:
[里坎]
真可靠！
你不想用天地树果实做点生意吗？

scripts.text:
[Rican]
Would you like to take a rest for a while?
It hasn't been a day yet since you last worked~
scripts.translation:
[里坎]
要不要先休息一阵子？
你上次来帮忙还不到一天呢~

scripts.text:
[Rican]
Hehe~
You came here to help me again?
You're so faithful!
scripts.translation:
[里坎]
嘿嘿~
你又来帮我啦？
真够忠心的！

scripts.text: I'll help.
scripts.translation: 我来帮忙

scripts.text: I won't.
scripts.translation: 我不帮

scripts.text:
[Rican]
It's the same task to do as before.
30 Yggdrasil Berry. You can easily find it in Malangdo!!
Ah! Keep the secret to my son for sure~
Then please^ff99cc!!!^000000 please^ff99cc!!!^000000 please~~~
scripts.translation:
[里坎]
和上次一样，帮我找30个天地树果实就行。在绵绵岛上很容易找到！！
啊，千万别告诉我儿子哦~
拜托了^ff99cc！！！^000000拜托了^ff99cc！！！^000000拜托~~

scripts.text:
[Rican]
Yeah? Then play around here, since you are visiting~
scripts.translation:
[里坎]
是吗？既然来都来了，就在这里玩会儿吧~

scripts.text:
[Rican]
Woo waa hoohoo...
Woowaa ahhh ahh ahh...
I'm impatient... to stay home like this!!
scripts.translation:
[里坎]
呜哇呼呼...
呜哇啊啊啊...
我受不了了...不想再一直待在家里！！

scripts.text:
[Rican]
All I can do is press the button all day long~
This is not exciting at all~
I'm not willing to do anything more and more~ Doobie dooba~
scripts.translation:
[里坎]
我整天只能按按钮~
一点意思也没有~
越来越不想干活了~嘟比嘟吧~

scripts.text:
[Rican]
You need exactly 30 to get a set!
scripts.translation:
[里坎]
凑成一套正好需要30个！

scripts.text: Put the fruits in.
scripts.translation: 把果实放进去

scripts.text: Don't.
scripts.translation: 不放

scripts.text:
[Rican]
I'll press the button by myself!!!
scripts.translation:
[里坎]
我自己来按按钮！！！

scripts.text:
- The machine starts operating -
- when he presses the button. -
scripts.translation:
- 他按下按钮后， -
- 机器开始运转。 -

scripts.text:
[Rican]
Ah... you won't put it in?
scripts.translation:
[里坎]
啊...你不打算放进去吗？

scripts.text: - Drrrk Drrrk -
scripts.translation: - 咔哒咔哒 -

scripts.text: Your inventory is too heavy to proceed. Come back after lightening your load.
scripts.translation: 负重过高，无法继续。减轻负重后再来。

scripts.text: Your inventory is too full to proceed. Come back after reducing your load.
scripts.translation: 背包已满，无法继续。整理背包后再来。

scripts.text:
- As I put my hand in the sand -
- a fresh smell comes out. -
scripts.translation:
- 我把手伸进沙堆时， -
- 一股新鲜的气味飘了出来。 -

scripts.text:
- As I put my hand in the sand -
- I feel like I'm touching -
- something bad. -
- Ah, ah! Feels bad... -
scripts.translation:
- 我把手伸进沙堆时， -
- 感觉摸到了 -
- 什么不好的东西。 -
- 啊，啊！好恶心... -

scripts.text:
- Seeems suspicious. -
- But it's just sand... -
scripts.translation:
- 看起来很可疑。 -
- 可这明明只是沙子... -

scripts.text:
- There's something strange. -
- It feels like somehow - 
- you shouldn't make eye contact. -
scripts.translation:
- 有些不对劲。 -
- 总觉得 -
- 不该和它对视。 -

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
Star Candy sacrifices herself like this, but those fellows are setting the pillars around her for themselves only.
Hewww!!!
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
星星糖就这样牺牲自己，那些家伙却只顾着在她周围给自己立支柱。
哼！！！

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
They talk to her, but ignore me when I talk to her.
I don't like them at all!!!
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
他们能和她说话，却不理我。
我讨厌他们！！！

scripts.text: - Unlike the words of Dr. Devore, Biscuit appears fluent in speaking. -
scripts.translation: - 看来饼干说话很流利，和德沃尔博士的说法不一样。 -

scripts.text: - I think it's better to let Dr. Devore know this soon. -
scripts.translation: - 我应该尽快把这件事告诉德沃尔博士。 -

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
Umm?
What's this?
Do you have anything to tell me?
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
嗯？
这是什么？
你有话要对我说吗？

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
Well, that fellow is often the one ignoring my words.
He wavers with words to say and makes me uncomfortable.
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
那个家伙总是无视我说的话。
他吞吞吐吐的样子让我很不舒服。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Did you hear? Dr. Devore?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你听到了吗，德沃尔博士？

scripts.text:
[Linguist Devore]
Ummm? What do you mean?
I cannot hear anything.
scripts.translation:
[语言学家德沃尔]
嗯？你在说什么？
我什么也没听见。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Huh? Biscuit said 'Well, that fellow is often the one ignoring my words. He wavers with words to say and makes me uncomfortable.'?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
咦？饼干说：“那个家伙总是无视我说的话。他吞吞吐吐的样子让我很不舒服。”？

scripts.text:
[Linguist Devore]
What? What are you taling about?
I cannot hear anything.
scripts.translation:
[语言学家德沃尔]
什么？你在说什么？
我什么也没听见。

scripts.text:
[Linguist Devore]
If... if that's the cause!
We may have totally misunderstood!
scripts.translation:
[语言学家德沃尔]
如...如果真是这个原因！
那我们之前可能全都误会了！

scripts.text:
[Linguist Devore]
Oh my, we couldn't have known, since we live here only with ourselves.
scripts.translation:
[语言学家德沃尔]
天哪，我们一直只和自己生活在一起，难怪会不知道。

scripts.text:
[Linguist Devore]
Each living thing has its own area for audibility and vocalization. But we and Biscuit were in slightly different areas!
scripts.translation:
[语言学家德沃尔]
每种生物都有各自的听觉和发声频率范围。可我们和饼干的频率略有不同！

scripts.text:
[Linguist Devore]
In such conditions, we cannot hear any language properly!
This was a matter of sound rather than language...
scripts.translation:
[语言学家德沃尔]
在这种情况下，我们根本听不懂彼此的语言！
问题出在声音，而不是语言...

scripts.text:
[Linguist Devore]
Hu~hu... Despite of many years of study, we couldn't discover this reason...
scripts.translation:
[语言学家德沃尔]
呼...研究了这么多年，我们竟然一直没发现原因...

scripts.text:
[Linguist Devore]
It's not the time to do this!
I should change the way of studying right now.
scripts.translation:
[语言学家德沃尔]
现在不是感慨的时候！
我得立刻改变研究方法。

scripts.text:
[Linguist Devore]
I'll get back to the meeting and report this.
Then please take care of the next things!
scripts.translation:
[语言学家德沃尔]
我要回会议上汇报这件事。
接下来的事就拜托你了！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Wait, Dr. Devore, what on earth is next...?
What should I do...?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
等等，德沃尔博士，接下来到底要做什么...？
我该怎么办...？

scripts.text:
[Linguist Devore]
Hahaha~ You are the kind who can have conversations with Biscuit. Please try to talk with him.
It'll be helpful for my study, no matter what you talk about with him.
scripts.translation:
[语言学家德沃尔]
哈哈~你能和饼干交谈，试着跟他聊聊吧。
不管聊什么，对我的研究都会有帮助。

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
Hey... Don't look down on me!
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
喂...别瞧不起我！

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
...What are you looking at...
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
...你在看什么...

scripts.text: Ask about Star Candy.
scripts.translation: 打听星星糖

scripts.text: Ask about Biscuit.
scripts.translation: 打听饼干

scripts.text: Ask about Malangdo.
scripts.translation: 打听绵绵岛

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
Star Candy?
Tsk tsk!
It's no go, the lowly fellows.
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
星星糖？
啧啧！
那些低等家伙可不行。

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
You shouldn've recognized the previous and mysterious feeling from Star Candy!
She's the one who's really gorgeous.
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
你应该早就察觉星星糖身上那股神秘的气息了！
她才是真正光彩照人的那位。

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
How gorgeous she is that... umm...
Just gorgeous.
She is so gorgeous... but I don't know how to explaing it...
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
她到底有多美呢...嗯...
就是美得不得了。
她真的很美...可我不知道该怎么形容...

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
Khummm...
That's why the kinds speaking with sound are irritating.
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
嗯...
所以我才讨厌那些靠声音交流的种族。

scripts.text: Speaking with sound?
scripts.translation: 用声音交流？

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
The kind who got highly evolved like us talk using our minds, not sound.
As you think in your mind, it goes to the others right away, something like this?
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
像我们这样高度进化的种族，是用心灵而不是声音交流的。
就像你在心里想着什么，对方立刻就能知道...差不多就是这种感觉。

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
In other places, it used to be called ultrasonic waves, or telepathy.
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
在其他地方，这种交流方式被称为超声波或心灵感应。

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
So we haven't needed any more explanation or flowery words...
Woo, it's bothering me so much!
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
所以我们不需要再解释那么多，也不用说那些华丽的辞藻...
哎，越说越烦！

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
Me?
I'm an assistant to Star Candy, a new star in the Starfish race with multi-faceted talents!
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
我？
我是星星糖的助手，也是海星族里多才多艺的新星！

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
Ah, ah...
When I was her assistant at first, I used to be called a genius, handsome assistant, and so on...
I felt like a shining road of light had come up to me...
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
啊，啊...
刚当上她的助手时，大家还叫我天才帅气助手什么的...
我觉得自己正走在闪闪发光的人生道路上...

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
But if the elderly see this, they'll dry me out in the sun...
It was a life like a flame... Sob sob sob sob
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
可要是被老一辈看到我现在这样，他们肯定会把我拿去晒干...
那段日子简直像火焰一样炽热...呜呜呜...

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
This island is where the gorgeous Star Candy can take a rest.
The surface is soft and with the high moisture inside, it's the best place for Starfishes.
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
这座岛是美丽的星星糖休息的地方。
地表柔软，内部湿度又高，是海星最理想的栖息地。

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
Now, those cats already occupied it as they wanted.
It's a problem because Star Candy is too kind...
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
现在那些猫随心所欲地占据了这里。
都怪星星糖太善良了...

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
Hey, you haven't gone back?
Get some jellies for Star Candy to eat if you have time.
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
喂，你还没回去吗？
有空的话，给星星糖弄些果冻来吃吧。

scripts.text: Okay.
scripts.translation: 好

scripts.text: Why me?
scripts.translation: 为什么是我？

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
You can get the jellies around here.
It's not that difficult, and you should come back before Star Candy's meal time!
About 30 jellies would be okay for a meal.
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
附近就能找到果冻，不难的。记得赶在星星糖用餐前回来！
一顿大概需要30个果冻。

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
Why you?
I'm busy enough to assist her and the cat fellows who can't hear my voice, that's why I should ask you.
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
为什么找你？
我忙着照顾她，还得应付那些听不见我说话的猫，只好拜托你了。

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
How rude...
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
真没礼貌...

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
You're not my subordinate, so I can't order you by force. But if Star Candy can't have her meal on time, you have to remember that this island will collapse completely.
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
你又不是我的部下，我不能强迫你。不过，要是星星糖没能按时吃饭，这座岛就会彻底崩塌，你可别忘了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
...It's not a request, but a threat...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
...这哪是请求，根本就是威胁...

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
It's not enough at all~
I need at least 30 Delicious Jelly.
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
完全不够~
我至少需要30个可口果冻。

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
You got them well.
There won't be any problem to prepare her meal.
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
你收集得不错。
准备她的饭菜应该没问题了。

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
Though the jelly looks strange, it tastes good...
Star Candy seems to like it a lot as well.
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
果冻看起来怪怪的，味道倒不错...
星星糖似乎也很喜欢。

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
Have your meal, Star Candy~
Uhhh, why don't you eat it?
You have no appetite?
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
星星糖，吃饭啦~
咦，你怎么不吃？
没胃口吗？

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
Hooo.. it's natural that you have no appetite...
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
唉...难怪你没胃口...

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
How come precious Star Candy supports the ground in the basement like this, and it's so dry, though it's in a subterranean cave of an island!
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
星星糖这么珍贵，怎么能让她在岛屿地下的洞穴里支撑地面？
而且这里还这么干燥！

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
Moreover, the slithery thing is bothering Star Candy.
You cannot avoid the stress.
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
还有，那个滑溜溜的海参一直在烦星星糖。
她怎么可能不觉得有压力呢。

scripts.text: Slithery thing?
scripts.translation: 滑溜溜的东西？

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
Hmm? What is such a thing like that.
The slithery thing.
With its ugly looks, it bothers Star Candy continuously.
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
嗯？你说那是什么？
就是那个滑溜溜的东西。
它长得很丑，还一直缠着星星糖。

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
It tries to come up to the island especially when it's storming like today. I hid here a while. Those cats came and made her bad like this.
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
尤其是像今天这样刮风下雨时，它总想爬上岛来。我刚才躲了一会儿，那些猫就来了，把星星糖弄成这样。

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
Thanks to Star Candy, her skin is...
......
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
多亏了星星糖，她的皮肤才...
...

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
Woooaaappp!
What's this!!!
Her skin is!!!!
She got an abscess on her skin that used to shine like a jewel!!!!
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
哇啊啊啊！
这是什么！！！
她的皮肤竟然！！！
原本像宝石般闪耀的皮肤上，竟然长了脓疮！！！

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
She got in trouble with her dried skin, since she's here!
For our Starfishes, the lack of water means horrible things that lead to death!
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
她待在这里，皮肤都干裂成这样了！
对海星来说，缺水非常可怕，甚至会要命！

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
Ah, ah! She's so kind that she sacrifices herself to save such things. Sob sob.
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
啊，啊！她太善良了，为了救这些家伙牺牲自己...呜呜。

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
Ah, ah...
I can't leave to take care of her, isn't there anybody to help~
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
啊，啊...
我不能离开她去找东西照料她...有没有人能帮帮忙啊~

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
Isn't there anybody to helpppppp~
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
有没有人能帮帮忙啊~

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
Hey, you there...
Even as I ask like this, will you just ignore me and stand there?
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
喂，那边那个...
我都开口求你了，你还打算无视我，杵在那里吗？

scripts.text: I'll help.
scripts.translation: 我来帮忙

scripts.text: It's unavoidable, so I'll help.
scripts.translation: 事已至此，我来帮忙

scripts.text: I'll admit this is my destiny, so I'll and help.
scripts.translation: 我认了，这就是我的命运，我来帮忙

scripts.text: I'll do anything I can for Star Candy.
scripts.translation: 我会尽力帮助星星糖

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
Good attitude!
Hoo hoo~
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
态度不错！
呼呼~

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
Then please find the brush to wash her and get a basket to move water here.
Maybe they're stacked in the storage.
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
那就找把刷子来给她清洁，再拿个篮子把水运过来。
这些东西可能堆在仓库里。

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
Oh!
You brought the tools successfully.
Now you can wash the dry skin in the counter-clockwise direction!
Right, then from her left leg...!
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
哦！工具都带来了。
现在可以逆时针擦洗她干裂的皮肤了！
对，先从她的左腿开始...！

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
Oh!
You brought the tools successfully.
Now you can fetch sea water from outside.
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
哦！工具都带来了。
现在可以去外面取海水了。

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
There's a spot I remember as first rate, in the east of Malangdo.
It's not right to wash her with the water collected in this cave!
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
我记得绵绵岛东边有个绝佳的取水地点。
不能用洞穴里积的水给她清洗！

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
Be careful not to spill the water, as it's heavy to carry.
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
水很重，搬的时候小心别洒出来。

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
Ummm... It will be hard if you don't have the proper tools...
Though it doesn't matter for someone small like me.
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
嗯...要是没有合适的工具，清理起来会很困难...
不过我个头小，倒没关系。

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
For such enormous skin as Star Candy's, it's full of barnacles, oysters, and mussels!!!
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
星星糖的皮肤那么大，上面竟然长满了藤壶、牡蛎和贻贝！！！

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
Oh!
You brought the tools successfully.
Now you can wash the dry skin in the counter-clockwise direction!
Right, then from her left leg...!
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
哦！工具都带来了。
现在可以逆时针擦洗她干裂的皮肤了！
对，先从她的左腿开始...！

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
Well done!
Now I see that her beautiful face has recovered.
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
干得漂亮！
她那张漂亮的脸总算恢复原样了。

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
The skin will go bad if you don't clean it every day.
There's a saying... cleansing your skin is much more important than using makeup.
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
皮肤不天天清洁就会变差。
俗话说...清洁皮肤比化妆更重要。

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
You did a good job.
You helped me even though I asked suddenly like this...
To be honest, I thought you'd just leave.
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
干得不错。
我这么突然地拜托你，你还是愿意帮忙...
说实话，我还以为你会直接走掉。

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
It's a kind of reward. Say my words to Dr. Dvor... or Devore, whatever the cat's name is.
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
这是给你的谢礼。帮我把话转告德沃尔博士...或者叫德沃，反正就是那只猫啦。

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
There's no need to wait until the study finishes. We can talk through you, and it's better to talk about the current situation...
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
不用等研究结束，我们可以通过你来交流。现在更该谈谈眼前的情况...

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
This is not for you... and all of you, either. It's rather for Star Candy to get rest as soon as possible, you know!
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
这不是为了你...也不是为了你们所有人。主要是想让星星糖尽快休息，知道吗！

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
I'll call you when I need you, so don't worry!
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
需要你的时候我会再叫你，放心吧！

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
It's the time for Star Candy to have a meal.
Get some jellies.
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
星星糖该吃饭了。
去弄些果冻来。

scripts.text: I'll help.
scripts.translation: 我来帮忙

scripts.text: I'll stop.
scripts.translation: 我不帮了

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
You can get the jellies around here.
It's not that difficult, and you should come back before Star Candy's meal time!
About 30 jellies would be ok for a meal.
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
附近就能找到果冻，不难的。记得赶在星星糖用餐前回来！
一顿大概需要30个果冻。

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
What, are you talking about you let our Star Candy feel hungry?!
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
什么？你是想让我们家星星糖饿肚子吗？！

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
Star Candy is really good.
She never loses her smile, even though it's so hard to stand...
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
星星糖真的很坚强。
明明这么难受，她却始终没有失去笑容...

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
Rude! How come you talk to precious Star Candy!
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
太没礼貌了！怎么能跟尊贵的星星糖说话！

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
You look different from the fellows that usually comes...
You also look strange, though.
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
你看起来和那些常来的人不一样...
不过，你也挺奇怪的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
?!
You can talk!

[Biscuit]
What?
You've never seen me talking?
What's the matter with you?
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
什么？
你以前没见过我说话吗？
你怎么回事？

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
Since I can talk with you, you seem better than those other foolish ones.
Though I learned to speak in their language, they don't understand.
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
既然你能跟我交谈，看来你比那些笨蛋强多了。
我明明学会了他们的语言，他们却听不懂。

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
Our precious Star Candy humbly supports them, and they treat her like this.
They don't know how to express thanks!
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
我们尊贵的星星糖一直默默支持着他们，他们却这样对她。
根本不知道感恩！

scripts.text: Support?
scripts.translation: 支持？

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
Anyway!
It's no use to treat them well.
They don't know how hard Star Candy is trying.
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
总之，对他们再好也没用。
他们根本不知道星星糖有多努力。

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
This island used to be hers, but for the short time while she avoided storms and got here, those cats were suddenly dropped on the island.
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
这座岛原本是她的。她为了躲避风暴来到这里，没想到那些猫也突然落到了岛上。

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
Since the ground here is so soft, Star Candy was stuck in between, and the situation is now like this.
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
这里的地面很软，星星糖被卡在中间，事情就变成现在这样了。

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
Actually, she can get out regardless of those bad things, but she supports the ground worrying that someone will get hurt.
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
其实她随时都能脱身，可她担心有人会受伤，所以一直撑着地面。

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
Ah, ah...
What a beatiful mind...
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
啊，啊...
多么美好的心灵...

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
Once she moved a bit when she felt uncomfortable, and saw them in panic. She hasn't moved at all since then. I'm worried if she's not well.
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
有一次她不舒服，稍微动了一下，结果看到大家都慌了。从那以后她就再也没动过，我真担心她的身体。

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
Star Candy sacrifices herself like this, but those fellows are setting the pillars around her for themselves only.
Hewww!!!
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
星星糖就这样牺牲自己，那些家伙却只顾着在她周围给自己立支柱。
哼！！！

scripts.text:
[Biscuit]
They talk to her, but ignore me when I talk to her.
I don't like them at all!!!
scripts.translation:
[饼干]
他们能和她说话，却不理我。
我讨厌他们！！！

scripts.text: - Unlike the words of Dr. Devore, Biscuit appears fluent in speaking. -
scripts.translation: - 看来饼干说话很流利，和德沃尔博士的说法不一样。 -

scripts.text: - I think it's better to let Dr. Devore know this soon. -
scripts.translation: - 我应该尽快把这件事告诉德沃尔博士。 -

scripts.text: An error has occurred.
scripts.translation: 发生了错误。

- to be so {0}. -

- 皮肤竟然这么{0}。 -

- 一把清洁刷 -
- 和一桶满满的水。 -

That tickles.
scripts.translation:

呼呼呼~
好痒哦。

scripts.text:
[Star Candy]
You're a really good human being.
scripts.translation:
[星星糖]
你真是个善良的人。

scripts.text:
[Star Candy]
Since I couldn't move, it was the most difficult thing to stand.
scripts.translation:
[星星糖]
我一直动不了，能坚持站着实在太不容易了。

scripts.text:
[Star Candy]
Ah~ Feels good~
I felt itchy for so long.
scripts.translation:
[星星糖]
啊~真舒服~
痒了好久，总算缓过来了。

scripts.text:
[Star Candy]
Thanks so much.
scripts.translation:
[星星糖]
太感谢你了。

scripts.text:
- All the water -
- sank into the ground. -
scripts.translation:
- 水全都 -
- 渗进地底了。 -

scripts.text:
[Portali]
I have no business for an immature fellow!
scripts.translation:
[波塔利]
我可没空理不成熟的家伙！

scripts.text:
[Portali]
Hmmm...
You smell like cats even though you're a human being...
scripts.translation:
[波塔利]
嗯...
明明是人类，身上却有股猫味...

scripts.text:
[Portali]
But... Would you like to go back to my hometown?
I'll let you go to the land of Midgard with the new skill I found!
It's not free. I'll need canned food!
scripts.translation:
[波塔利]
不过...你想回我的家乡吗？
我发现了一种新技能，可以送你去米德加尔特！
当然不是免费的，我要收罐头！

scripts.text: Go.
scripts.translation: 出发

scripts.text: Don't go.
scripts.translation: 不去

scripts.text: Prices?
scripts.translation: 怎么收费？

scripts.text:
[Portali]
Where are you going without canned food...?
scripts.translation:
[波塔利]
没带罐头还想去哪儿...？

scripts.text: Schwarzwald Republic
scripts.translation: 修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德共和国

scripts.text: Arunafeltz Kingdom
scripts.translation: 阿鲁纳菲兹王国

scripts.text: Prontera
scripts.translation: 普隆德拉

scripts.text: Morocc
scripts.translation: 梦罗克

scripts.text: Alberta
scripts.translation: 艾尔贝塔

scripts.text: Al De Baran
scripts.translation: 艾尔帕兰

scripts.text: Payon
scripts.translation: 斐扬

scripts.text: Geffen
scripts.translation: 吉芬

scripts.text: Einbroch
scripts.translation: 艾音布罗克

scripts.text: Lighthalzen
scripts.translation: 里希塔乐镇

scripts.text: Juno
scripts.translation: 朱诺

scripts.text: Hugel
scripts.translation: 毁葛

scripts.text: Rachel
scripts.translation: 拉赫

scripts.text: Veins
scripts.translation: 伯仁斯

scripts.text:
[Portali]
Okay...
scripts.translation:
[波塔利]
好吧...

scripts.text:
[Portali]
3 for Rune-Midgarts!
6 for Schwarzwald, 5 for Arunafeltz.
Schwarzwald is the nation of prohibited magic, and Arunafeltz seems to have a curse!
scripts.translation:
[波塔利]
去卢恩·米德加兹要3个罐头！
去修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德要6个，去阿鲁纳菲兹要5个。
修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德禁止使用魔法，阿鲁纳菲兹则好像被诅咒了！

scripts.text:
[Portali]
Where are you going without canned food...?
scripts.translation:
[波塔利]
没带罐头还想去哪儿...？

scripts.text:
[Portali]
Then to {0}~
scripts.translation:
[波塔利]
那就去{0}吧~

scripts.text: Your inventory is too heavy to proceed. Come back after lightening your load.
scripts.translation: 负重过高，无法继续。减轻负重后再来。

scripts.text: Your inventory is too full to proceed. Come back after reducing your load.
scripts.translation: 背包已满，无法继续。整理背包后再来。

scripts.text:
[Pipielle]
Wow, this is nice weather. Do you like this kind of weather, too? But I need to do my work now.
scripts.translation:
[皮皮埃尔]
哇，天气真好。你也喜欢这样的天气吗？不过我现在得去工作了。

scripts.text:
[Pipielle]
I would ask for your help, if you were a stronger advanturer...
scripts.translation:
[皮皮埃尔]
要是你是个更强的冒险者，我倒想请你帮忙...

scripts.text: ^770099This cat is working on something, but she asks for help above level 60.^000000
scripts.translation: ^770099这只猫正在研究某些东西，但她只想请60级以上的冒险者帮忙。^000000

scripts.text:
[Pipielle]
Would you come here and open your bag for me?
scripts.translation:
[皮皮埃尔]
能过来让我看看你的背包吗？

scripts.text:
[Pipielle]
There are many beautiful fish around here. So I feel my heart beating standing here.
scripts.translation:
[皮皮埃尔]
这附近有好多漂亮的鱼，站在这里真让人心潮澎湃。

scripts.text: I think my heart is beating faster...
scripts.translation: 我的心跳好像变快了...

scripts.text:
[Pipielle]
How come you only know about eating! My heart doesn't only beat for food.
scripts.translation:
[皮皮埃尔]
你怎么满脑子只有吃！我的心跳可不只是为了食物。

scripts.text:
[Pipielle]
I've studied at a human university before and I learned to speak there so don't treat me like some animal.
scripts.translation:
[皮皮埃尔]
我以前在人类的大学念过书，也是在那里学会说话的，别把我当成普通动物。

scripts.text:
[Pipielle]
I am a scholar of fish research.
It's important for cats to research fish.
scripts.translation:
[皮皮埃尔]
我是研究鱼类的学者。
对猫来说，研究鱼类很重要。

scripts.text: How's your research going?
scripts.translation: 你的研究进展如何？

scripts.text:
[Pipielle]
I was a good friend of admiral Thomas but our ship hasn't gone back to sea since we arrived here.
scripts.translation:
[皮皮埃尔]
我以前是托马斯上将的好朋友，可自从我们来到这里，船就再也没出过海。

scripts.text:
[Pipielle]
The shipmates seem to be pretty lonely.
scripts.translation:
[皮皮埃尔]
船员们似乎都很寂寞。

scripts.text:
[Pipielle]
A scholar from the university came here to research us and thought it was amazing to find a cat that speaks his language already.
So he's been helping me teach the others.
scripts.translation:
[皮皮埃尔]
有位大学学者来这里研究我们，发现竟然有只猫已经会说人类的语言，觉得很不可思议。
从那以后，他就一直帮我教其他猫说话。

scripts.text: Is that why I understand all the cats?
scripts.translation: 所以我才听得懂所有猫说话吗？

scripts.text:
[Pipielle]
Yes, exactly!
I was one of the few cats who could talk to humans before that scholar arrived.
scripts.translation:
[皮皮埃尔]
没错！
那位学者来之前，我就是少数能和人类交谈的猫之一。

scripts.text:
[Pipielle]
Anyways, now I'm collecting specimens to study the monsters here. I hope you can help me.
scripts.translation:
[皮皮埃尔]
总之，我现在正在收集这里的魔物标本做研究。希望你能帮忙。

scripts.text: How can I help you?
scripts.translation: 我能帮你做什么？

scripts.text: I have to decline.
scripts.translation: 我得拒绝

scripts.text:
[Pipielle]
Oh, okay. If you change your mind, please come again.
scripts.translation:
[皮皮埃尔]
哦，好吧。改变主意的话，欢迎再来找我。

scripts.text:
[Pipielle]
There is a monster called a Pouring who's eating all fish in the Octopus and Culvert dungeon.
scripts.translation:
[皮皮埃尔]
有种叫水滴波利的魔物，正在章鱼洞窟和下水道里把鱼吃光。

scripts.text:
[Pipielle]
It suddenly appeared during the winter, so could you collect the specimens of Unidentified Fish after getting rid of it?
scripts.translation:
[皮皮埃尔]
它是在冬天突然出现的。你能打倒它，再收集一些未鉴定鱼类标本吗？

scripts.text:
[Pipielle]
You can get Unidentified Fish from the Pouring monsters, so please collect 30 of them.
scripts.translation:
[皮皮埃尔]
打倒水滴波利就能得到未鉴定鱼类，请收集30份。

scripts.text:
[Pipielle]
Oh, thank you! I will take these specimens.
scripts.translation:
[皮皮埃尔]
哦，谢谢！这些标本我收下了。

scripts.text:
[Pipielle]
I want to give you something, but the last one is out of stock now so I will just write your name here.
scripts.translation:
[皮皮埃尔]
我本想送你点东西，可最后一份也已经送完了，只好先把你的名字记下来。

scripts.text:
[Pipielle]
I can give you good news even from a distance, but it's only possible if I am really lucky...
scripts.translation:
[皮皮埃尔]
就算隔得很远，我也可能给你带来好消息...不过得看我运气够不够好。

scripts.text:
[Pipielle]
I'm sorry, but please collect 30 Unidentified Fish specimens.
scripts.translation:
[皮皮埃尔]
抱歉，请收集30份未鉴定鱼类标本。

scripts.text:
[Pipielle]
Oh, you met admiral Tomas... how was it?
scripts.translation:
[皮皮埃尔]
哦，你见到托马斯上将了...觉得他怎么样？

scripts.text: He looks gentle
scripts.translation: 他看起来很温和

scripts.text: He looks terrible
scripts.translation: 他看起来很糟糕

scripts.text:
[Pipielle]
Hmm...
Frankly speaking, I was a real fan of Admiral Tomas. Can you take responsibility for your word?
scripts.translation:
[皮皮埃尔]
嗯...
老实说，我可是托马斯上将的忠实崇拜者。你说这话，敢负责吗？

scripts.text: Just kidding!
scripts.translation: 我开玩笑的！

scripts.text: Oh yes, he was really terrible!
scripts.translation: 没错，他真的很糟糕！

scripts.text:
[Pipielle]
Is he?
Okay, it really depends on personal taste...
scripts.translation:
[皮皮埃尔]
是吗？
好吧，看来这确实因人而异...

scripts.text:
[Pipielle]
Is he?

[Pipielle]

托马斯上将是带领我们航海来到这座岛的传奇人物。那是我一生中最幸福的时刻。

scripts.text:
[Pipielle]

[皮皮埃尔]
请多帮帮他。能信任的人不多...这是我个人的请求。

scripts.text:
[Pipielle]
And this is a small gift for looking after admiral Tomas.
^0000ffReceived 200 E Class Coins.^000000
scripts.translation:

这是送给你的谢礼，谢谢你照顾托马斯上将。
^0000ff获得200个E级代币。^000000

like usual.

[Gobonge]
There were lots of cans.
I thougt it was new due to different shape
but it was bad cans!
I ate too much and
got in bed right away
so I can't do anything...

And by the way, you have...
nice colthes.

[戈邦格]

[{0}]

just lay in bed forever.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
为了绵绵岛的和平，你就永远躺在床上吧。

scripts.text:
[Gobonge]
I will!
I will have your peace first once I get well!

[戈邦格]

等我好了，先让你尝尝“和平”的滋味！

把他们拉来帮忙，改善猫咪们的生活！

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

你怎么又来了！

scripts.text:

The enemy must be near the dock

[戈邦格]
好久没做那些不该做的坏事了，真没劲。

Was it from raccoon that made us pain in stomach?
Oh bad raccoon!

scripts.translation:

是浣熊害我们胃疼的吗？

scripts.text:
[Gobonge]
I need time to concentrate on my stomachache.
You can go now!
scripts.translation:
[戈邦格]
我得专心对付胃疼。
你先走吧！

scripts.text:
[Gobonge]

The Patrol Leader wants to go back to
bad world as soon as possible.

How about it?

scripts.text: It's troublsome, I quit.

scripts.text: Sure I will!

scripts.text:
[Gobonge]
Sorry, but you should go now

scripts.translation:

抱歉，你先走吧，

scripts.text:
[Gobonge]
Hmm, investigation is not enough.

I might be in pain of stomach

嗯，调查还不够。

scripts.text:

He appears to be listening intently.

坏罐头？

scripts.text:
[Awfully Suspious Dealer]
...

...

...

...
