...那家伙真是个混蛋！
而且，什么？船长室里又找到一块？！

scripts.text:
[Chef Nyas]
Thomas......
He has position that should take the lead to sailors, but he got a wrong?
Ududuk.
scripts.translation:
[厨师尼亚斯]
托马斯...
他身为水手的领袖，怎么会犯这种错？
真是的。

scripts.text:
[Chef Nyas]
This cat's ship biscuit was! Always thankful food to help our starvation during a long sailing!
No matter what taste, It always saves us at crossroads of life and death!
scripts.translation:
[厨师尼亚斯]
猫饼干可是...漫长航海中帮我们熬过饥饿的救命粮！
不管味道如何，每逢生死关头它总能救我们一命！

scripts.text:
[Chef Nyas]
Although the situation is not able to use fire for a month, two month even 1000 days!
This is blessed food to guarantee on open sea!
scripts.translation:
[厨师尼亚斯]
就算一个月、两个月，甚至一千天都无法生火，它也是我们在茫茫大海上赖以生存的食物！

scripts.text:
[Chef Nyas]
How many chef cats have difficult time to make a cat's ship biscuit!
The military discipline has been relaxed because we settled down on island! Already forget the dangerous situation?!
scripts.translation:
[厨师尼亚斯]
当年多少猫厨师为了制作猫饼干费尽心血！
定居岛上、食物充足以后，军纪就松懈了！难道大家已经忘了当年的险境？！

scripts.text:
Chef is outraged and very upset.
He mumbled and made a threatening sound with grind his teeth.
Come back later when he calms down.
scripts.translation:
厨师气得怒不可遏。
他低声嘟囔，咬牙切齿地发出威胁般的声音。
等他冷静下来再来吧。

scripts.text:
[Chef Nyas]
There you are? I made a bad break.
I made a big decision when you are out for me.
scripts.translation:
[厨师尼亚斯]
你来了？我刚才发了一通火。
趁你不在，我做了个重大决定。

scripts.text:
[Chef Nyas]
After settled down on Island, depraved mindset cause of plentiful foods.
Therefore, I'll change the menu that cat's ship biscuit is provided for one meal a day!.
scripts.translation:
[厨师尼亚斯]
定居岛上、食物充足以后，大家的心态都懈怠了。
所以我要改菜单，每天安排一顿猫饼干！

scripts.text:
[Chef Nyas]
That ingredient is needed to make cat's ship biscuit.
There is no wheat on this island, so I need to get your help.
scripts.translation:
[厨师尼亚斯]
做猫饼干需要这种食材。
岛上没有小麦，所以得请你帮忙找。

scripts.text:
[Chef Nyas]
Anything is possible to grind flour and knead dough.
Please bring that kind of ^4d4dff10 Grain^000000 and ^4d4dff 1 Plain Sauce^000000.
Replace salt with seawater..
scripts.translation:
[厨师尼亚斯]
只要能磨成粉、揉成面团，什么谷物都行。
请带来^4d4dff10份谷物^000000和^4d4dff1份普通酱汁^000000。
再用海水代替盐...

scripts.text:
[Chef Nyas]
Could we get them easily on land?
I'll get the rest what I need.
scripts.translation:
[厨师尼亚斯]
这些东西在陆地上很容易找到吗？
其余材料我会自己准备。

scripts.text:
[Chef Nyas]
I'll fix their taste that is crazy for canned food.
He approached like a calm sea that has horrible thunder storm
I'll give a pain like a god of sea's anger! Kmeow~~!!
scripts.translation:
[厨师尼亚斯]
我会把这些坏罐头里怪异的味道调回来。
那家伙就像暴风雨前平静的海面一样靠近...
我要让他尝尝海神之怒！喵呜~~！！

scripts.text:
A look of chef is quite serious.
Let me tell Cleanyang about the result first.
scripts.translation:
厨师神情严肃。
我还是先把结果告诉清洁羊吧。

scripts.text:
Chef is still trying to soothe his anger.
Maybe need more time.
scripts.translation:
厨师还在努力平息怒火。
看来得再等等。

scripts.text:
[Chef Nyas]
Finally here. Wow, this land is pretty different.
That is enough to process.
scripts.translation:
[厨师尼亚斯]
总算送来了。哇，这种食材真特别。
这些已经够用了。

scripts.text:
[Chef Nyas]
If you are ok, I want to get these food everyday.
If you don't mind, just come back tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[厨师尼亚斯]
如果你愿意，我想每天都要这些食材。
不介意的话，明天再来吧。

scripts.text:
[Chef Nyas]
That ingredient is needed to make cat's ship biscuit.
There is no wheat on this island, so I need to get your help.
scripts.translation:
[厨师尼亚斯]
做猫饼干需要这种食材。
岛上没有小麦，所以得请你帮忙找。

scripts.text:
[Chef Nyas]
Anything is possible to grind flour and knead dough.
Please bring that kind of ^4d4dff10 Grain^000000 and ^4d4dff 1 Plain Sauce^000000.
Replace salt with seawater...
scripts.translation:
[厨师尼亚斯]
只要能磨成粉、揉成面团，什么谷物都行。
请带来^4d4dff10份谷物^000000和^4d4dff1份普通酱汁^000000。
再用海水代替盐...

scripts.text:
[Chef Nyas]
There you are.
It's not mealtime... Why are you here?
scripts.translation:
[厨师尼亚斯]
你来了。
还没到用餐时间呢，来这里做什么？

scripts.text: What's today's work?
scripts.translation: 今天要做什么？

scripts.text: Food Delivery
scripts.translation: 配送食物

scripts.text: Just bored...
scripts.translation: 我只是闲得无聊...

scripts.text:
[Chef Nyas]
Now, cat's ship biscuit is being baked in this oven.
It's all for your delivery food.
scripts.translation:
[厨师尼亚斯]
猫饼干正在这个烤炉里烘烤。
这是给你配送的食物。

scripts.text:
[Chef Nyas]
Quiet wave with a little salty and savory smell.
The food of sea is coming to make sailor's heart flutter.
scripts.translation:
[厨师尼亚斯]
海风平静，空气中飘着微咸的香气。
这海上的食物，最能让水手心潮澎湃。

scripts.text:
[Chef Nyas]
I've got enough ingredients of cat's ship biscuit today.
Let me order next time.
scripts.translation:
[厨师尼亚斯]
今天做猫饼干的材料已经够了。
下次再来下单吧。

scripts.text:
[Chef Nyas]
Um? You are dull.
You already took my order list?
Just take care of them.
scripts.translation:
[厨师尼亚斯]
嗯？你反应真慢。
已经拿到我的订单清单了？那就照着准备吧。

scripts.text:
[Chef Nyas]
Here you are.
I need ingredients for cat's ship biscuit now. Fortunately, you are here at the right moment.
scripts.translation:
[厨师尼亚斯]
你来得正好。
我现在需要猫饼干的原料。

scripts.text:
[Chef Nyas]
Could you bring some ingrediednts for cat's ship biscuit from land?
If you say so, I have one more thing to request...
scripts.translation:
[厨师尼亚斯]
能从陆地上帮我带些猫饼干的原料来吗？
你要是答应，我还有一件事想拜托你...

scripts.text: I'm busy today.
scripts.translation: 我今天很忙

scripts.text: Sure, what are you need?
scripts.translation: 好啊，需要什么？

scripts.text:
[Chef Nyas]
That is sad news.
However, it's ok. Cat's ship biscuit is originally prepared food.
Anyway, today's biscuit wll be provided when the second moon is full.
scripts.translation:
[厨师尼亚斯]
真遗憾。
不过没关系，猫饼干本来就能提前做好。
今天的饼干会在第二次满月时发放。

scripts.text: So teeth grinder?
scripts.translation: 所以，是那种硬得能磨牙的饼干？

scripts.text: Worm castle...
scripts.translation: 虫子城堡...

scripts.text: Do not throw away?
scripts.translation: 不能扔掉？

scripts.text:
[Chef Nyas]
What do you want to hear from me?!
Kmeow!!
The hardness of cat's ship biscuit is like a noble endurance in the sea!
Do not ignore this!!
scripts.translation:
[厨师尼亚斯]
你到底想听什么？！
喵呜！！
猫饼干的坚硬，就像水手在海上必须具备的坚忍！
这可不能小看！！

scripts.text:
[Chef Nyas]
Only idiot who does not take care of preserving says like that.
Dry enough and seal it in cool dry place. Tut-tut.
scripts.translation:
[厨师尼亚斯]
只有不懂保存的傻瓜才会这么说。
把它彻底晾干，再密封放在阴凉干燥处。啧啧。

scripts.text:
[Chef Nyas]
Anyway Is that all about protein?
Why don't you eat at night if it's on your mind!
scripts.translation:
[厨师尼亚斯]
你就只关心蛋白质吗？
要是这么在意，晚餐时吃不就好了！

scripts.text:
[Chef Nyas]
Never throw food!
When you are hit by cat's ship biscuit, you will get bruise or bleeding but
It is not that reason!!!
Do not play with food!
scripts.translation:
[厨师尼亚斯]
绝不能浪费食物！
被猫饼干砸中，顶多淤青或流血，
但这可不是重点！！！
别拿食物开玩笑！

scripts.text:
[Chef Nyas]
The ingredients of cat's ship biscuit are 10 Grain and 1 Plain Sauce as usual.
And I'd like to study food of human, so bring one of them.
scripts.translation:
[厨师尼亚斯]
猫饼干的原料还是老样子：10份谷物和1份普通酱汁。
另外，我想研究人类的食物，带一道来给我看看。

scripts.text:
[Chef Nyas]
My curious food is...
^4d4dff {0} ^000000 .
Just one dish is enough, so please do it together.
scripts.translation:
[厨师尼亚斯]
我感兴趣的料理是...
^4d4dff {0} ^000000。
带一道就够了，和其他材料一起拿来吧。

scripts.text:
[Chef Nyas]
You have to bring the dish that made from fresh ingredients.
^ff0000I will refuse the instant food.^000000
scripts.translation:
[厨师尼亚斯]
请带用新鲜食材做的料理。
^ff0000即食食品我可不要。^000000

scripts.text:
[Chef Nyas]
Hey my friend, you have a bad memory.
Did you already take my order list?
scripts.translation:
[厨师尼亚斯]
嘿，朋友，你记性真差。
已经拿到我的订单清单了吗？

scripts.text:
[Chef Nyas]
Do you remember what I ask to bring?
I have no idea.
scripts.translation:
[厨师尼亚斯]
还记得我让你带什么来吗？
我自己都不记得了。

scripts.text:
[Chef Nyas]
What did I say to bring?
I don't remember?
Did you get something wrong to come here?
scripts.translation:
[厨师尼亚斯]
我让你带什么来着？
我不记得了...
你是不是弄错了？

scripts.text:
[Chef Nyas]
Is that ingredients of cat's ship biscuit and the food of human?
Let me check what you brought...
scripts.translation:
[厨师尼亚斯]
这些是做猫饼干的材料，还有人类的料理吗？
让我看看你带了什么...

scripts.text:
[Chef Nyas]
Great.
This is that food!
It will be good reference. Well done.
scripts.translation:
[厨师尼亚斯]
很好。
就是这个料理！
很有参考价值，干得不错。

scripts.text:
[Chef Nyas]
Alright, could you come tomorrow?
When the time to you coming, I'm very excited.
Nyahuh Nyahuh
scripts.translation:
[厨师尼亚斯]
好，明天再来吧。
想到你明天会来，我就很期待。
喵呼喵呼~

scripts.text:
[Chef Nyas]
Yummm...
Did I overestimate your ability?
Double check what is short and bring them properly.
scripts.translation:
[厨师尼亚斯]
嗯...
我是不是高估你的能力了？
再仔细核对缺少的东西，然后带齐了再来。

scripts.text:
[Chef Nyas]
There is not different from undiscerning young cat.
scripts.translation:
[厨师尼亚斯]
跟没见识的小猫没两样。

scripts.text:
[Chef Nyas]
You are quite bold like a killer whale.
If you don't have any business, don't touch vegetable and go away.
scripts.translation:
[厨师尼亚斯]
你倒是胆大得像虎鲸。
没事就别碰蔬菜，赶紧走开。

scripts.text: - You have too many items to proceed in this quest. -
scripts.translation: - 物品栏太满，无法继续任务。 -

scripts.text:
[Rato]
Seems like a visitor.
How does this island look?
It is hard to believe, but this ground is very soft, so we named this island Malangdo.
scripts.translation:
[拉托]
看起来你是来访的。
觉得这座岛怎么样？
听起来难以置信吧？这里的地面非常柔软，所以我们把岛命名为绵绵岛。

scripts.text:
[Rato]
If you were a more professional adventurer, I'd ask you one thing...
Well, I won't do it.
scripts.translation:
[拉托]
要是你是个更有经验的冒险者，我倒有件事想请教...
算了，还是不说了。

scripts.text:
[Rato]
Hey there.
I am Rato, do you have a moment?
scripts.translation:
[拉托]
你好。
我叫拉托，你有空吗？

scripts.text: Yeah, sure I do.
scripts.translation: 当然有空

scripts.text: I'm sorry, but I'm busy right now.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我现在很忙

scripts.text:
[Rato]
Well, nothing special, but could you do me a favor?
Did you see the kids gathered on your way here?
scripts.translation:
[拉托]
没什么大事，不过能请你帮个忙吗？
你来的路上看到那群孩子了吗？

scripts.text: Kids?
scripts.translation: 孩子？

scripts.text:
[Rato]
Yes yes, baby kids.
They are the youngest kids among the merchants and crews.
They feel anxious that they might not be able to go back home.
scripts.translation:
[拉托]
是啊，那些小猫。
他们是商人和船员中年纪最小的孩子。
他们担心自己可能再也回不了家。

scripts.text:
[Rato]
And they are getting bored of living on this small island.
They already tasted sea and adventure...
scripts.translation:
[拉托]
他们也厌倦了在这座小岛上生活。
毕竟他们已经见识过大海，也体验过冒险...

scripts.text:
[Rato]
They used to play with making things, but seem tired of that also...
If it's okay, would you play with them for a while?
scripts.translation:
[拉托]
他们以前喜欢自己做些东西玩，不过似乎也玩腻了...
方便的话，你能陪他们玩一会儿吗？

scripts.text: Uh, sure...
I don't have enough time for that.
scripts.translation: 我没时间陪他们

scripts.text:
[Rato]
Oh, thank you!
Then, where are they?
Maybe near Beginning Compass...?
scripts.translation:
[拉托]
哦，谢谢你！
他们在哪儿呢？
会不会在起始罗盘附近...？

scripts.text:
[Rato]
They are so active that I am not sure where they are now.
If you meet them, please spend time with them.
scripts.translation:
[拉托]
他们太活泼了，我也不知道现在跑到哪儿去了。
遇见他们的话，请陪他们玩一会儿。

scripts.text:
[Rato]
Oh, really?
It's okay even though you cannot do this right now.
If you meet them, please spend time with them.
scripts.translation:
[拉托]
哦，是吗？
你现在没空也没关系。
遇见他们的话，请陪他们玩一会儿。

scripts.text: If you meet them, please spend time with them.
scripts.translation: 遇见他们的话，请陪他们玩一会儿。

scripts.text:
[Rato]
The youngest one is Charo, with gold fur.
Roku has black fur, and Rosy has white fur.
Please take care of them.
scripts.translation:
[拉托]
最小的叫查罗，毛是金色的。
罗库是黑毛，罗西是白毛。
拜托你照看他们了。

scripts.text:
[Rato]
Oh, really?
I am sorry for disturbing you.
scripts.translation:
[拉托]
哦，是吗？
抱歉打扰你了。

scripts.text:
[Rato]
The youngest one is Charo, with gold fur.
Roku has black fur, and Rosy has white fur.
scripts.translation:
[拉托]
最小的叫查罗，毛是金色的。
罗库是黑毛，罗西是白毛。

scripts.text:
[Rato]
We can look forward to the moment we can go back home if these children grow up nicely.
For that reason, please take care of them.
scripts.translation:
[拉托]
只要这些孩子能平安长大，我们就还有回家的希望。
所以，请帮忙照看他们。

scripts.text:
[Rato]
Do kids disturb you too much?
What... adventurer group? Did you play with toys from the adventurer group?
scripts.translation:
[拉托]
孩子们是不是太缠着你了？
什么...冒险者团体？你是用他们的玩具陪孩子玩的吗？

scripts.text:
[Rato]
I really worried about them the first time we were shipwrecked to this island...
They thought the first voyage was huge adventure...
scripts.translation:
[拉托]
刚漂流到这座岛上时，我真的很担心他们...
可他们却把第一次航海当成了一场大冒险...

scripts.text:
[Rato]
They look excited, like they got a fever.
It seems like yesterday that I made toys for them and soothed them...
scripts.translation:
[拉托]
他们兴奋得像发烧了一样。
我仿佛昨天才刚做了玩具哄他们开心...

scripts.text: Rato seems to be in brown study.
scripts.translation: 拉托似乎陷入了沉思。

scripts.text:
You didn't bring the pieces of the painting.
Please take it with you.
scripts.translation:
你还没带画作碎片来。
请把碎片带来。

scripts.text:
[Rato]
What's going on?
It should be very hard to take care of the kids even though I asked you, isn't it?
I am sorry, I should take care of them...
scripts.translation:
[拉托]
怎么了？
虽然是我拜托你的，照顾孩子还是很辛苦吧？
抱歉，我应该自己照看他们...

scripts.text: You hand Rato a piece of painting.
scripts.translation: 你把一块画作碎片递给拉托。

scripts.text:
[Rato]
Oh, this is a piece of painting?
Ah!!!
Has this painting been torn up already?
scripts.translation:
[拉托]
哦，这是画作碎片？
啊！！！
这幅画已经被撕碎了？

scripts.text:
[Rato]
Did they say this is a gift for me?
Huhhuh, a piece of painting?
HAHAHAHAHA!
scripts.translation:
[拉托]
他们说这是送给我的礼物？
呼呼，画作碎片？
哈哈哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Rato]
Okay, I will patch up this painting by myself.
They are still the same.
I think I should worry about myself first...
scripts.translation:
[拉托]
好吧，我自己来修补这幅画。
他们还是老样子...
我想我还是先担心自己吧...

scripts.text:
[Rato]
It's very kind of you to play with the kids.
This is for you.
scripts.translation:
[拉托]
谢谢你陪孩子们玩。
这个送给你。

scripts.text:
[Rato]
I owe you a big favor!
Let's drink today!
Miaow~
scripts.translation:
[拉托]
我欠你一个大人情！
今天一起喝一杯吧！
喵呜~

scripts.text:
[Rato]
Hey, how's it going? If you have time please look at it.
scripts.translation:
[拉托]
嗨，最近怎么样？有空的话，来看看这个吧。

scripts.text: Look at a picture.
scripts.translation: 看看画

scripts.text: Don't look at a picture.
scripts.translation: 不看画

scripts.text:
[Rato]
Yes, they drew this picture full of happiness.
scripts.translation:
[拉托]
没错，他们画下了这幅充满欢乐的画。

scripts.text: Appreciate the picture in the frame.
scripts.translation: 欣赏相框里的画。

scripts.text:
[Rato]
Why don't you look at such a nice picture?
I'm disapointed.
scripts.translation:
[拉托]
这么好看的画，你怎么不看看？
我有点失望。

scripts.text: - You have too many items to proceed in this quest. -
scripts.translation: - 物品栏太满，无法继续任务。 -

scripts.text:
There are cats who seem younger than the other crew.
They are having a serious conversation about the weird machine in front of them.
scripts.translation:
有几只猫看起来比其他船员年纪小。
他们正认真讨论面前那台奇怪的机器。

scripts.text:
There are cats who seem younger than the other crew.
They are having a serious conversation about the weird machine in front of them.
They look like the kids that Rato told me about.
scripts.translation:
有几只猫看起来比其他船员年纪小。
他们正认真讨论面前那台奇怪的机器。
看起来就是拉托提到的那些孩子。

scripts.text: Just watch them without a word.
scripts.translation: 不出声地看着他们

scripts.text: Busy right now.
scripts.translation: 我现在很忙

scripts.text: You try to listen to the conversation without disturbing them.
scripts.translation: 你试着不惊动他们，悄悄听他们说话。

scripts.text:
[Charo]
When will it be fixed? When it will be done?
Isn't this the last one?
scripts.translation:
[查罗]
什么时候才能修好？还要多久？
这应该是最后一个了吧？

scripts.text:
[Rosy]
Um... you don't even get tried of it?
Anyway, we are in trouble.
The glass bead is broken.
scripts.translation:
[罗西]
嗯...你们还不腻吗？
总之，我们遇到麻烦了。
玻璃珠碎了。

scripts.text:
[Roku]
Don't we have an extra glass bead?
scripts.translation:
[罗库]
我们没有备用的玻璃珠吗？

scripts.text:
[Rosy]
No, we don't have any.
We can't fix this without it, right?
scripts.translation:
[罗西]
没有，一颗都没有。
没有它就修不好了，对吧？

scripts.text: The cats look your way at the same time.
scripts.translation: 几只猫同时转头看向你。

scripts.text: I have a spare Glass Bead!
scripts.translation: 我有备用的玻璃珠！

scripts.text: Why are you guys staring at me?
scripts.translation: 你们为什么盯着我看？

scripts.text:
[Roku]
There is no glass bead.
Don't lie to us.
scripts.translation:
[罗库]
根本没有玻璃珠。
别骗我们。

scripts.text:
[Charo]
Really? Oh, really?
It's a bead! And a shining glass bead as well!
scripts.translation:
[查罗]
真的吗？真的有吗？
是玻璃珠！而且还闪闪发亮！

scripts.text:
[Rosy]
Hmm. This is enough to replace it.
Like this...
scripts.translation:
[罗西]
嗯，这个刚好可以替换。
像这样...

scripts.text:
[Roku]
And then here, this?
Done.
scripts.translation:
[罗库]
然后这里...这样？
好了。

scripts.text:
[Charo]
Exciting!!!
Okay, adventurer! We'll give you the right to use this machine!
Try this whenever you want to!!
scripts.translation:
[查罗]
太棒了！！！
冒险者，我们授予你使用这台机器的权利！
以后想玩随时都可以来！！

scripts.text:
[Charo]
Advanturer! This is a delicious can.
You can get whatever you want with cans in this island. It is tradable.
Rosy, Roku and I collected them.
scripts.translation:
[查罗]
冒险者！这是美味的罐头。
在岛上，罐头可以换到任何想要的东西，也能和别人交易。
罗西、罗库和我收集了这些。

scripts.text:
[Charo]
And adventurer!
If you were a real adventurer,
you would clear all Nyadventures
made by the Meow Bravery Team!
Challenge it whenever you want to!
scripts.translation:
[查罗]
还有，冒险者！
如果你是真正的冒险者，
就来完成喵之勇气队制作的
所有喵冒险吧！
随时欢迎来挑战！

scripts.text:
[Rosy]
We are just looking at you as you stand there.
scripts.translation:
[罗西]
我们只是看着你站在那里而已。

scripts.text: I'll come again later.
scripts.translation: 我晚点再来。

scripts.text:
[Charo]
We fixed the Duruduru compass, we only need a visitor now...
Hey, do you want to be a visitor?
scripts.translation:
[查罗]
我们修好了嘟嘟罗盘，现在只差一位访客了...
嘿，你想当这位访客吗？

scripts.text: A visitor?
scripts.translation: 访客？

scripts.text:
[Charo]
This is an adventure course made by the Meow adventure team.
Especially we have added studying course this time.
It's simple to solve, you only need to find compass in this island according to order.
scripts.translation:
[查罗]
这是喵冒险队制作的冒险课程。
这次还特别加入了学习课程。
玩法很简单，只要按顺序找到岛上的罗盘就行。

scripts.text: I'll give it a try.
scripts.translation: 我来试试

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text:
[Charo]
Here is your Adventure Card.
This is the Duruduru Compass which we fixed with the glass bead you gave us.
And this is the Beginning Compass.
scripts.translation:
[查罗]
这是你的冒险卡。
这台是我们用你给的玻璃珠修好的嘟嘟罗盘。
这台则是起始罗盘。

scripts.text:
[Charo]
The game will start if you put the Adventure Card in here!
This machine is for testing essential ingredients of adventure.
scripts.translation:
[查罗]
把冒险卡放进这里，游戏就会开始！
这台机器会考验冒险者必备的基本能力。

scripts.text:
[Charo]
Don't forget the destination for successful adventure.
And you should find a way to get to your destination as fast as possible.
scripts.translation:
[查罗]
别忘了冒险的终点。
还要想办法尽快抵达目的地。

scripts.text:
[Charo]
You will be good, as you are a good person for giving us the glass bead.
scripts.translation:
[查罗]
你愿意把玻璃珠给我们，真是个好人，一定能顺利完成的。

scripts.text:
Got Adventure Card from the yellow cat Charo.
It seems to work if I put this card in the slot in the Beginning Compass.
scripts.translation:
我从黄毛猫查罗那里拿到了冒险卡。
看起来把卡插进起始罗盘的卡槽里就能启动。

scripts.text:
[Charo]
The game will start if you scratch Adventure Card to the Beginning Compass!
The Beginning Compass will let you know where you should go.
scripts.translation:
[查罗]
在起始罗盘上刷一下冒险卡，游戏就会开始！
起始罗盘会告诉你该往哪里走。

scripts.text:
[Charo]
^4d4dffIf you go through all the compasses, you will see Meowbell from the ship Navi at last!
Ring the New bell!^000000
scripts.translation:
[查罗]
^4d4dff通过所有罗盘后，最后就能看到纳维号上的喵铃！
敲响新铃铛吧！^000000

scripts.text:
[Charo]
Ah... you are not going to do it...
Um...
Sob~
Meow~
scripts.translation:
[查罗]
啊...你不打算参加吗...
嗯...
呜...
喵...

scripts.text:
[Rosy]
Hey, adventurer. Don't make kids cry!
scripts.translation:
[罗西]
喂，冒险者，别把孩子弄哭了！

scripts.text:
[Charo]
Oh? Isn't this failed stamp from Bubi?
I'm really disappointed.
Try again~ you can make it!
scripts.translation:
[查罗]
哦？这是布比留下的失败印章吗？
我太失望了。
再试一次吧~你一定可以的！

scripts.text:
[Charo]
The game will start if you scratch Adventure Card to the Beginning Compass!
The Beginning Compass will let you know where you should go.
scripts.translation:
[查罗]
在起始罗盘上刷一下冒险卡，游戏就会开始！
起始罗盘会告诉你该往哪里走。

scripts.text:
[Charo]
^4d4dffIf you go through all the compasses, you will see Meowbell from the ship Navi at last!
Ring the New bell!^000000
scripts.translation:
[查罗]
^4d4dff通过所有罗盘后，最后就能看到纳维号上的喵铃！
敲响新铃铛吧！^000000

scripts.text:
[Charo]
Where is your Adventure Card?
You should bring it with you.
You can't be serious that you threw it away with your other trash!!
scripts.translation:
[查罗]
你的冒险卡呢？
应该随身带着才对。
你不会把它和其他垃圾一起扔了吧？！

scripts.text:
[Charo]
I heard it!
I heard sound of Meowbell!
You are great!
The next will be a big case!
scripts.translation:
[查罗]
我听见了！
我听见喵铃响了！
你太厉害了！
接下来可是大案子！

scripts.text: The next?
scripts.translation: 接下来呢？

scripts.text:
[Charo]
You are member of the Meow Bravery Team while you have the card with you.
We need an adventurer like you anyways, since this is a big case.
scripts.translation:
[查罗]
只要带着这张卡，你就是喵之勇气队的成员。
正好有件大案子，我们需要你这样的冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Charo]
It's for the cuff.
It seems a bomb is planted in this island.
The detective has went for this case already.
scripts.translation:
[查罗]
这是为了调查案件。
岛上好像被人安放了炸弹。
侦探已经去处理这件事了。

scripts.text:
[Charo]
You should go there too!
scripts.translation:
[查罗]
你也快去帮忙！

scripts.text: Why do I have to go there?
scripts.translation: 我为什么要去？

scripts.text: What an adventure! I'll take it!
scripts.translation: 真是刺激的冒险！我接了！

scripts.text:
[Charo]
This is a big case!
And this island could explode!
Oh, you might shut your eyes to the fact.
Give the Adventure Card back!
scripts.translation:
[查罗]
这可是大案子！
整座岛都可能爆炸！
你竟然想对这件事视而不见。
把冒险卡还给我！

scripts.text:
[Charo]
You have great capabilities as an adventurer!
Please help detective and his friend who got in trouble and also save this island!
scripts.translation:
[查罗]
你很有冒险者的本事！
请帮帮遇到麻烦的侦探和他的朋友，也救救这座岛！

scripts.text:
[Charo]
But be sure this should be done undercover!
Therefore you need to take this certification.
It shouldn't happen that the detective misunderstands you as an enemy!
scripts.translation:
[查罗]
但一定要秘密行动！
所以你得拿上这张证明。
可不能让侦探把你误认成敌人！

scripts.text: - Changed Adventure Card A into Adventure Card B. -
scripts.translation: - 冒险卡A已更换为冒险卡B。 -

scripts.text:
[Charo]
The great detective and his friend will be around the ship Navi.
scripts.translation:
[查罗]
那位大侦探和他的朋友就在纳维号附近。

scripts.text:
[Charo]
Do you feel a disposition to help the detective and his friend?
Don't you?
scripts.translation:
[查罗]
你愿意帮侦探和他的朋友吗？
难道不愿意吗？

scripts.text: Yes I do.
scripts.translation: 愿意

scripts.text: No I don't.
scripts.translation: 不愿意

scripts.text:
[Charo]
You have great capabilities as an adventurer!
Please help detective and his friend who got in trouble and also save this island!
scripts.translation:
[查罗]
你很有冒险者的本事！
请帮帮遇到麻烦的侦探和他的朋友，也救救这座岛！

scripts.text:
[Charo]
But be sure this should be done undercover!
Therefore you need to take this certification.
It shouldn't happen that the detective misunderstands you as an enemy!
scripts.translation:
[查罗]
但一定要秘密行动！
所以你得拿上这张证明。
可不能让侦探把你误认成敌人！

scripts.text: - Changed Adventure Card A into Adventure Card B. -
scripts.translation: - 冒险卡A已更换为冒险卡B。 -

scripts.text:
[Charo]
The great detective and his friend will be acound ship Navi.
scripts.translation:
[查罗]
那位大侦探和他的朋友会在纳维号附近。

scripts.text:
[Charo]
Oh my god, the great detective and the ship Navi...
scripts.translation:
[查罗]
天哪，那位大侦探和纳维号...

scripts.text:
[Charo]
The great detective and his friend will be around the ship Navi.
scripts.translation:
[查罗]
那位大侦探和他的朋友就在纳维号附近。

scripts.text:
[Charo]
I have been waiting for you...~
Oh, I am short of breath from coming here in a hurry.
Hmph... Meow...
scripts.translation:
[查罗]
我一直在等你呢...~
啊，我一路赶过来，都喘不过气了。
呼...喵...

scripts.text:
[Charo]
Don't you have anything to show me?
Let me see it quickly!
Take it out!
scripts.translation:
[查罗]
你没带要给我看的东西吗？
快让我看看！
拿出来！

scripts.text:
[Charo]
What? You don't have it?
It can't be true.
Surely you took this with you...
scripts.translation:
[查罗]
什么？你没带？
不可能。
你肯定随身带着的...

scripts.text:
[Rosy]
How come it happened?
This painting is very important for us.
Please give it back to us.
scripts.translation:
[罗西]
怎么会这样？
这幅画对我们很重要。
请把它还给我们。

scripts.text:
[Charo]
Yes, this is it!
This is our...
But, how do we put the broken pieces together?
scripts.translation:
[查罗]
没错，就是这块！
这是我们的...
不过，这些碎片要怎么拼起来呢？

scripts.text:
[Rosy]
We need a board and glue as well to put it together.
That's too troublesome to just give it away!
scripts.translation:
[罗西]
还得找块板子和胶水才能拼起来。
送出去也太麻烦了吧！

scripts.text:
[Roku]
Rato, looks like he is happy.
He will understand.
scripts.translation:
[罗库]
拉托看起来很高兴。
他会明白我们的心意。

scripts.text:
[Charo]
Really...?
There is no Meow team and us without Rato.
I feel a little bad to give only pieces of painting but...
scripts.translation:
[查罗]
真的吗...？
没有拉托，就没有喵队，也没有我们。
只送画作碎片过去，我有点过意不去...

scripts.text:
[Charo]
We have no other way!
Rato treated this by himself!
No, it's better to ask Rato to put this back together.
scripts.translation:
[查罗]
也没别的办法了！
拉托会自己处理好的！
不，还是请拉托把画拼起来吧。

scripts.text:
[Rosy]
Good idea.
That's really a good idea.
I was getting tired of it.
scripts.translation:
[罗西]
好主意。
这主意真不错。
我都快被这件事烦死了。

scripts.text:
[Charo]
You are a member of the Meow Bravery Team.
Please give these pieces of painting to Rato.
And tell him to treat it preciously as our treasure...
scripts.translation:
[查罗]
你是喵之勇气队的成员。
请把这些画作碎片交给拉托，
告诉他要像珍宝一样好好珍藏...

scripts.text:
[Charo]
We couldn't make the Bravery Team without Rato.
Please.
Tell him we didn't forget our home island.
scripts.translation:
[查罗]
没有拉托，就没有喵之勇气队。
拜托你了，告诉他我们没有忘记故乡的岛。

scripts.text:
[Charo]
Please give this pating to Rato.
We drawed this painting to show Rato.
Please.
scripts.translation:
[查罗]
给你！请把这幅画交给拉托。
我们画下来就是想给他看的。
拜托了。

scripts.text:
[Charo]
Here you are! Our emeritus member of the new Bravery Team!
Where did you go for adventure today?
Are these adventure stories?!
If not, then...
scripts.translation:
[查罗]
给你！喵之勇气队的新任荣誉成员！
今天去了哪里冒险？
这些是冒险故事吗？！
要不是的话...

scripts.text:
[Charo]
You might have come here for the compass race like huge tuna from our Meow Bravery Team!!
Meow!
scripts.translation:
[查罗]
你是来参加嘟嘟罗盘比赛的吧？就像我们喵之勇气队那条大金枪鱼一样！！
喵！

scripts.text:
[Charo]
Well, Homnya and Nyangson are too difficult for me.
...?
I meant the book is difficult for me.
scripts.translation:
[查罗]
嗯，霍姆尼亚和喵森对我来说太难了。
...？
我是说，那本书太难了。

scripts.text:
[Charo]
Do you know how much Rato loves the painting which you have found?
He put framed the painting on the wall!
Meow~
scripts.translation:
[查罗]
你知道拉托有多喜欢你找到的那幅画吗？
他已经把它装裱起来挂在墙上了！
喵~

scripts.text:
[Charo]
I miss my hometown.
But Malangdo is also my hometown as well.
I am okay with us all together in here~
scripts.translation:
[查罗]
我很想念故乡。
不过绵绵岛也是我的家。
只要大家都在这里，我就满足了~

scripts.text:
A young cat with white fur tries so hard with the weird machine.
The machine might be broken.
scripts.translation:
一只白毛小猫正努力摆弄那台奇怪的机器。
机器可能坏了。

scripts.text:
[Rosy]
Um? The adventurer who brought us the glass bead?
I really thank you for that.
We could fix the compass with that glass bead.
scripts.translation:
[罗西]
嗯？你就是给我们带来玻璃珠的冒险者吗？
真的很谢谢你。
多亏那颗玻璃珠，我们才修好了罗盘。

scripts.text:
[Rosy]
Adventure Card? Will you do the Duruduru race?
It's hard to say it's fun even though we made it.
scripts.translation:
[罗西]
冒险卡？你要参加嘟嘟罗盘比赛吗？
虽然是我们设计的，但我也不敢说它有多好玩。

scripts.text:
[Charo]
Oh, it's fun! Perfectly fun!
I have remodeled it this time!!
It will be really fun!!
scripts.translation:
[查罗]
好玩！绝对好玩！
这次我重新改装过了！！
一定会特别有趣！！

scripts.text:
[Roku]
Yes. It's fun, as Charo said.
Maybe.
...
It is.
scripts.translation:
[罗库]
对，就像查罗说的，很好玩。
大概吧。
...
确实很好玩。

scripts.text:
[Rosy]
Meow...
I feel sleepy today.
I've had sore throat these day because I talked too much...
scripts.translation:
[罗西]
喵...
我今天好困。
这几天说话太多，嗓子都疼了...

scripts.text:
[Rosy]
Don't you agree with me, friend?
...?
Oh, I didn't even realize...
scripts.translation:
[罗西]
朋友，你也这么觉得吧？
...？
哎呀，我刚才没注意到...

scripts.text:
[Rosy]
Forget about it!
Doesn't this machine ever break?
scripts.translation:
[罗西]
算了！
这台机器怎么总是坏？

scripts.text: - You have too many items to proceed in this quest. -
scripts.translation: - 物品栏太满，无法继续任务。 -

scripts.text:
A young black cat helps the busy white cat.
Maybe the machine is broken.
scripts.translation:
一只小黑猫正在帮忙碌的白猫。
机器好像坏了。

scripts.text:
[Roku]
Oh? You are the one who gave us the glass bead.
Thanks a lot.
I am happy, too, because Charo looks happy.
scripts.translation:
[罗库]
哦？你就是送我们玻璃珠的人啊。
多谢了。
查罗这么开心，我也很高兴。

scripts.text:
[Roku]
Charo likes it.
It will be fun.
scripts.translation:
[罗库]
查罗喜欢就好。
应该会很好玩。

scripts.text:
[Roku]
Charo has been waiting for so long.
To Charo...
scripts.translation:
[罗库]
查罗等了很久了。
给查罗的...

scripts.text:
[Roku]
Do you have something to tell me?
scripts.translation:
[罗库]
你有话要对我说吗？

scripts.text: Report results of the race.
scripts.translation: 汇报比赛结果

scripts.text: Challenge the race.
scripts.translation: 挑战比赛

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 没什么

scripts.text:
[Roku]
Bubi, no confirmation stamps and card.
You will be in trouble if you are like this.
scripts.translation:
[罗库]
布比，你的确认印章和卡片都不见了。
这样下去会惹麻烦的。

scripts.text:
[Roku]
Good job.
You are very smart.
This is a gift for you.
Please come tomorrow again.
scripts.translation:
[罗库]
做得好，你很聪明。
这是给你的礼物。
明天再来吧。

scripts.text:
[Roku]
Charo likes you so much.
He will be happy if you come.
scripts.translation:
[罗库]
查罗很喜欢你。
你要是来，他一定会很开心。

scripts.text:
[Roku]
Failed...
...is it too difficult for you?
But the race is available only once a day.
scripts.translation:
[罗库]
失败了...
...对你来说太难了吗？
不过比赛一天只能参加一次。

scripts.text: Give me one more chance!
scripts.translation: 再给我一次机会！

scripts.text: Okay.I will try tomorrow.
scripts.translation: 好吧，明天再试

scripts.text:
[Roku]
Um... Um... Well...
If you bring a Malangdo Can,
I will give you one more chance.
scripts.translation:
[罗库]
嗯...嗯...这个嘛...
带一罐绵绵岛罐头来，我就再给你一次机会。

scripts.text:
[Roku]
Okay. Do you want to exchange 1 Malangdo Can for a Adventure Card?
scripts.translation:
[罗库]
好。要用1个绵绵岛罐头换一张冒险卡吗？

scripts.text: Exchange for Adventure Card A.
scripts.translation: 兑换冒险卡A

scripts.text: Stop it.
scripts.translation: 算了

scripts.text:
[Roku]
You have it already?
scripts.translation:
[罗库]
你已经有一张了吗？

scripts.text:
[Roku]
Here is your Adventure Card.
Beginning Compass, start!
scripts.translation:
[罗库]
这是你的冒险卡。
起始罗盘，启动！

scripts.text:
[Roku]
Okay, come again tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[罗库]
好，明天再来吧。

scripts.text:
[Roku]
Okay, come again tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[罗库]
好，明天再来吧。

scripts.text:
[Roku]
You have reported the result for today already.
Right?
scripts.translation:
[罗库]
你今天已经汇报过结果了，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Roku]
You are too hasty.
You didn't even finish the race.
It's still going.
scripts.translation:
[罗库]
你太心急了。
比赛还没结束呢。

scripts.text:
[Roku]
The result is little weird, but...
This is neither a complete race nor incomplete race.
scripts.translation:
[罗库]
结果有点奇怪...
说不上完成，也不能算没完成。

scripts.text:
[Roku]
Is this because of the machine?
Let's make void for this race.
scripts.translation:
[罗库]
是机器出问题了吗？
这次比赛就作废吧。

scripts.text:
[Roku]
You have failed?
Do you want to try again?
I will delete the report of the failed result.
scripts.translation:
[罗库]
你失败了吗？
还想再试一次吗？
我会删掉这次失败的记录。

scripts.text:
[Roku]
No, not yet.
Duruduru race is only once for a day.
If we do it more often, the machine will break.
scripts.translation:
[罗库]
不，现在还不行。
嘟嘟罗盘比赛一天只能参加一次。
玩得太频繁，机器会坏掉的。

scripts.text:
[Roku]
I know that you will try the Duruduru race.
I deleted your last report.
scripts.translation:
[罗库]
我知道你还想参加嘟嘟罗盘比赛。
我已经删掉你上次的记录了。

scripts.text:
[Roku]
You need a Adventure Card to challenge again.
Do you want to exchange 1 Malangdo Can for a Adventure Card?
scripts.translation:
[罗库]
想再次挑战，得先有冒险卡。
要用1个绵绵岛罐头换一张冒险卡吗？

scripts.text: Buy Adventure Card.
scripts.translation: 购买冒险卡

scripts.text: Just stop it.
scripts.translation: 算了

scripts.text:
[Roku]
You have it already?
scripts.translation:
[罗库]
你已经有一张了吗？

scripts.text:
[Roku]
There is nothing for free.
You need a Malangdo Can.
scripts.translation:
[罗库]
没有免费的东西。
需要用一个绵绵岛罐头来换。

scripts.text:
[Roku]
Here is your Adventure Card.
Beginning Compass, start!
scripts.translation:
[罗库]
这是你的冒险卡。
起始罗盘，启动！

scripts.text:
[Roku]
Okay.
scripts.translation:
[罗库]
好。

scripts.text:
[Roku]
You are the weird one.
scripts.translation:
[罗库]
你才奇怪呢。

scripts.text:
There is a strange machine.
The kids said this was the ride called Duruduru compass of the Meow Bravery Team.
scripts.translation:
有一台奇怪的机器。
孩子们说这是喵之勇气队的游乐设施——嘟嘟罗盘。

scripts.text:
An iron pot contains a map of Malangdo with a card inserter.
After inserting your card, a red button and the map inside the pot light up.
It seems to start after pressing the button.
scripts.translation:
铁锅里装着绵绵岛地图，旁边有个卡片插槽。
插入卡片后，红色按钮和锅里的地图都会亮起来。
看起来按下按钮就能启动。

scripts.text: Start it right now.
scripts.translation: 现在启动

scripts.text: Start it later.
scripts.translation: 稍后启动

scripts.text: The card has come out with lights on the map after pressing the button.
scripts.translation: 按下按钮后，卡片弹了出来，地图上的灯也亮了。

scripts.text: The game has started already!
scripts.translation: 游戏已经开始了！

scripts.text: The game has started already!
scripts.translation: 游戏已经开始了！

scripts.text: Challenge it a little later.
scripts.translation: 请稍后再来挑战。

scripts.text:
The destination displays with pressing the button after inserting the card.
It's above the deck in the middle of the island!
scripts.translation:
插入卡片并按下按钮，目的地就会显示出来。
就在岛中央的甲板上！

scripts.text:
Beginning Compass among the Duruduru compass.
The Duruduru race starts from this compass.
scripts.translation:
这是嘟嘟罗盘的起始罗盘。
嘟嘟罗盘比赛从这里开始。

scripts.text:
After inserting the card and pressing the red button, the path to the destination lit up.
The order will be {0}^000000.
scripts.translation:
插入卡片并按下红色按钮后，通往目的地的路线亮了起来。
顺序是{0}^000000。

scripts.text: The order will be {0}^000000.

There is a strange machine.
This is the Duruduru compass from the Meow Bravery Team.
scripts.translation:
有一台奇怪的机器。
这是喵之勇气队的嘟嘟罗盘。

scripts.text:
Delicate {0} lights surround the {1}.
After inserting the card and pressing the button, characters appear on the screen.
scripts.translation:
精致的{0}色灯光环绕着{1}。
插入卡片并按下按钮后，屏幕上就会出现文字。

scripts.text: Delicate {0} lights surround the {1}.
scripts.translation: 精致的{0}色灯光环绕着{1}。

scripts.text: ^00FF00This is a card that didn't start the game yet. Please go back to the Beginning Compass.^000000
scripts.translation: ^00FF00这张卡还没启动游戏，请回到起始罗盘。^000000

scripts.text:
Welcome to the exciting number world!
Enter the exact answer after reading the question!
scripts.translation:
欢迎来到刺激的数字世界！
看清题目后输入正确答案！

scripts.text:
The card slides out with a sound after entering the number.
^4d4dffYou have passed the {0}! Run to the next destination!^000000
You should run for the next destination.
scripts.translation:
输入数字后，卡片伴着提示音滑了出来。
^4d4dff你通过了{0}！快跑去下一个目的地！^000000
快去下一个目的地吧。

scripts.text:
You've got wrong answer!
You can not pass here without exact answer!
Enter exact answer after read question!
scripts.translation:
答案错了！
答对才能通过这里！
看清题目后再输入正确答案！

scripts.text:
The compass needle turns around in the middle of map.
You should run for the next destination.
scripts.translation:
地图中央的罗盘指针转动起来。
快跑去下一个目的地吧。

scripts.text: ^FF0000You are going the wrong way! The paths in the card and compass don't line up!^000000
scripts.translation: ^FF0000你走错方向了！卡片上的路线和罗盘不一致！^000000

scripts.text:
There is a fancy bell which doesn't fit in with the ship.
This bell is used in a game by the Meow Bravery Team.
scripts.translation:
船上有个格格不入的华丽铃铛。
这是喵之勇气队在游戏中使用的铃铛。

scripts.text:
There is a one more little bell beside the huge notice bell in the deck.
This is the Meowbell from the Meow Bravery Team.
scripts.translation:
甲板上的大型通知铃旁边，还有一只小铃铛。
这是喵之勇气队的喵铃。

scripts.text:
This is last bell to ring if you have the card for the game.
Nothing to say for now.
scripts.translation:
持有游戏卡的话，这是最后一个要敲的铃铛。
目前没有其他提示。

scripts.text:
This is the Meowbell.
You insert your card into the middle slot.
Knock Meowbell!!
scripts.translation:
这是喵铃。
把卡插进中间的插槽。
敲响喵铃！！

scripts.text:
This is the Meowbell.
You insert your card into the middle slot.
-- Beep --
The card has out with a warning sound.
scripts.translation:
这是喵铃。
把卡插进中间的插槽。
-- 哔 --
卡片伴着警告声弹了出来。

scripts.text:
[Deckhand Bubi]
Oh, I'm suprised.
You rang the Meowbell in a short time.
I think you have the talent to be an adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[甲板水手布比]
哦，真让人惊讶。
你这么快就敲响了喵铃。
我看你很有冒险者的天赋。

scripts.text:
[Deckhand Bubi]
People say...
The purpose of this Duruduru game
is to find and go to a destination quickly and accurately.
scripts.translation:
[甲板水手布比]
听说...
嘟嘟罗盘比赛就是要又快又准地找到目的地并赶过去。

scripts.text:
[Deckhand Bubi]
Go to Charo with that Adventure Card.
I will give you a confirmation stamp for success.
scripts.translation:
[甲板水手布比]
拿着冒险卡去找查罗。
我会给你盖个成功印章。

scripts.text:
[Deckhand Bubi]
Oh, you've really gotten used to it.
You succeeded again.
I've put my paw stamp here.
Run to Rato now.
scripts.translation:
[甲板水手布比]
哦，你越来越熟练了。
又成功了。
我已经在这里盖上爪印章。
现在去找拉托吧。

scripts.text:
[Deckhand Bubi]
You didn't ring the Meowbell within time.
Well, it's out of my hands now.
I will give you the fail stamp!!
scripts.translation:
[甲板水手布比]
你没能及时敲响喵铃。
好吧，我也帮不了你了。
给你盖个失败印章！！

scripts.text:
[Bubi]
Hey, human adventurer, what are you here for?
Yeah~ this is a beautiful view.
scripts.translation:
[布比]
嘿，人类冒险者，你来这里做什么？
嗯~这里风景真好。

scripts.text:
[Bubi]
Are you one of the people who came here to ring the Meowbell?
I am not a member of the Meow Team, but I can give you the confirmation stamp.
scripts.translation:
[布比]
你是来敲喵铃的吗？
我虽然不是喵之队的成员，但可以给你盖确认印章。

scripts.text:
[Bubi]
Um, my work?
Oh, that is only for when I am not on a voyage.
I am free these days.
scripts.translation:
[布比]
嗯，我的工作？
那是我不出航时才做的事。
最近我正好有空。

scripts.text:
[Cat Detective]
Um? What is the matter?
Hey, here is a suspicious guy.
scripts.translation:
[猫侦探]
嗯？怎么了？
嘿，那边有个可疑的家伙。

scripts.text:
[Cat Detective]
I can surely tell he is drunk by the smell of liquid.
I am so sad that I can not.
scripts.translation:
[猫侦探]
我当然能凭液体的气味判断他是不是喝醉了。
可惜我闻不出来。

scripts.text:
[Friend of Detective]
Oh, I am so sorry to hear that you have such genius analytical skills!
He is not drunk...
scripts.translation:
[侦探的朋友]
哎呀，你的分析能力可真“高明”，真替你难过！
他根本没喝醉...

scripts.text:
[Cat Detective]
Drunks always smell of liquid.
But he is not, therefore he is not drunk, friend.
scripts.translation:
[猫侦探]
醉汉身上总有液体味。
他没有液体味，所以他没喝醉，朋友。

scripts.text: Then what is your identity?
scripts.translation: 那你到底是什么身份？

scripts.text:
[Cat Detective]
Well... You are everything except drunk!!!
scripts.translation:
[猫侦探]
嗯...除了醉鬼，你什么都像！！！

scripts.text: The voice of the cats sounded shaky.
scripts.translation: 猫的声音听起来有些发颤。

scripts.text:
[Cat Detective]
What did I say?
Didn't I tell you that someone will come here soon?
scripts.translation:
[猫侦探]
我说过什么来着？
我不是说很快就会有人来吗？

scripts.text:
[Friend of Detective]
Great.
I can only admire your deduction.
scripts.translation:
[侦探的朋友]
真了不起。
我只能佩服你的推理。

scripts.text:
[Detective Homnya]
Haha, Nyangson, this is nothing for me.
Before that, let's listen to the stories from the visitor first.
scripts.translation:
[侦探霍姆尼亚]
哈哈，喵森，这点小事难不倒我。
先听听这位访客怎么说吧。

scripts.text: Charo? Rosy?
scripts.translation: 查罗？罗西？

scripts.text: Are you guys detectives?
scripts.translation: 你们是侦探吗？

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
No... Who are they?
Nyangson, do you know them?
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亚]
不是...他们是谁？
喵森，你认识他们吗？

scripts.text:
[Nyangson]
I... I don't know either?
I don't know Charo and Rosy!
scripts.translation:
[喵森]
我...我也不认识啊？
我不认识查罗和罗西！

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
Yes. Yes.
We are the detective and friend!
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亚]
没错，没错。
我们是侦探和他的朋友！

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
Yes, I am the detective, Homnya.
And this is my friend, Nyangson. He reports my cases.
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亚]
对，我是侦探霍姆尼亚。
这位是我的朋友喵森，负责报道我的案件。

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
Anyways, that's not important for now!
We should focus on current situation.
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亚]
总之，现在先不说这个！
我们得专心处理眼前的情况。

scripts.text:
[Nyangson]
Yes, that's right, friend.
We think........
scripts.translation:
[喵森]
是啊，没错，朋友。
我们觉得...

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
Yes! This is a bomb for sure!
I am so sorry, I have only analytical and detective skills but don't have the skill to dispose of a bomb!
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亚]
没错！这肯定是炸弹！
真抱歉，我只会分析和办案，不会拆炸弹！

scripts.text:
[Nyangson]
What do you mean by that?
It doesn't make any sense!
scripts.translation:
[喵森]
你这话是什么意思？
根本说不通啊！

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
Yes, we shout when it changed from the peak of hope into the peak of sorrow.
Peak!
Meow!
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亚]
没错！从希望的顶点跌到绝望的深渊时，我们就该大喊：
顶点！
喵！

scripts.text: I don't get the meaning of this, but they seem to be in hurry.
scripts.translation: 我听不懂他们在说什么，不过他们似乎很着急。

scripts.text: Continue to humor them.
scripts.translation: 继续陪他们演下去

scripts.text: Stop playing around.
scripts.translation: 别再胡闹了

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
Oh, if you give us a hand, I will take it. How do you think about it, friend?
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亚]
哦，你肯帮忙的话，我当然接受。你觉得呢，朋友？

scripts.text:
[Nyangson]
I don't really care about it. What I want to do is only to report this case.
One of the cases will be open to the public among the most strange and weird cases ever.
scripts.translation:
[喵森]
我倒不怎么在意。我只想把这起案件报道出来。
这会成为史上最离奇案件之一，公之于众。

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
I knew this visitor had the skill to dispose of a bomb.
He is totally prepared to escape from danger.
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亚]
我就知道这位访客会拆炸弹。
他显然做好了应对危险的准备。

scripts.text:
[Nyangson]
Oh, I heard of it. I heard they use fly wings and butterfly wings as well.
I've never thought I could meet a person who used these thing for real.
scripts.translation:
[喵森]
哦，我听说过。听说他们会用苍蝇翅膀和蝴蝶翅膀。
没想到我真能遇到使用这些东西的人。

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
Yes, I believe this visitor will solve our mystery.
Then please stop this damn machine!
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亚]
我相信这位访客能解开谜团。
那么，请把这台该死的机器停下来！

scripts.text:
[Nyangson]
Yes, the damn machine!
It is loud and useless!
And it will be blown up.
scripts.translation:
[喵森]
没错，就是这台该死的机器！
又吵又没用！
还会被炸飞！

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
Well, stop this machine!!!
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亚]
好了，快把机器停下来！！！

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
Please don't...
Please act according to the script.
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亚]
别这样...
照着剧本演就好。

scripts.text:
[Nyangson]
Charo. Where is the script?
No, Homnya. My friend...
scripts.translation:
[喵森]
查罗，剧本呢？
不，霍姆尼亚，我的朋友...

scripts.text: Two young cats are sweating a lot.
scripts.translation: 两只小猫紧张得满头大汗。

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
Stop this noisy machine!
This is the moment that your memory can be coming through!
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亚]
把这台吵死人的机器停下来！
你的记忆就要浮现了！

scripts.text:
[Nyangson]
Yes. Yes.
This is the sort of training where you dispose of and breach all the traps.
Yes, this is.
scripts.translation:
[喵森]
没错，没错。
这就是拆除并突破所有陷阱的训练。
就是这样。

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
It was a scary moment.
This machine is still fine anyways!
Stop it again.
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亚]
刚才真是吓人。
不过机器还好好的！
再把它停下来。

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
Yes, you need Adventure Card B to operate this machine.
Do you want to buy a new one?
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亚]
对，要操作这台机器，需要冒险卡B。
要买一张新的卡吗？

scripts.text:
[Nyangson]
It costs one Malangdo Can.
scripts.translation:
[喵森]
需要一个绵绵岛罐头。

scripts.text: Buy Adventure Card.
scripts.translation: 购买冒险卡

scripts.text: Do not buy.
scripts.translation: 不买

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
I said I can exchange Adventure Card with one Malango Can~
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亚]
我说过可以用一个绵绵岛罐头换冒险卡~

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
See, this is a scary machine.
Here is your Adventure Card.
Stop this machine this time.
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亚]
看，这机器挺吓人的吧。
这是你的冒险卡。
这次把机器停下来。

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
What?
But you came here to buy a Adventure Card.
......
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亚]
什么？
你不是来买冒险卡的吗？
...

scripts.text:
[Nyangson]
If you buy a Adventure Card there won't be any bloodshed...
scripts.translation:
[喵森]
买了冒险卡，就不会有人受伤了...

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
Hey, there is good news for you.
I received pretty good news while you struggled with that machine.
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亚]
嘿，有个好消息告诉你。
你刚才跟机器搏斗时，我收到一个好消息。

scripts.text:
[Nyangson]
Hello, capable friend, what did you find?
Is this something like hidden treasure?
scripts.translation:
[喵森]
你好，能干的朋友，有什么发现？
是隐藏的宝藏吗？

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
Hidden treasure?
Very similar!
It will be hidden in serveral places inside the cabin.
You should find them!
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亚]
宝藏？很像！
它们藏在纳维号船舱里的好几个地方。
快去找找！

scripts.text: I feel tired of it now.
scripts.translation: 我有点累了

scripts.text: Oh, yes!
scripts.translation: 哦，好啊！

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
Oh, really?
If you feel tired then it's okay.
Please come again, if you want.
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亚]
哦，是吗？累了就先休息吧。
想继续的话，随时再来。

scripts.text:
[Nyangson]
Please come again~.
scripts.translation:
[喵森]
有空再来哦~

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
I knew you would do this!
I have the right eye for people.
The place is inside of the ship Navi.
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亚]
我就知道你会答应！
我看人的眼光很准。
地点就在纳维号的船舱里。

scripts.text:
[Nyangson]
It will be fine because it isn't really a large place.
I look forward to your active work!
scripts.translation:
[喵森]
地方不大，不用担心。
期待你大显身手！

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
Please find the pieces of the treasure.
The treasure is hidden inside of the ship Navi according to our information.
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亚]
请找出宝藏碎片。
根据我们的情报，它们藏在纳维号船舱里。

scripts.text:
[Nyangson]
Come here right after you find treasure!
scripts.translation:
[喵森]
找到宝藏后马上回来！

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
You've found all the treasure.
Yes, exactly.
You might thought this painting was just a normal painting.
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亚]
你把所有宝藏都找齐了。
没错，就是这些。
你可能以为这只是一幅普通的画。

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
But...!
If we do this...!
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亚]
但是...！
只要我们这样做...！

scripts.text:
[Nyangson]
Oh, this is....... the one from that moment...
This is the one when we left our hometown.
scripts.translation:
[喵森]
哦，这是...那时候的...
这是我们离开故乡时的画面。

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
It's time to give it back to the brave new team!
Let's give it back!
Meow~
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亚]
该把画还给喵之勇气队了！
还给大家吧！
喵~

scripts.text:
Charo and Rosy who make up as Homnya and Nyangson
checked the pieces of painting and give it back again.
They look excited.
scripts.translation:
查罗和罗西扮成霍姆尼亚与喵森，检查了画作碎片后又把它们拼了起来。
他们看起来很兴奋。

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
Please give it back to the Meow Bravery Team~
For everyone~ Meow~
These are real treasures!
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亚]
请把它还给喵之勇气队~
为了大家~喵~
这些才是真正的宝藏！

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
Well? It's strange. There should be 6 pieces of treasure.
It's missing pieces...
Is this fake? I will throw it out!
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亚]
嗯？真奇怪，宝藏应该有六块。
怎么少了几块...
这是假的吧？我要把它扔掉！

scripts.text:
[Nyangson]
Go get the treasure again!
scripts.translation:
[喵森]
再去把宝藏找回来！

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
Please give these treasures you've found to the Meow Bravery Team.
You will know how precious these treasures are when you give these to them~
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亚]
请把找到的宝藏交给喵之勇气队。
交给他们之后，你就会明白这些宝藏有多珍贵~

scripts.text:
[Nyangson]
Yes, you will realize.
It's good to take a break for little bit but now we don't have any spare time.
scripts.translation:
[喵森]
没错，到时你就会明白。
稍微歇会儿也好，不过现在可没时间了。

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
Stop this noisy machine!
Insert your Adventure Card, and take a look at the reaction of the machine carefully. Then do the proper action!
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亚]
先把这台吵闹的机器停下来！
插入冒险卡，仔细观察机器的反应，再采取相应的行动！

scripts.text:
[Nyangson]
That's right~
scripts.translation:
[喵森]
没错~

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
Hey Nyangson.
Here comes the hero.
He seems to be here for fixing this naughty machine.
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亚]
嘿，喵森。
英雄来了。
他好像是来修理这台调皮机器的。

scripts.text:
[Nyangson]
I always admire your keen insight.
He looks like that for sure.
Then he will buy Adventure Card with Malangdo Can?
scripts.translation:
[喵森]
我一直很佩服你敏锐的洞察力。
他看起来确实像是来修机器的。
那他会用绵绵岛罐头买冒险卡吗？

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
You are getting better
I always keep eyes on your keen insight.
You are my true friend.
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亚]
你越来越厉害了。
我一直在留意你敏锐的洞察力。
你是我真正的朋友。

scripts.text: How's the condition of Bang?
scripts.translation: 邦那边怎么样了？

scripts.text: Ignore it.
scripts.translation: 不理它

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
it's so motivated but it's not the time yet.
Not yet even though naughty machine is noisy.
Please come again.
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亚]
它已经跃跃欲试了，不过还没到时候。
机器再吵也不行，现在还不是时候。
过会儿再来吧。

scripts.text:
[Nyangson]
We also have break time.....
scripts.translation:
[喵森]
我们也要休息的...

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
Can you hear how noisy this one is?
It sounds like a runaway foal!
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亚]
听听它有多吵！
简直像匹脱缰的小马！

scripts.text:
[Nyangson]
He needs an Adventure Card to stop it.
Well, do you want to try?
scripts.translation:
[喵森]
要用冒险卡才能让它停下来。
你想试试吗？

scripts.text: Buy Adventure Card B.
scripts.translation: 购买冒险卡B

scripts.text: Don't buy it.
scripts.translation: 不买

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
How many Malangdo Cans for an Adventure Card?
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亚]
一张冒险卡要几个绵绵岛罐头？

scripts.text:
[Nyangson]
Only one can, dear.
Meow~
scripts.translation:
[喵森]
只要一个，亲爱的。
喵~

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
Yes, please try it without blowing it up.
Solve it fast!
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亚]
好，试试吧，别把它弄炸了。
快点解决！

scripts.text:
[Nyangson]
Please do it.
scripts.translation:
[喵森]
拜托你了。

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
Ah... Hey... You can't do that!
Hey, don't go!
Please stop this, Nyangson!
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亚]
啊...喂...你不能这样！
喂，别走！
喵森，快让它停下来！

scripts.text:
[Nyangson]
This and that one are all noisy!
Please!
scripts.translation:
[喵森]
这台和那台都吵死了！
拜托了！

scripts.text: The two young cats are sweating a lot.
scripts.translation: 两只小猫紧张得满头大汗。

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
Ah... Hey... You can't do that!
Hey, don't go!
Please stop this, Nyangson!
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亚]
啊...喂...你不能这样！
喂，别走！
喵森，快让它停下来！

scripts.text:
[Nyangson]
This and that one are all noisy!
Please!
scripts.translation:
[喵森]
这台和那台都吵死了！
拜托了！

scripts.text: The two young cats are sweating a lot.
scripts.translation: 两只小猫紧张得满头大汗。

scripts.text:
[Nyangson]
I am a friend of Detective Homnya, Nyangson.
Please ask Homnya if you have questions.
scripts.translation:
[喵森]
我是侦探霍姆尼亚的朋友喵森。
有问题就问霍姆尼亚吧。

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
Yes, he only goes 'yes, my friend' beside me!
Ask me!
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亚]
没错，他待在我身边就只会说“是的，我的朋友”！
问我吧！

scripts.text:
There is a strange machine.
It has a Red, Blue, Yellow, and Green luminous body with buttons to react,
while spinning with noisy sounds.
scripts.translation:
有一台奇怪的机器。
机身亮着红、蓝、黄、绿四种颜色，旁边有响应按钮；它一边旋转，一边发出刺耳的噪音。

scripts.text: It looks more unstable as it spins faster.
scripts.translation: 它转得越快，看起来就越不稳定。

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
It's so motivated, but it's not time yet.
Not yet, even though the machine is so noisy.
Please come again.
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亚]
它已经跃跃欲试了，不过还没到时候。
机器再吵也不行，现在还不是时候。
过会儿再来吧。

scripts.text:
[Nyangson]
We also have break time...
scripts.translation:
[喵森]
我们也要休息的...

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
You can't try this without Adventure Card B.
Please bring it with you.
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亚]
没有冒险卡B就不能玩这个。
记得带上卡再来。

scripts.text:
There is a strange machine.
It has a Red, Blue, Yellow, and Green luminous body with buttons to react,
while spinning with noisy sounds.
scripts.translation:
有一台奇怪的机器。
机身亮着红、蓝、黄、绿四种颜色，旁边有响应按钮；它一边旋转，一边发出刺耳的噪音。

scripts.text: It looks more unstable as it spins faster.
scripts.translation: 它转得越快，看起来就越不稳定。

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
Stop this machine by inserting the card into it!
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亚]
把卡插进机器里，让它停下来！

scripts.text:
[Nyangson]
Go ahead!
scripts.translation:
[喵森]
开始吧！

scripts.text: Insert card.
scripts.translation: 插入卡片

scripts.text: Stop it.
scripts.translation: 让它停下

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
Um? You aren't going to do this?
Really?
Even though this machine can blow up the whole island?!
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亚]
嗯？你不打算试试吗？
真的吗？
这台机器可是能把整座岛炸飞的啊？！

scripts.text:
[Nyangson]
Does he know it's never going to blow up?
scripts.translation:
[喵森]
他知道这东西根本不会爆炸吗？

scripts.text: The two young cats are sweating a lot.
scripts.translation: 两只小猫紧张得满头大汗。

scripts.text:
After inserting the card, discs on top of the machine spin faster...
The lights begin to flicker faster too.
scripts.translation:
插入卡片后，机器顶部的圆盘转得更快了...
灯光也闪烁得越来越快。

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
Oh, great!
The banging has stopped!
You have a good memory!
Please take this small gift.
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亚]
太好了！
噪音停了！
你的记忆力真好！
请收下这份小礼物。

scripts.text:
[Nyangson]
You can get it after you have been through all the difficulties from the Meow Advanture Team.
And we are not sure if this machine will try to blow up agian, so please come again tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[喵森]
通过喵冒险队设置的所有难关后，你就能拿到奖励。
这台机器明天还会不会想炸掉自己，我们也不确定...明天再来吧。

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
Hey, there is good news for you.
I received pretty good news while you struggled with that machine.
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亚]
嘿，有个好消息告诉你。
你刚才和机器较劲的时候，我收到了好消息。

scripts.text:
[Nyangson]
Hello, capable friend, what did you find?
Is this something like hidden treasure?
scripts.translation:
[喵森]
你好，能干的朋友，有什么发现？
是隐藏的宝藏吗？

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
Hidden treasure?
Very similar!
It will be hidden in serveral places inside the cabin.
You should find them!
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亚]
宝藏？差不多！
有些东西藏在船舱里的几个地方。
快去找找！

scripts.text: I feel tired of it now.
scripts.translation: 我有点累了

scripts.text: Oh, yes!
scripts.translation: 好啊！

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
Oh, really?
If you feel tired then it's okay.
Please come again, if you want.
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亚]
哦，是吗？累了就先休息吧。
想继续的话，随时再来。

scripts.text:
[Nyangson]
Please come again~.
scripts.translation:
[喵森]
有空再来哦~

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
I knew you would do this!
I have the right eye for people.
The place is inside of the ship Navi.
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亚]
我就知道你会答应！
我看人的眼光很准。
东西就在纳维号的船舱里。

scripts.text:
[Nyangson]
It will be fine because it isn't really a large place.
I look forward to your active work!
scripts.translation:
[喵森]
地方不大，不用担心。
期待你大显身手！

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
Then I am looking forward to tomorrow!
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亚]
那我就等你明天来！

scripts.text:
Luminous
The order of buttons are:
[Red] [Green] [Blue] [Yellow]
And below this, more buttons:
[Green] [Red] [Yellow] [Blue]
In that order.
scripts.translation:
发光
按钮亮起的顺序是：
[红] [绿] [蓝] [黄]
接下来下面的按钮会亮起：
[绿] [红] [黄] [蓝]
按这个顺序操作。

scripts.text:
Luminous
{0}
Shines according to this order.
The buttons below are shining now.
Stop the machine by pressing the right button within time.
scripts.translation:
发光
{0}
灯光会按照这个顺序闪烁。
下面的按钮正在发光。
请在时限内按下正确的按钮，停止机器。

scripts.text: Red
scripts.translation: 红

scripts.text: Blue
scripts.translation: 蓝

scripts.translation: 黄

scripts.translation: 绿

scripts.text:
The speed of spinning is getting faster after pressing the buttons.
After all...
scripts.translation:
按下按钮后，圆盘转得越来越快。
最后...

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
Watch out!!!
 
[Nyangson]
It's blowing up!
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亚]
小心！！！

[喵森]
它要爆炸了！

scripts.text:
Adventure Card B burned off
with a huge explosion.
scripts.translation:
冒险卡B
在剧烈爆炸中烧毁了。

scripts.text:
The speed of the spinning discs gets slower after pressing the buttons.
The luminous shines once and stops also.
scripts.translation:
按下按钮后，圆盘转得慢了下来。
灯光闪了一次，也停了。

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
Don't reduce your tension!
It's not over yet!
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亚]
别放松警惕！
还没结束！

scripts.text:
The machine starts again.
And the luminous shines also, as if it keeps asking you for the right answer.
scripts.translation:
机器又启动了。
指示灯也亮了起来，仿佛在催你给出正确答案。

scripts.text: - You have too many items to proceed in this quest. -
scripts.translation: - 物品栏太满，无法继续任务。 -

scripts.text:
{0}
You found a piece of the painting.
scripts.translation:
{0}
你找到了一块画作碎片。

scripts.text:
It looks like you can put these pieces of paintings together.
If I found all the pieces, I should go back to Homnya.
scripts.translation:
这些画作碎片似乎能拼在一起。
找齐之后，应该回去找霍姆尼亚。

scripts.text:
I think this is the treasure Homnya and Nyangson mentioned.
Let's find more pieces.
scripts.translation:
我想这就是霍姆尼亚和喵森提到的宝藏。
再去找些碎片吧。

scripts.text:
[Neat Crew]
What are you doing here?!
Don't touch that box any more!
There will be more bugs if you keep hiding snacks in there!
Get out!
scripts.translation:
[整洁的船员]
你在这里做什么？！
别再碰那个箱子了！
你要是继续把零食藏在里面，虫子只会越来越多！
出去！

scripts.text: A box in the corner of the cabin.
scripts.translation: 船舱角落里有一个箱子。

scripts.text: This is a box which used to contain a piece of the painting.
scripts.translation: 这是一个曾经装着画作碎片的箱子。

scripts.text:
[Neat Crew]
Ah, do not touch it!
Why do you keep messing it up after I clean up the room?!
Get out!
scripts.translation:
[整洁的船员]
啊，别碰！
我刚收拾好房间，你怎么又把它弄乱了？！
出去！

scripts.text: The books are organized according to order on the bookshelf.
scripts.translation: 书架上的书按顺序摆放着。

scripts.text: This is a book which used to contain a piece of the painting.
scripts.translation: 这是一本曾经藏着一块画作碎片的书。

scripts.text:
[Scary Crew]
What are you doing here?
Do not disturb me, and go away.
Get out!
scripts.translation:
[吓人的船员]
你在这里干什么？
别打扰我，走开。
出去！

scripts.text:
It's dirty and smells like fish.
There are a lot of furs from cats.
scripts.translation:
又脏又有股鱼腥味。
上面沾了不少猫毛。

scripts.text:
This is dirty bed where a piece of the painting was hidden.
There are a lot of furs from cats.
scripts.translation:
这张床脏兮兮的，曾经藏着一块画作碎片。
上面沾了不少猫毛。

scripts.text: There is a seashell decoration on a clean display cupboard.
scripts.translation: 干净的陈列柜上摆着一个贝壳装饰。

scripts.text: This is the seashell where a piece of the painting was hidden.
scripts.translation: 这个贝壳曾经藏着一块画作碎片。

scripts.text:
[Picky Crew]
Is that you who scratched all the pillars in here?!
Meow~~~~!!
Get off from that pillar!
scripts.translation:
[挑剔的船员]
是你把这里所有的柱子都抓花了吗？！
喵~~~~！！
快从柱子上下来！

scripts.text:
I can see the trace of a scratch.
Pillars made from trees are originally good to hang, but scratched by nails.
scripts.translation:
上面能看到抓痕。
树木制成的柱子本来很适合攀爬，却被爪子抓花了。

scripts.text: I can see the crack where a piece of the painting was hidden.
scripts.translation: 我能看到那道藏过画作碎片的裂缝。

scripts.text:
There are windows for ventilation on the floor.
A cold wind comes from these windows.
Why are ventilation windows set up on the floor?
scripts.translation:
地板上开着几扇通风窗。
冷风正从窗户里灌进来。
为什么要把通风窗开在地板上？

scripts.text:
There are windows for ventilation on the floor.
A piece of the painting was hung in there.
Why are ventilation windows set up on the floor?
scripts.translation:
地板上开着几扇通风窗。
里面曾挂着一块画作碎片。
为什么要把通风窗开在地板上？

scripts.text:
[Neat Crew]
Please clean up your stuff by yourself.
Especially you guys getting dirty after we came to this island!
Please throw the trash into the trash can.
scripts.translation:
[整洁的船员]
自己的东西请自己收拾好。
尤其是你们，来这座岛之后把周围弄得脏兮兮的！
垃圾请扔进垃圾桶。

scripts.text:
[Neat Crew]
And you plucked every crop.
Hmph. Please, let's leave it in its natural state.
scripts.translation:
[整洁的船员]
你们还把庄稼都摘光了。
哼，拜托了，让它们自然生长吧。

scripts.text:
[Neat Crew]
What are you looking at?
Will you mess up here too?
Meow?!
scripts.translation:
[整洁的船员]
你在看什么？
也打算在这里捣乱吗？
喵？！

scripts.text:
[Scary Crew]
I try to be nice these days, and kids just take liberties with me.
Will you too?
scripts.translation:
[吓人的船员]
我最近才试着和善一点，小鬼们就开始蹬鼻子上脸。
你也想这样吗？

scripts.text:
[Scary Crew]
They just come in and out, even the other person's room...
It causes harm for sure.
scripts.translation:
[吓人的船员]
他们进进出出，连别人的房间也照闯不误……
这肯定会惹出麻烦。

scripts.text:
[Picky Crew]
Do not run in the hall!
My fur falls out because of someone who
scratches everywhere!
scripts.translation:
[挑剔的船员]
别在走廊里跑！
不知道是谁到处乱抓，害得我掉了一地毛！

scripts.text: Your inventory is too heavy to proceed. Come back after lightening your load.
scripts.translation: 你的负重过高，无法继续。请减轻负重后再来。

scripts.text: Your inventory is too full to proceed. Come back after reducing your load.
scripts.translation: 你的背包已满，无法继续。请整理背包后再来。

scripts.text: A gentle looking cat is whispering to himself.
scripts.translation: 一只看起来温和的猫正在低声自语。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hello... Mr. Cat...
The cat takes a glance at you and goes back to his whispering as if he didn't even see you.
scripts.translation: 那只猫瞥了你一眼，随后像是没看见你似的，继续低声自语。

scripts.text: It seems you are not being considered worth talking to.
scripts.translation: 看来他并不打算理你。

scripts.text: A gentle looking cat is whispering to himself.
scripts.translation: 一只看起来温和的猫正在低声自语。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Man! 10 losses in a row...
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家协会负责人]
天啊……已经连输十场了……

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
We are the 'Cat Gamers' Association.
But, we still keep on losing and we have no idea why!
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家协会负责人]
我们是“猫玩家”协会。
可我们一直输，完全不知道原因！

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
We've got to find out the reason for this losing streak.
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家协会负责人]
我们得查清楚连败的原因。

scripts.text: You are getting interested in the cat's story. Let's hear more.
scripts.translation: 你对这只猫讲的事有些好奇，决定继续听下去。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
The reason, yes!
This can be one of them.
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家协会负责人]
原因，对！
这可能就是其中一个原因。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
^DD2234Giving up so many points!^000000
That's right. No matter how much you score,
we will still lose if we give up so many points.
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家协会负责人]
^DD2234丢了这么多分！^000000
没错。无论得多少分，
丢掉这么多分的话，我们还是会输。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
For the other reason. Hmm!
This could be related with the previous reason.
No ^DD2234aggresive point betting^000000 at all.
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家协会负责人]
至于另一个原因……嗯！
这或许和刚才说的原因有关。
完全没有^DD2234积极下注^000000。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Other teams bet on games that they think will win, and bet low when they are not confident.
I guess we didn't know that.
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家协会负责人]
其他队伍会给看好的比赛下重注，没把握时就少下注。
看来我们之前没意识到这一点。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Hmm, can this be a reason?
For some reason there were ^DD2234players disappearing right before the match up^000000 and I guess this could have effected our game spirit.
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家协会负责人]
嗯，这也可能是原因吗？
不知为何，^DD2234有些选手总在比赛开始前消失^000000，我猜这可能打击了大家的士气。

[猫玩家协会负责人]
嗯……看来我们连败的原因是：
丢分太多；
下注太保守；
还有选手消失？

scripts.text: It seems like the gentle looking cat has finished thinking. Let's interrupt the conversion.
scripts.translation: 那只看起来温和的猫似乎已经想完了。我们打断这场谈话吧。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Now that I know the reason,
there should be a solution to that.
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家协会负责人]
既然知道了原因，
就一定有办法解决。

scripts.text: Umm... Mr. Cat...
scripts.translation: 那个……猫先生……

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Who's there? Human? You are a human?
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家协会负责人]
谁在那里？人类？你是人类？

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
... ... ... ...
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家协会负责人]
……

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Oh! Yes! Right!
I remember hearing that
humans have started passing through here recently.
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家协会负责人]
哦！对！没错！
我记得最近听说，
人类开始经过这里了。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
So good to see you!!
What is your name by the way?
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家协会负责人]
见到你真高兴！！
对了，你叫什么名字？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
My name is {1}, Mr. Cat.

[Cat Gamers Director]
Oh, ^0000FF{0}^000000.
How may I help you?
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家协会负责人]
哦，^0000FF{0}^000000。
有什么事吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Actually I wanted to help you out since I heard that you've lost 10 games in a row...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
其实，我听说你们已经连输十场了，所以想来帮帮你们……

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Well, you didn't really have to point it out like that...
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家协会负责人]
哎呀，你也不必说得这么直白吧……

scripts.text:
[{0}]
A weakness is no longer a weakness when you say it out loud.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
弱点只要说出口，就不再是弱点了。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Hahahaha I like that phrase.
I should remember it and
tell it to my kids. Heh~
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家协会负责人]
哈哈哈，我喜欢这句话。
我得记下来，
讲给孩子们听。嘿嘿～

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
I like you, {0} {1}. Will you help us get out of this 10 game losing streak? Ehehe~
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家协会负责人]
我挺喜欢你的，{0} {1}。能帮我们结束十连败吗？嘿嘿～

scripts.text: Sorry, I'm a stupid {0}.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我是个愚蠢的{0}。

scripts.text: Sure, I'm a cool {0}.
scripts.translation: 当然，我是个很酷的{0}。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Guess I was wrong about you~
How can a person call themself stupid.
Now I can see how stupid you are.
Good bye~
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家协会负责人]
看来是我看错你了～
哪有人会说自己很蠢呢？
现在我知道你有多蠢了。
再见～

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Wow. I respect you, {0}.
Let me ask you a favor.
Please meet the hard working Manager Cat and ask about our team's attitude these days.
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家协会负责人]
哇，我很佩服你，{0}。
能拜托你一件事吗？
请去找那位勤勉的猫管理员，问问我们队最近的状态。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
The Manager Cat must be around here somewhere~
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家协会负责人]
猫管理员应该就在这附近～

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Please meet the hard working
Manager Cat, and ask about our team's attitude these days.
The Manager Cat must be around here somewhere~
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家协会负责人]
请去找那位勤勉的猫管理员，
问问我们队最近的状态。
他应该就在这附近～

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Ok Ok. So what did the manager cat say about the atmosphere these days?~
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家协会负责人]
好，好。那么猫管理员怎么说？最近队里的气氛怎么样？～

scripts.text: You tell him exactly what the Manager Cat said.
scripts.translation: 你把猫管理员的话一字不漏地转告给他。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The manager cat said...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
猫管理员说……

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Do not hesitate... Just tell me everything~
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家协会负责人]
别犹豫……全都告诉我吧～

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Umm... the player cats are afraid of you...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
呃……那些猫玩家都很怕你……

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
What... What did you say?
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家协会负责人]
什……你说什么？

scripts.text: Cat Gamers Director seems to be in shock. Let's give him some time to calm down.
scripts.translation: 猫玩家协会负责人似乎大受打击。让他先冷静一会儿吧。

scripts.text: Cat Gamers Director seems to be in shock. Let's give him some time to calm down.
scripts.translation: 猫玩家协会负责人似乎大受打击。让他先冷静一会儿吧。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
That is impossible!
There is no other cat that's nicer than I am!
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家协会负责人]
这不可能！
没有比我更和善的猫了！

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Am I really that scary?
Are those players who bailed on the practice afraid of me too?
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家协会负责人]
我真的有那么可怕吗？
那些缺席训练的选手，也是因为怕我才不来的吗？

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
It can't be, right? ehehehehe~
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家协会负责人]
不会吧？嘿嘿嘿嘿～

scripts.text: - He laughs nervously. -
scripts.translation: - 他紧张地笑了起来。 -

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Is that the truth?
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家协会负责人]
这是真的吗？

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
{0}, will you help me out?

scripts.translation:
[猫玩家协会负责人]
{0}，你能帮帮我吗？

你能帮我查查他们是不是因为我才逃走的吗？嘿嘿～

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Their names are Eryu, Stew, Ketchup, and Eff.
They've got to be somewhere around here.
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家协会负责人]
他们叫埃留、斯图、番茄酱和埃夫。
他们应该就在这附近。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Please find them all~
But, don't ask too directly! Ok?
Just ask them gentle questions~
Ok? Be! Gentle!
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家协会负责人]
请把他们都找出来～
不过别问得太直接！好吗？
温和地问问就好～
知道了吗？一定要！温柔！

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
I appreciate your help, {0}. heh~
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家协会负责人]
多谢你帮忙，{0}。嘿嘿～

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ It seems some humans are scamming cats around this town.
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家协会负责人]
嘿嘿～看来有些人类在镇上欺骗猫咪。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
What good is it to scam innocent cats?~
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家协会负责人]
欺骗无辜的猫咪能有什么好处呢？～

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, I think that you're right.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是啊，我也觉得你说得对。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Oh, so you met Eryu, Stew, Ketchup, and Eff.
It is so good to see you again. Heh~
Thank you very much for your effort~. Heh~
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家协会负责人]
哦，原来你见过埃留、斯图、番茄酱和埃夫了。
很高兴再次见到你。嘿嘿～
辛苦你了，非常感谢～嘿嘿～

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
So what did they say?
They really think I am scary?
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家协会负责人]
那他们怎么说？
他们真的觉得我很可怕吗？

scripts.text: You tell the Cat Gamers Director what Eryu, Stew, Ketchup, and Eff said.
scripts.translation: 你把埃留、斯图、番茄酱和埃夫的话转告给猫玩家协会负责人。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
They think you push them too much through the practices. So they are scared.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
他们觉得你训练时逼得太紧，所以很怕你。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
What? Really?
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家协会负责人]
什么？真的吗？

scripts.text: The Cat Gamers Director seems to be shocked once again. Better give him more time to calm down.
scripts.translation: 猫玩家协会负责人似乎又受到了打击。最好再给他一些时间冷静。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Their names are Eryu, Stew, Ketchup, and Eff.
They've got to be somewhere around here.
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家协会负责人]
他们叫埃留、斯图、番茄酱和埃夫。
他们应该就在这附近。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Please find them all~
But, don't ask too directly! Ok?
Just ask them gentle questions~
Ok? Be! Gentle!
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家协会负责人]
请把他们都找出来～
不过别问得太直接！好吗？
温和地问问就好～
知道了吗？一定要！温柔！

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
I appreciate your help, {0}. heh~
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家协会负责人]
多谢你帮忙，{0}。嘿嘿～

scripts.text: Cat Gamers Director seems to be in shock once again. Better give more time to calm down.
scripts.translation: 猫玩家协会负责人似乎又受到了打击。最好多给他一些时间冷静。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Ok, I understand.
I was a scary cat after all.
This can't be right!! Heh~
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家协会负责人]
好吧，我明白了。
看来我确实是只可怕的猫。
不对吧！！嘿嘿～

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
I need to change my scary cat image. Heh~
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家协会负责人]
我得改变大家对我这只可怕猫的印象。嘿嘿～

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
This is my mission now,
so our team can improve
game performance. Heh~
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家协会负责人]
这是我现在的使命，
这样才能提升我们队伍的
比赛表现。嘿嘿～

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Please go meet our manager cat,
and find out how can I change
this scary cat image of mine. Heh~
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家协会负责人]
请去找我们的猫管理员，
问问我该怎么改变
大家对我这只可怕猫的印象。嘿嘿～

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ I would much appreciate your help, {0}~.
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家协会负责人]
嘿嘿～要是你能帮忙，{0}，我就太感激了～

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Please ask our manager cat how can I change this scary cat image.
Heh~
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家协会负责人]
请去问问我们的猫管理员，我该怎么改变大家对我这只可怕猫的印象。
嘿嘿～

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ Please help me out,
{0}! Heh~
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家协会负责人]
嘿嘿～拜托你帮帮我，
{0}！嘿嘿～

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
You came back!! Heh~
So, what did our manager cat say?
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家协会负责人]
你回来了！！嘿嘿～
那么，我们的猫管理员怎么说？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Manager cat asked to prepare a box.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
猫管理员让我准备一个箱子。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
A box? Heh~ Sure, why not?
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家协会负责人]
箱子？嘿嘿～行啊，为什么不呢？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Are you going to ask me what is it for?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你不问问箱子是做什么用的吗？

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Well, I kind of was eavesdropping when {0} and Manager Cat were talking together. Heh~
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家协会负责人]
刚才{0}和猫管理员说话时，我有点在偷听。嘿嘿～

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Now I need to check with our players, see how they really feel.
Heh~ Why don't you come back tomorrow?
Heh~ Let me decide what to do after checking their honest petition letters. Heh~
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家协会负责人]
现在我得问问队员们，听听他们真正的想法。
嘿嘿～你明天再来吧？
等我看完大家真心写下的请愿信，再决定下一步怎么做。嘿嘿～

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Still receiving petition letters. Heh~
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家协会负责人]
请愿信还在陆续送来。嘿嘿～

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
I wonder what they really want to say~ Heh~
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家协会负责人]
真想知道他们到底想说什么～嘿嘿～

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ All done with collecting petition letters~
Heh~ Let's see what they wrote here?
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家协会负责人]
嘿嘿～请愿信都收齐了～
来看看他们写了什么吧？嘿嘿～

scripts.text: Reading...~
scripts.translation: 正在阅读……～

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ Let me see... 'Stupid Cat lea...de...'
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家协会负责人]
嘿嘿～我看看……“笨猫队长……”

scripts.text:
- Crumpling the paper -
Cat Gamers Director has crumpled the paper and thrown it away.
scripts.translation:
- 把纸揉成一团 -
猫玩家协会负责人把纸揉成一团，扔到了一边。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ Wrong paper.
Let's read another one... Heh~
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家协会负责人]
嘿嘿～拿错了。
再读一封吧……嘿嘿～

scripts.text: ~Reading~
scripts.translation: ～阅读中～

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ Here we go.
'I don't like playing with the same team members over and over.
Please pick new team members,
or get me a practicing partner.'
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家协会负责人]
嘿嘿～找到了。
“我不喜欢总是和同一批队员一起玩。
请换些新队员，
或者给我找个练习搭档。”

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ I see.
I can take this positively.
Heh~ Let's move on to another one.
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家协会负责人]
嘿嘿～我知道了。
这意见倒是挺积极的。
嘿嘿～再看下一封吧。

scripts.text: ~Reading~
scripts.translation: ～阅读中～

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~
'We need more snacks~ Get us some more snacks~'
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家协会负责人]
嘿嘿～
“我们还想要更多零食～再给我们一些零食吧～”

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ This one also sounds productive.
Heh~ Petition letters are good, I guess... Heh~
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家协会负责人]
嘿嘿～这封也挺有建设性。
看来请愿信确实有用……嘿嘿～

scripts.text: Reading...~
scripts.translation: 正在阅读……～

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~
'Elders are bullying me. Help me...'
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家协会负责人]
嘿嘿～
“长老们在欺负我。救救我……”

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ Our team is absolutely
like a family here~ Someone is
playing here, you know. Heh~
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家协会负责人]
嘿嘿～看来我们队真的像一家人一样呢～毕竟队里也有人在玩恶作剧嘛。嘿嘿～

scripts.text: Reading...~
scripts.translation: 正在阅读……～

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ There are only 4 letters!

Heh~
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家协会负责人]
嘿嘿～一共只有四封信！
其中还有一封是恶作剧……
嘿嘿～

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Everyone seems to have a satisfied team life~ Heh~
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家协会负责人]
看来大家对队里的生活都挺满意嘛～嘿嘿～

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Not... Really...
There are tons of letters piled in the back of the box, but Cat Gamers Director doesn't want to admit the problem.
scripts.translation: 箱子后面还堆着一大摞信，但猫玩家协会负责人不愿承认有问题。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~
Hey, {0}. What did you say? Heh~
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家协会负责人]
嘿嘿～
喂，{0}。你刚才说什么？嘿嘿～

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Nothing! Please carry on.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
没什么！您继续。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ Because of what these players want,
I have a favor to ask you, {0}...
Heh~
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家协会负责人]
嘿嘿～队员们有这些要求，我想请你帮个忙，{0}……
嘿嘿～

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What is it?

[Cat Gamers Director]
Will you be our players' practicing partner?
Heh~ I feel strongly that you, {0}, can be trusted for this. Heh~
scripts.translation:
[猫玩家协会负责人]
