scripts.translation:
[奇怪的猫]
喵～喵呜～嗷嗷～喵呜喵～嗷嗷～

scripts.text: Some strange cat is here.
scripts.translation: 这里有一只奇怪的猫。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
Meow~ Meo~ Ow Ow~ Meow Meo~ Eow Eow~
scripts.translation:
[猫管理员]
喵～喵呜～嗷嗷～喵呜喵～嗷嗷～

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
What do you want?
scripts.translation:
[猫管理员]
你想做什么？

scripts.text: Ask about the team's attitude...
scripts.translation: 询问队伍的状况……

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
Do not lie to me! How can I trust you and reveal our team secret? Aren't you a spy from the doggy team?
scripts.translation:
[猫管理员]
别骗我！我怎么能相信你，把队伍的秘密告诉你？你是狗队派来的间谍吧？

scripts.text: Aww, come on...
scripts.translation: 哎呀，拜托……

scripts.text: You play with a foxtail nearby and then ask again.
scripts.translation: 你在附近拿着猫尾草逗猫玩，然后再问一次。

scripts.text: Cat Gamers Director says...
scripts.translation: 猫玩家协会负责人说……

scripts.text: The Manager Cat seems to be interested in the foxtail and starts answering.
scripts.translation: 猫管理员似乎对猫尾草很感兴趣，开始回答你的问题。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
Players are afraid of the Cat Gamers Director. When they see Cat Gamers Director at the game, they get nervous.
scripts.translation:
[猫管理员]
队员们都怕猫玩家协会负责人。只要他出现在比赛现场，大家就会紧张起来。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
Can you give me that?
scripts.translation:
[猫管理员]
那个能给我吗？

scripts.text: You hand the foxtail to the Manager Cat. Go back to the Cat Gamers Director.
scripts.translation: 你把猫尾草递给猫管理员，然后返回猫玩家协会负责人那里。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
Don't lie to me!
Why should I trust you,
and give our team information?
Aren't you a spy from doggy team...?
Go away.
scripts.translation:
[猫管理员]
别骗我！
我为什么要相信你，
把队伍的情报告诉你？
你是狗队派来的间谍吧……？
走开。

scripts.text: This cat might hit you.
scripts.translation: 这只猫可能会揍你。

scripts.text:
The Manager Cat is playing with the foxtail you gave him.
He seems to be liking it...
scripts.translation:
猫管理员正在玩你给他的猫尾草。
他似乎很喜欢……

scripts.text:
The Manager Cat is playing with the foxtail you gave him.
He seems to be liking it...
scripts.translation:
猫管理员正在玩你给他的猫尾草。
他似乎很喜欢……

scripts.text: Help~ Fire~
scripts.translation: 救命～着火了～

scripts.text: Hey~!
Do you want to hear something?
scripts.translation: 想听点什么吗？

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
Don't lie~ We don't use fire that much~
scripts.translation:
[猫管理员]
别骗人～我们没怎么用火～

scripts.text: The Manager Cat ignores you, and keeps on playing with the foxtail.
scripts.translation: 猫管理员没有理你，继续玩着猫尾草。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
Meow~ I want to tell you a story~ Follow me meow~ Let talk over there, meow~
scripts.translation:
[猫管理员]
喵～我想给你讲个故事～跟我来，喵～我们去那边聊，喵～

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Haha, I was just kidding. I actually need to tell you that the Cat Gamers Director has an issue...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哈哈，我开玩笑的。其实我得告诉你，猫玩家协会负责人遇到点麻烦……

scripts.text: You explain the story to the Manager Cat.
scripts.translation: 你把事情经过告诉了猫管理员。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
Scary image... Meow, I understand... Cat Gamers Director should feel peace by giving up things.
scripts.translation:
[猫管理员]
可怕的形象……喵，我明白了……让猫玩家协会负责人放下一些执念，心里就能平静下来。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
Meow! Go tell him this, meow~ Prepare a box, meow~
scripts.translation:
[猫管理员]
喵！把这个办法告诉他，喵～准备一个箱子，喵～

scripts.text:
[{0}]
A box?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
一个箱子？

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
Petition it is, meow!! There is some place where humans do such things, I think it will help us~
scripts.translation:
[猫管理员]
就是请愿箱，喵！！我记得人类有地方会这么做，应该能帮上忙～

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ok, I will go tell it to the Games Director~
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好，我这就去告诉猫玩家协会负责人～

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
You tell the Cat Gamers Director to prepare a Box for sure!~ I will tell this to my team, meow.
scripts.translation:
[猫管理员]
你一定要告诉猫玩家协会负责人准备一个箱子！～我会把这事告诉队员们，喵。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
The players are excited and writing a bunch of things for the petition box... I wonder what they are writing.
scripts.translation:
[猫管理员]
队员们正兴奋地往请愿箱里写东西呢……真想知道他们都写了什么。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
You won't help practice? If you help, the Cat Gamers Director will give you food cans... Please reconsider!
scripts.translation:
[猫管理员]
你不愿意帮忙训练吗？你来帮忙的话，猫玩家协会负责人会给你罐头……请再考虑一下！

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
Meow~ Aren't you {0}? I heard Cat Gamers Director ordered a special certificate, meow~
scripts.translation:
[猫管理员]
喵～你是{0}吧？我听说猫玩家协会负责人订做了一张特别的证书，喵～

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
When practicing, you must equip the '^0000FFCat Gamers Certificate^000000' item~ Don't forget, meow~
scripts.translation:
[猫管理员]
训练时必须装备“^0000FF猫玩家证书^000000”喔～别忘了，喵～

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
This is not possible. Please contact an administrator.
scripts.translation:
[猫管理员]
这不可能。请联系管理员。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
What do you want meow?
scripts.translation:
[猫管理员]
你想做什么，喵？

scripts.text: Hi.
scripts.translation: 你好。

scripts.text: Any news?
scripts.translation: 有什么新消息吗？

scripts.text: Help me with playing.
scripts.translation: 帮我练习游戏。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
Oh, hi meow~
scripts.translation:
[猫管理员]
哦，你好呀，喵～

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
I tell you this meow~ You don't know Cat Gamers Director's feeling meow~.
scripts.translation:
[猫管理员]
我告诉你吧，喵～你不了解猫玩家协会负责人的心情，喵～

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
lol? >> Curious, Admire
Heh~ >> Normal
lol Heh~ >> Happy
lol lol Heh~ >> Crazy meow
scripts.translation:
[猫管理员]
哈哈？ >> 好奇、羡慕
嘿嘿～ >> 普通
哈哈，嘿嘿～ >> 开心
哈哈哈哈，嘿嘿～ >> 疯狂，喵

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
But, why are you asking me meow? Strange meow...
scripts.translation:
[猫管理员]
不过，你为什么问我呢，喵？真奇怪，喵……

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
Some cats use 'meow meow' like me when talking, but some don't.
scripts.translation:
[猫管理员]
有些猫说话时会像我一样“喵喵”叫，但也有些猫不会。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
Cats don't have an honorific phrase, so don't get us wrong as looking down on you meow.~
scripts.translation:
[猫管理员]
猫没有敬语，所以别误会我们是在看不起你，喵～

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
You should walk around many places and ask for information meow... But, don't bother me please meow~
scripts.translation:
[猫管理员]
你应该到处走走，打听些消息，喵……不过请别来烦我，喵～

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
No easy way for that... I just breathe meow...
scripts.translation:
[猫管理员]
这种事没有捷径……我只要呼吸就行了，喵……

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
What game do you want to play?
'Cat Gamers' has players for 4 types of games meow~
The Cat Gamers Director said he will challenge other games later~
scripts.translation:
[猫管理员]
你想玩什么游戏？
“猫玩家”协会里有四种游戏的选手，喵～
协会负责人说以后还会挑战其他游戏，喵～

scripts.text: Rock Paper Scissors
scripts.translation: 石头剪刀布

scripts.text: KongNyangKong
scripts.translation: 碰拳猜方向

scripts.text: ChamChamCham
scripts.translation: 猜猜看

scripts.text: Flag Game
scripts.translation: 夺旗

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
Rock Paper Scissors meow? Nothing special...
scripts.translation:
[猫管理员]
石头剪刀布吗，喵？没什么特别的……

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
Scissor beats Paper, meow.
Rock beats Scissors, meow.
Paper beats Rock, meow.
These are basic rules.
scripts.translation:
[猫管理员]
剪刀胜布，喵。
石头胜剪刀，喵。
布胜石头，喵。
这就是基本规则。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
You play 5 Rock Paper Scissors games with player cats meow.
You play again when you are even meow.
scripts.translation:
[猫管理员]
你要和猫玩家对战五局石头剪刀布，喵。
平局的话就重赛，喵。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
You can get a present after 3 times of winning meow.
And you get a big present when you win all 5 matches, meow!!
scripts.translation:
[猫管理员]
赢三局就能拿到礼物，喵。
五局全胜的话，还有大奖，喵！！

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
Find Paa or Ser if you want to play the Rock Paper Scissors game.
scripts.translation:
[猫管理员]
想玩石头剪刀布的话，就去找帕阿或塞尔。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
KongNyangKong is not an easy game meow.
scripts.translation:
[猫管理员]
碰拳猜方向可不是简单的游戏，喵。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
When attacking, face your hand the same direction as the opponent meow.
scripts.translation:
[猫管理员]
进攻时，手势要和对手的方向相同，喵。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
When defending, you should face your hand the opposite direction from the opponent meow.
scripts.translation:
[猫管理员]
防守时，手势要和对手的方向相反，喵。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
If the attack is a success, you can keep on attacking.
But, if you fail, you have to defend meow.
scripts.translation:
[猫管理员]
进攻成功就能继续攻击。
如果失败，就得转为防守，喵。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
If you be careful, you can win without getting hit at all meow.
scripts.translation:
[猫管理员]
只要小心应对，甚至可以不受伤就赢，喵。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
Once you make your opponent's HP 0, you win meow.
Of course there will be a present meow.
Good luck meow.
scripts.translation:
[猫管理员]
把对手的HP降到0就算获胜，喵。
当然也有礼物拿，喵。
祝你好运，喵。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
Oh~ right meow~!! Find KungKung if you want to play KongNyangKong.
scripts.translation:
[猫管理员]
哦，对了，喵～想玩碰拳猜方向的话，就去找孔孔。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
ChamChamCham is a high level mind game meow.
scripts.translation:
[猫管理员]
猜猜看是高阶的心理战，喵。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
The rules are simple, but you need to think a lot meow.
scripts.translation:
[猫管理员]
规则很简单，但得多动脑筋，喵。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
You should direct your hand to where the cat turns its face meow.
scripts.translation:
[猫管理员]
你要把手指向猫转头的方向，喵。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
A present is given for 3 wins in a row meow.
The more wins, the more presents meow.
scripts.translation:
[猫管理员]
连续赢三次就能拿到礼物，喵。
赢得越多，礼物也越多，喵。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
Kuka is smart, and remembers players with many wins meow.
There will be more presents when you take 1st place meow.
scripts.translation:
[猫管理员]
库卡很聪明，会记住赢过很多次的玩家，喵。
拿到第一名的话，礼物会更多，喵。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
Flag Game is way harder than ChamChamCham game meow.
Really~ Really~ Really~
hard mind game meow.
It's 1,000 times harder meow.
scripts.translation:
[猫管理员]
夺旗比猜猜看难得多，喵。
真的～真的～真的～
是场烧脑的心理战，喵。
难上一千倍，喵。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
You get 5 Flag Point when starting meow.
1 point goes away when you wave the flag once meow.
scripts.translation:
[猫管理员]
开始时你有五点旗分，喵。
每挥一次旗就会扣一点，喵。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
You win the game when no other cats are waving flags meow.
scripts.translation:
[猫管理员]
其他猫都不挥旗时，你就赢了，喵。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
You can predict if other cats will wave their flags or not meow.
By looking at their actions meow.
scripts.translation:
[猫管理员]
观察其他猫的行动，
就能预测它们会不会挥旗，喵。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
You must win to get presents meow.
You will get more presents since this is hard game meow~
scripts.translation:
[猫管理员]
必须获胜才能拿到礼物，喵。
这游戏很难，所以获胜后能拿更多礼物，喵～

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
If you want to play Flag Game meow~
Go find the other manager cat who is trying to get the Referee Certificate meow.
scripts.translation:
[猫管理员]
想玩夺旗的话，喵～
就去找另一位正在考取裁判证的猫管理员，喵。

scripts.text: Your inventory is too heavy to proceed. Come back after lightening your load.
scripts.translation: 你的负重过高，无法继续。请减轻负重后再来。

scripts.text: Your inventory is too full to proceed. Come back after reducing your load.
scripts.translation: 你的背包已满，无法继续。请整理背包后再来。

scripts.text: You found Eryu the cat, and start talking.
scripts.translation: 你找到了猫咪埃留，便上前搭话。

scripts.text:
[Eryu]
Umm... Who are you?
scripts.translation:
[埃留]
呃……你是谁？

scripts.text: The Games Director sent me.
scripts.translation: 协会负责人派我来的。

scripts.text: I am a writer for the 'Human' magazine.
scripts.translation: 我是《人类》杂志的撰稿人。

scripts.text: Who are you?
scripts.translation: 你是谁？

scripts.text:
[Eryu]
Arrgg. Go away...
I don't know who you're talking about.
scripts.translation:
[埃留]
啊……走开……
我不知道你在说谁。

scripts.text:
[Eryu]
Umm? 'Human' magazine?
Is there such a thing?
scripts.translation:
[埃留]
嗯？《人类》杂志？
真有这种东西吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
We've been publishing for 10 years.
But, I guess it is possible for cats to not know who we are.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我们已经发行十年了。
不过猫咪不知道我们，倒也不奇怪。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
We are a really famous magazine throughout the World!
Don't you believe me?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我们可是风靡全世界的知名杂志！
你不信吗？

scripts.text:
[Eryu]
Hmm... ok. But, what can I do for you?
scripts.translation:
[埃留]
嗯……好吧。你找我有什么事？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I am in the middle of writing an article named 'Game Playing Cats'...'
It is a special piece for me.
And some team named umm... do... umm... wal... not sure...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我正在写一篇题为《爱玩游戏的猫》的报道……
这篇报道对我意义非凡。
还有个队伍叫……嗯……狗……嗯……华尔……我记不太清了……

scripts.text:
[Eryu]
'Dog n Waltz'?
scripts.translation:
[埃留]
“狗与华尔兹”？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh! Yes!
One of players there 'Dog n Waltz' has recommended Eryu for an interview.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哦！没错！
“狗与华尔兹”队里有人推荐我来采访埃留。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
He says you are a really good player who can help me with the article.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
他说你是位很出色的玩家，能帮我完成这篇报道。

scripts.text:
[Eryu]
I don't remember anyone from 'Dog n Waltz' that much.
scripts.translation:
[埃留]
我不太记得“狗与华尔兹”队里的人了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The person isn't important.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那个人不重要。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Just answer a few questions for me, ok?
Be yourself and you'll do just fine.
Ok, first question: How much do you practice a day?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
只要回答我几个问题，好吗？
照实回答就行。
第一个问题：你每天练习多久？

scripts.text:
[Eryu]
Usually for about 8 hours, but I have to tell you that I'm not on the team anymore...
scripts.translation:
[埃留]
通常练八个小时左右。不过我得告诉你，我已经不在队里了……

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Wait, what?
You are not with the team now? How come...?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
等等，什么？
你现在不在队里了？怎么回事……？

scripts.text:
[Eryu]
Well...
The Director Cat was too scary...
I was very sick and had to take a day off...
Just one freaking day...
scripts.translation:
[埃留]
唉……
协会负责人实在太吓人了……
有一次我病得很重，只好请了一天假……
就一天而已啊……

scripts.text:
[Eryu]
And then the Director Cat was raging at me!
scripts.translation:
[埃留]
结果协会负责人冲我大发雷霆！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hmm, sounds pretty rough.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，听起来真不好受。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
'Cat Gamers' has lost another great player.
I'm sorry to hear that you're not on the team anymore.
I guess this is the end of the interview.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
“猫玩家”又失去了一位优秀选手。
听说你已经离队，我也很遗憾。
看来采访只能到此为止了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Because this is for current players only.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这次采访只面向现役选手。

scripts.text:
[Eryu]
Oh...
Sorry to make you waste your time.
scripts.translation:
[埃留]
哦……
害你白跑一趟了，抱歉。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, don't worry.
I should say sorry for taking up your precious time.
Have a nice day.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
没关系。该道歉的是我，占用了你宝贵的时间。
祝你今天愉快。

scripts.text:
You found out the reason why Eryu left the team.
Time to go find the other cats.
scripts.translation:
你弄清了埃留离队的原因。
该去找其他猫咪了。

scripts.text:
[Eryu]
Yes, I am Eryu! What do you want, huh, meow~
scripts.translation:
[埃留]
没错，我就是埃留！找我有什么事，喵～

scripts.text:
[Eryu]
Aren't you the magazine writer?
What brings you here again...?
scripts.translation:
[埃留]
你不是那个杂志记者吗？
怎么又回来了……？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ah!
Sorry, I was trying to interview another cat...
And came back to you by mistake.
I'm sorry.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
啊！
抱歉，我本来要去采访另一只猫……
结果不小心又走到你这里了。
不好意思。

scripts.text:
[Eryu]
Ah... I see. Take care of yourself.
scripts.translation:
[埃留]
啊……我知道了。路上小心。

scripts.text:
[Eryu]
This is not possible. Please contact an administrator.
scripts.translation:
[埃留]
这不可能。请联系管理员。

scripts.text:
[Eryu]
Who are you?
scripts.translation:
[埃留]
你是谁？

scripts.text: What do you want to say?
scripts.translation: 你想说什么？

scripts.text:
[Eryu]
What is this? What do you mean by '{0}'...?
Ah... aren't you the writer?

scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你可以贷款啊！！
这可是稳赚一百倍的买卖！！
这么好的机会怎么能错过？
无论如何都要想办法投资！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You know what..? They say some careers like pro gamers can get solid loans.
Like about 1,000 can loan at once.
Without a high interest rate!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你知道吗……听说有些职业，比如职业玩家，很容易拿到贷款。
一次大约能贷一千罐。
而且利息还不高！

scripts.text:
[Eff]
Meow!! 1... 1,000...
Moew~ I am a Pro Gamer.
Meow~ But, I quit~ Meow~
scripts.translation:
[埃夫]
喵！！一……一千……
喵～我以前是职业玩家。
喵～不过我已经退役了～喵～

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What!! Why would you quit such good a gig!! Are you crazy?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
什么？！这么好的工作，你为什么要辞掉？！你疯了吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Let's say we invest 1,000 cans after getting that loan.
One, Ten, Hundred, Tousand. Woot!
I can't believe this.
The result will be 100,000 cans, 100,000!!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
假设贷款后投进一千罐。
一、十、百、千……哇！
简直不敢相信。
最后能变成十万罐，整整十万罐！！

[埃夫]
一……十万罐……喵～

scripts.text:
[{0}]
So tell me... Why did you quit such a great job?
Why?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
告诉我……你为什么要放弃这么好的工作？
为什么？

scripts.text:
[Eff]
I was afraid of the Director Cat there...
Meow~ This one time, I had to take a sick day.
Meow~ And I haven't seen such scary cat my entire life...
scripts.translation:
[埃夫]
我怕那里的猫玩家协会负责人……
喵～有一次我病了，只好请一天假。
喵～我这辈子没见过那么吓人的猫……

scripts.text:
[{0}]
So you quit because Cat Gamers Director was so scary. Hmm, sorry but I can't let you in on this investment...
I guess... What a waste of time!
Good bye!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
所以你是因为猫玩家协会负责人太吓人，才退队的。嗯……抱歉，这样我就不能让你参与投资了……
唉……真是浪费时间！
再见！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh and don't tell anyone what I just told you!
Bye~
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
对了，刚才我告诉你的事，千万别告诉别人！
再见～

scripts.text:
You found out why Eff has left the team.
Now, let's find the other cats.
scripts.translation:
你弄清了埃夫离队的原因。
现在去找其他猫咪吧。

scripts.text:
[Eff]
Yes. I am a cat.
Meow~ Do you think I am a dog?
Meow~ You are a strange human. Meow~
scripts.translation:
[埃夫]
没错，我是猫。
喵～你以为我是狗吗？
喵～你这人类真奇怪，喵～

scripts.text:
[Eff]
Seeing as this is like the first time I met you.
I'll forgive you today. Meow.
Meow~ Don't even think about bringing up that name to me again...
scripts.translation:
[埃夫]
就当今天是我们第一次见面吧。
今天我就原谅你，喵。
喵～以后别再跟我提起那个名字了……

scripts.text:
[Eff]
You are--!!
Meow~ I want to invest. Meow~
scripts.translation:
[埃夫]
你是——！！
喵～我想投资，喵～

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Not without the cans you can't!!
You didn't tell anyone about this deal, right?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
没带罐头可不行！！
你没把这笔交易告诉别人吧？

scripts.text:
[Eff]
I didn't. Meow~
scripts.translation:
[埃夫]
没有，喵～

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ok, good cat! Never!!
Tell this to other cats!~
Bye Bye~
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好猫！千万别说出去！！
也不要告诉其他猫哦～
再见～

scripts.text:
[Eff]
This is not possible. Please contact an administrator.
scripts.translation:
[埃夫]
这不可能。请联系管理员。

scripts.text:
[Eff]
Who are you, meow?
scripts.translation:
[埃夫]
你是谁，喵？

scripts.text: What do you want to say?
scripts.translation: 你想说什么？

scripts.text:
[Eff]
What is this? What do you mean by '{0}'? Meow...
Meow...? Meow! You! Investor meow?
scripts.translation:
[埃夫]
这是什么？你说“{0}”是什么意思，喵……
喵……？喵！是你！投资者，喵？

scripts.text:
Eff seems to recognize you.
{0}
scripts.translation:
埃夫似乎认出了你。
{0}

scripts.text:
[Eff]
You are--!!
Meow~ I want to invest. Meow~
scripts.translation:
[埃夫]
你是——！！
喵～我想投资，喵～

scripts.text: Eff seems to recognize you, so let's get away.
scripts.translation: 埃夫似乎认出了你，快逃吧。

scripts.text:
[Eff]
Meow Meow~ 'Cat Gamers' can say good bye to me, meow.
Meow... Who are you meow?
scripts.translation:
[埃夫]
喵喵～“猫玩家”可以跟我说再见了，喵。
喵……你是谁，喵？

scripts.text: This cat might hit you. Let's get away.
scripts.translation: 这只猫可能会揍你，快逃吧。

scripts.text:
[Eff]
Meow~ I want to invest. Meow~
scripts.translation:
[埃夫]
喵～我想投资，喵～

scripts.text: Eff seems to recognize you, so let's get away.
scripts.translation: 埃夫似乎认出了你，快逃吧。

scripts.text: Your inventory is too heavy to proceed. Come back after lightening your load.
scripts.translation: 你的负重过高，无法继续。请减轻负重后再来。

scripts.text: Your inventory is too full to proceed. Come back after reducing your load.
scripts.translation: 你的背包已满，无法继续。请整理背包后再来。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Hey, ^0000FF{0}^000000. You haven't done what we asked you for. A promise is a promise, you know.
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
喂，^0000FF{0}^000000。你还没完成我们拜托你的事呢。答应过的事就要做到，知道吗？

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Ah!! When you are done, please get checked by the Cat Gamers Director over there.
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
啊！！完成后记得去那边找猫玩家协会负责人确认。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
You seem like a first timer! Where did you get the certificate? Someone lost it, I guess.
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
你看起来是第一次来！证书是从哪儿弄来的？大概是有人弄丢了吧。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Rock Paper Scissors is a serious game. When will our practicing partner come?
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
石头剪刀布可是很认真的比赛。我们的练习搭档什么时候才来？

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Oh, ^0000FF{0}^000000? Want to play the Rock Paper Scissors game?

[Ser]
Where is your Cat Gamers Certificate? It seems like nothing, but you can't play this game without it!
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
你的猫玩家证书呢？看起来不起眼，可没有它就不能玩！

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Please go get the certificate.
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
先去拿到证书再来。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Is it tomorrow already? I don't think so! Can't you read the time?
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
已经到明天了吗？我看还没有吧！你不会看时间吗？

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Oh, ^0000FF{0}^000000? Want to play the Rock Paper Scissors game?
Play the game.
scripts.translation: 开始游戏

scripts.text: Say hi.
scripts.translation: 打个招呼

scripts.text: Ask about the game rules.
scripts.translation: 询问游戏规则

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Good idea.
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
好主意。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Oh! Ok, hi? But, why now?
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
哦！好吧，你好？不过现在打招呼是为什么？

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Ah... You are bored? Why don't you play a game with me?
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
啊……你觉得无聊吗？要不要和我玩一局？

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Hey, you! Don't neglect the Rock Paper Scissors game!!
I've seen many people getting their butts kicked in this game!!
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
喂！别小看石头剪刀布！！
我见过很多人在这游戏里输得很惨！！

scripts.text:
[Ser]
You better mark my words, if you don't want to end up like them!~
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
记住我的话，免得落得和他们一样的下场！～

scripts.text:
[Ser]
You don't even know how to play this game?
Let me kindly teach you.
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
你连怎么玩都不知道吗？
我就大发慈悲教教你吧。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Scissors beats Paper,
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
剪刀胜布，

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Paper beats Rock,
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
布胜石头，

scripts.text:
[Ser]
And Rock beats Scissors.
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
石头胜剪刀。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Ok? Got it now?
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
懂了吗？明白了吧？

scripts.text:
[Ser]
You must play 5 matches with me.
We go again if the game is even!!
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
你得和我比五局。
如果平局，就重赛！！

scripts.text:
[Ser]
I will give you a present if you beat me 3 times. Ok?
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
你要是赢我三局，我就送你礼物。怎么样？

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Ok, then. Go away.
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
好，就这样。走吧。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
{0} match ~~
Result is even, so we play again.
Try your best!
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
第{0}局～～
平局了，所以我们再比一次。
加油！

scripts.text:
[Ser]
{0} match ~~
Try your best!
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
第{0}局～～
加油！

scripts.text:
[Ser & {0}]
Rock! Paper! Scissors!
scripts.translation:
[塞尔与{0}]
石头！剪刀！布！

scripts.text: Rock
scripts.translation: 石头

scripts.text: Paper
scripts.translation: 布

scripts.text: Scissors
scripts.translation: 剪刀

scripts.text:
[Ser]
All 5 matches are over!!
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
五局都结束了！！

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Hmm... Let me see...
I won {0} times, and you, {1}, won {2} times, right?
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
嗯……我算算……
我赢了{0}局，你赢了{2}局，{1}，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Ser]
{0} has won the game.
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
{0}赢了。

scripts.text: Ser became polite all of a sudden.
scripts.translation: 塞尔忽然变得彬彬有礼。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Great game it was. I admire your enthusiasm for the game. So, I want to give you my precious Can as a present.
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
这场比赛真精彩。我很欣赏你对游戏的热情，所以想把我珍藏的罐头送给你。

scripts.text: I don't need it!
scripts.translation: 我不需要！

scripts.text: Thank you.
scripts.translation: 谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Just take it!! Do as I say~
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
拿着吧！！听我的～

scripts.text:
[Ser]
You are polite. But, sadly this is all I can give you.
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
你真有礼貌。不过很遗憾，我能给你的就只有这些了。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Good bye~ Come back tomorrow for more practice~
Oh! You won all 5 matches. Here are some more extra Cans.
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
再见～明天再来练习吧～
哦！你五局全胜了。这些额外的罐头也给你。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Good bye~ Come back tomorrow for more practice~
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
再见～明天再来练习吧～

scripts.text:
[Ser]
{0} has lost. Ha... Ha...
Ser became very arrogant.
scripts.translation: 塞尔变得十分傲慢。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
You want to play with me? Ser? With that skill of yours? Meow?
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
你想和我玩？和塞尔？就凭你那点本事？喵？

scripts.text:
[Ser]
What? Present? How can you ask for such a thing when you lose? Go practice more!! Work!! Yes, I should make you do this!!
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
什么？还想要礼物？输了还敢要礼物？去多练习！！努力！！对，我就该让你去练！！

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Hmm. Do you know a fish named Phen? Do you? Isn't it a delicious looking fish?
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
嗯，你知道一种叫水母的鱼吗？知道吧？看起来很好吃，对吧？

scripts.text:
- Chrub -
Ser wipes the drool from his mouth.
scripts.translation:
- 咕噜 -
塞尔擦掉嘴边的口水。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Go catch 30 Phens. And also get me 10 Fish Tails. Get them to our Director cat, and he will make a delicious dish with them.
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
去抓30只水母，再给我拿10条鱼尾。把它们交给猫玩家协会负责人，他会做一道美味的料理。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Lately, I've felt powerless and that there's too much weight on me. I should take care of my health.
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
最近我总觉得提不起劲，身上的担子也太重了。得好好保养身体才行。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Now it's time for some healthy food.
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
现在该吃点健康的东西了。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Get 50 Marse and 25 Milk to our Cat Gamers Director. He has excellent knowledge on healthy foods.
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
给猫玩家协会负责人送50只乌贼和25瓶牛奶。他很懂健康饮食。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Well... we do have a rival, you know. They are 'Dog n Waltz', and everything goes wrong when they come around.
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
嗯……我们有个对手，你知道吧？他们叫“狗与华尔兹”，一出现就没好事。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
I would ask you to bully them, but I suppose that's illegal... So, please at least harass similar looking monsters. What would be a good target?
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
我本想叫你去欺负他们，不过那可能违法……至少去找些长得像他们的魔物出出气吧。该找谁好呢？

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Oh, that archer among Kobolds!! I hate those the most. Go harass 30 Kobold Archers, and report to our Cat Gamers Director.
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
啊，就是犬妖弓箭手！！我最讨厌那些家伙了。去骚扰30只犬妖弓箭手，再向猫玩家协会负责人汇报。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
What is most important for winning the game? It is quickness. What should we do to get faster?
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
想赢比赛，最重要的是什么？是速度。怎么才能变快呢？

scripts.text:
[Ser]
I've been thinking... The best way for us cats is obviously catching rats.
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
我一直在想……对我们猫来说，抓老鼠当然是最好的训练方法。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
You know Cramp, right? That blue chubby creature... Please go catch 10 of them, and report to our Cat Gamers Director.
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
你知道蓝鼠吧？就是那种蓝色、胖乎乎的家伙……去抓10只，再向猫玩家协会负责人汇报。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Ah... I want some bird cuisine. Which one would be most delicious?
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
啊……我想吃鸟肉料理。哪种鸟最好吃呢？

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Picky? Ah! It's too small. How about Condor? I am not sure... Peco Peco?
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
小鸡？啊，太小了。秃鹰怎么样？不太确定……大嘴鸟？

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Alright! Please catch 50 Peco Pecos and get them to our Cat Gamers Director. We shall have a party with bird cuisine tonight.
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
好！去抓50只大嘴鸟，交给猫玩家协会负责人。今晚我们要开一场鸟肉料理派对。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
I get too nervous before the game. And I don't play well when I'm nervous. I need something to calm down before the game starts.
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
我每次赛前都特别紧张，一紧张就发挥不好。比赛开始前，我得找点东西让自己冷静下来。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Oh! That's right! Yarn! I used to play with Yarn when I was young. Wasn't able to have that kind of relaxation after joining the 'Cat Gamers'.
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
哦！对了！毛线球！我小时候常玩毛线球。加入“猫玩家”之后，就再也没能像那样放松过了。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Please get 20 Yarns for me. Why 20? There are many other cats with the same issue. Our Director should take care of this for you.
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
请帮我找20团毛线。为什么要20团？还有很多猫也有同样的问题。猫玩家协会负责人会帮你处理的。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Recently, our Director seems to have been trying to cut some expenses. Or is the manager taking advantage?
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
最近协会负责人好像在想办法削减开支。还是说管理员在趁机捞好处？

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Regular snacks for our players have been reduced. You should go get 30 Rat Tails, and give them to our Cat Gamers Director.
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
队员们的日常零食被削减了。你去找30条鼠尾，交给猫玩家协会负责人吧。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Then, we shall find out if our manager is being greedy or not.
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
这样就能查出我们的管理员是不是在贪便宜了。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
I am having a slump these days. I can't give my 100% to the game.
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
我最近状态不太好，比赛时总是发挥不出全部实力。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
It is the lemon we need in times like this.
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
这种时候就需要柠檬。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Please get 5 lemons for me. Don't forget, I need 5 Lemons... Our Cat Gamers Director should know what to do with them.
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
请帮我拿5个柠檬。别忘了，是5个……猫玩家协会负责人应该知道怎么处理。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Malangdo is a good place for a cat to live. But, it gets very hot when we play games.
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
绵绵岛很适合猫咪生活，不过比赛时会热得受不了。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
When we are playing a lot, it gets really crazy hot, hard for us to bear. You know how hysterical we cats can be, right?
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
比赛打得久了，简直热得发狂，让猫都受不了。你也知道猫有多容易激动吧？

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Please get us either 10 Ice Pieces or 10 Ice Creams. Our Cat Gamers Director should know what to do with them.
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
请帮我们拿10块冰块或10个冰淇淋。猫玩家协会负责人应该知道怎么处理。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
I can see that you also need some rest. Feel free to relax for a while. How about taking a walk around the village? I insist~!
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
看起来你也需要休息。放松一会儿吧。要不要在村里散散步？我坚持这么认为～

scripts.text:
[Ser]
But, it is no fun to just walk around the village. Hmm... Right!! Why don't you go ahead and meet a cat named Eryu?
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
不过光在村里散步也没意思。嗯……对了！！去见一只叫埃留的猫怎么样？

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Oh! And when you meet the cat, make sure to say 'Come back'. That is the password. And don't forget to tell our Director I was with you all the time!!
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
哦！见到那只猫时，记得说“回来”。这是暗号。还有，别忘了告诉协会负责人，我一直都和你在一起！！

scripts.text:
[Ser]
I can see that you also need some rest. Feel free to relax for a while. How about taking a walk around the village? I insist~!
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
看起来你也需要休息。放松一会儿吧。要不要在村里散散步？我坚持这么认为～

scripts.text:
[Ser]
But, it is no fun to just walk around the village. Hmm... Right!! Why don't you go ahead and meet a cat named Stew?
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
不过光在村里散步也没意思。嗯……对了！！去见一只叫斯图的猫怎么样？

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Oh! And when you meet the cat, make sure to say 'Come back'. That is the password. And don't forget to tell our Director I was with you all the time!!
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
哦！见到那只猫时，记得说“回来”。这是暗号。还有，别忘了告诉协会负责人，我一直都和你在一起！！

scripts.text:
[Ser]
I can see that you also need some rest. Feel free to relax for a while. How about taking a walk around the village? I insist~!
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
看起来你也需要休息。放松一会儿吧。要不要在村里散散步？我坚持这么认为～

scripts.text:
[Ser]
But, it is no fun to just walk around the village. Hmm... Right!! Why don't you go ahead and meet a cat named Ketchup?
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
不过光在村里散步也没意思。嗯……对了！！去见一只叫番茄酱的猫怎么样？

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Oh! And when you meet the cat, make sure to say 'Come back'. That is the password. And don't forget to tell our Director I was with you all the time!!
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
哦！见到那只猫时，记得说“回来”。这是暗号。还有，别忘了告诉协会负责人，我一直都和你在一起！！

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
看起来你也需要休息。放松一会儿吧。要不要在村里散散步？我坚持这么认为～

scripts.text:
[Ser]
But, it is no fun to just walk around the village. Hmm... Right!! Why don't you go ahead and meet a cat named Eff?

[塞尔]
不过光在村里散步也没意思。嗯……对了！！去见一只叫埃夫的猫怎么样？

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Oh! And when you meet the cat, make sure to say 'Come back'. That is the password. And don't forget to tell our Director I was with you all the time!!
scripts.translation:
[塞尔]
哦！见到那只猫时，记得说“回来”。这是暗号。还有，别忘了告诉协会负责人，我一直都和你在一起！！

scripts.text: Your inventory is too heavy to proceed. Come back after lightening your load.
scripts.translation: 你的负重过高，无法继续。请减轻负重后再来。

scripts.text: Your inventory is too full to proceed. Come back after reducing your load.
scripts.translation: 你的背包已满，无法继续。请整理背包后再来。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
You haven't done what we asked you for meow. A promise is a promise, you know meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
你还没完成我们拜托的事呢，喵。一诺千金，懂吗，喵？

scripts.text:
[Paa]
When you are done meow, please get checked by the Cat Gamers Director over there meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
做完之后记得去那边找猫玩家协会负责人确认，喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
You seem like a first timer meow! Where did you get the certificate meow? Someone lost it, I guess meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
你看起来是第一次来，喵！证书是从哪儿弄来的，喵？大概是有人弄丢了吧，喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
When is our practicing partner coming meow? I am bored meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
我们的练习搭档什么时候来呀，喵？我都无聊了，喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Oh, ^0000FF{0}^000000 meow? Want to play the Rock Paper Scissors game meow?
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
哦，^0000FF{0}^000000，喵？想玩石头剪刀布吗，喵？

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Where is your Cat Gamers Certificate meow? It seems like nothing, but you can't play this game without it meow!
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
你的猫玩家证书呢，喵？看起来不起眼，可没有它就不能玩这个游戏，喵！

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Go get the certificate meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
先去拿到证书再来，喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
We can only play the game once a day meow. Come tomorrow meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
我们一天只能玩一次，喵。明天再来吧，喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Oh, ^0000FF{0}^000000 meow? Want to play the Rock Paper Scissors game meow?
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
哦，^0000FF{0}^000000，喵？想玩石头剪刀布吗，喵？

scripts.text: Play the game.
scripts.translation: 开始游戏

scripts.text: Say hi.
scripts.translation: 打个招呼

scripts.text: Ask about the game rules.
scripts.translation: 询问游戏规则

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Good idea meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
好主意，喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Hello meow~ Nice to see you meow~
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
你好呀～见到你真高兴，喵～

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Other games have one cat player. But, we have two for Rock Paper Scissors. You want to know why meow?
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
其他游戏都只有一位猫选手。只有石头剪刀布有两位。想知道为什么吗，喵？

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Paa is kind meow. So, I'll tell you story meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
因为帕阿很善良，喵。所以我来给你讲个故事，喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Ser cat is my twin brother. I was born first, but he always says he is the elder meow. But, I don't fight with Ser meow. I am a good brother meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
塞尔是我的双胞胎弟弟。我先出生，可他总说自己才是哥哥，喵。不过我从不和塞尔争，喵。我是个好哥哥，喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Anyways, me and Ser are well known as the pro gamer cat brothers meow. Everyone knows us meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
总之，我和塞尔可是有名的职业玩家兄弟，喵。大家都认识我们，喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
You are free to admire me, meow. I give you permission meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
你可以尽情崇拜我，喵。我准许了，喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
You want to know how to play this game meow? I'll teach you because I am a kind cat meow~
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
想知道怎么玩吗，喵？我这只善良的猫会教你的，喵～

scripts.text:
[Paa]
You don't seem that stupid meow. So, let's skip the part about what beats what meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
你看起来没那么笨，喵。谁克谁的部分就跳过吧，喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
You must play 5 matches with me meow. We go again if the game is even meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
你得和我比五局，喵。平局的话就重赛，喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
If you win 3 times, I'll give you a present meow~ Cat Gamers Director said so meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
你要是赢三局，我就送你礼物，喵～这是猫玩家协会负责人说的，喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
That is all meow~ But it is not an easy game meow. Respect the game meow~
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
就这些，喵～不过这游戏可不简单，喵。要认真对待，喵～

scripts.text:
[Paa]
{0} match ~~ meow.
Result is even, so we play again meow.
Try your best meow!
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
第{0}局～～喵。
平局了，所以我们再比一次，喵。
加油，喵！

scripts.text:
[Paa]
{0} match ~~ meow.
Try your best meow!
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
第{0}局～～喵。
加油，喵！

scripts.text:
[Ser & {0}]
Rock! Paper! Scissors!
scripts.translation:
[塞尔与{0}]
石头！剪刀！布！

scripts.text: Rock
scripts.translation: 石头

scripts.text: Paper
scripts.translation: 布

scripts.text: Scissors
scripts.translation: 剪刀

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Meow!! All 5 matches are over meow!!
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
喵！！五局都结束了，喵！！

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Let me see meow...
I won {0} times meow, and you, {1}, won {2} times, right meow?
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
让我算算，喵……
我赢了{0}局，你赢了{2}局，{1}，对吧，喵？

scripts.text:
[Paa]
You won meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
你赢了，喵。

scripts.text: Paa became polite all of a sudden.
scripts.translation: 帕阿忽然变得彬彬有礼。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Great game it was meow. I admire your enthusiasm for the game meow. So, I want to give you my precious Can as a present meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
这局打得真精彩，喵。我很欣赏你对游戏的热情，喵。所以想把我珍藏的罐头送给你，喵。

scripts.text: I don't need it!
scripts.translation: 我不需要！

scripts.text: Thank you.
scripts.translation: 谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Just take it meow!! Do as I say meow~
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
拿着吧，喵！！听我的，喵～

scripts.text:
[Paa]
You are polite meow. But, sadly this is all I can give you meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
你真有礼貌，喵。不过很遗憾，我能给你的就只有这些了，喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Good bye meow~ Come back tomorrow for more practice meow~
Oh! You won all 5 matches meow. Here are some more extra Cans meow!
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
再见，喵～明天再来练习吧，喵～
哦！你五局全胜了，喵。这些额外的罐头也给你，喵！

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Good bye meow~ Come back tomorrow for more practice meow~
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
再见，喵～明天再来练习吧，喵～

scripts.text:
[Paa]
You lost. Meow... Meow...
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
你输了，喵……喵……

scripts.text: Paa became very arrogant.
scripts.translation: 帕阿变得十分傲慢。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
You want to play with me? Paa? With that skill of yours? Meow?
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
你想和我玩？和帕阿？就凭你那点本事？喵？

scripts.text:
[Paa]
What? Present meow? How can you ask for such a thing meow? You lost meow! Go practice more!! Work!! Yes, I should make you do this meow!!
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
什么？还想要礼物，喵？输了还敢要礼物，喵？去多练习！！努力！！对，我就该让你去练，喵！！

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Hmm. Do you know a fish named Phen meow? Do you? Isn't it a delicious looking fish meow?
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
嗯，你知道一种叫水母的鱼吗，喵？知道吧？看起来很好吃，对吧，喵？

scripts.text:
- Chrub -
Paa wipes the drool from his mouth.
scripts.translation:
- 咕噜 -
帕阿擦掉嘴边的口水。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Go catch 30 Phens meow. And also get me 10 Fish Tails meow. Get them to our Director cat, and he will make a delicious dish with them meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
去抓30只水母，喵。再给我拿10条鱼尾，喵。把它们交给猫玩家协会负责人，他会做成美味料理，喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Lately, I've felt powerless and that there's too much weight on me meow. I should take care of my health meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
最近我总觉得提不起劲，身上的担子也太重了，喵。得好好保养身体，喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Now it's time for some healthy food meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
现在该吃点健康的东西了，喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Get 50 Marse and 25 Milk to our Cat Gamers Director meow. He has excellent knowledge on healthy foods meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
给猫玩家协会负责人送50只乌贼和25瓶牛奶，喵。他很懂健康饮食，喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
We do have a rival, you know meow. They are 'Dog n Waltz', and everything goes wrong when they come around meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
我们有个对手，你知道吧，喵？他们叫“狗与华尔兹”，一出现就没好事，喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
I would ask you to bully them, but I suppose that's illegal meow... So, I will ask you to harass similar looking monsters meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
我本想叫你去欺负他们，但那可能违法，喵……所以请去骚扰长得像他们的魔物，喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Oh, that archer among Kobolds meow!! I hate those the most. Go harass 30 Kobold Archers, and report to our Cat Gamers Director meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
啊，就是犬妖弓箭手，喵！！我最讨厌那些家伙了。去骚扰30只犬妖弓箭手，再向猫玩家协会负责人汇报，喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
What is most important for winning the game meow? It is quickness. What should we do to get faster meow?
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
想赢比赛，最重要的是什么，喵？是速度。我们该怎么变快呢，喵？

scripts.text:
[Paa]
I've been thinking meow... The best way for us cats is obviously catching rats meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
我一直在想，喵……对我们猫来说，抓老鼠当然是最好的办法，喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
You know Cramp, right meow? That blue chubby creature meow... Please go catch 10 of them, and report to our Cat Gamers Director meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
你知道蓝鼠吧，喵？就是那种蓝色、胖乎乎的家伙，喵……去抓10只，再向猫玩家协会负责人汇报，喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Chrub... I want some bird cuisine meow. Which one would be most delicious meow?
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
咕噜……我想吃鸟肉料理，喵。哪种鸟最好吃呢，喵？

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Picky? Ah! It's too small meow. How about Condor? I am not sure... Peco Peco meow?
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
小鸡？啊，太小了，喵。秃鹰怎么样？不太确定……大嘴鸟呢，喵？

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Alright meow! Please catch 50 Peco Pecos and get them to our Cat Gamers Director meow. We shall have a party with bird cuisine tonight meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
好，喵！去抓50只大嘴鸟，交给猫玩家协会负责人，喵。今晚我们要开一场鸟肉料理派对，喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
I get too nervous before the game meow. And I don't play well when I'm nervous meow. I need something to calm down before the game starts meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
我每次赛前都特别紧张，喵。一紧张就发挥不好，喵。比赛开始前，我得找点东西让自己冷静下来，喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Oh! That's right meow! Yarn meow! I used to play with Yarn when I was young meow. Wasn't able to have that kind of relaxation after joining the 'Cat Gamers' meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
哦！对了，喵！毛线，喵！我小时候常玩毛线，喵。加入“猫玩家”后，就再也没法那样放松了，喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Please get 20 Yarns for me meow. Why 20? There are many other cats with the same issue meow. Our Director should take care of this for you meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
请帮我找20团毛线，喵。为什么要20团？还有很多猫也有同样的问题，喵。猫玩家协会负责人会帮你处理的，喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Recently, our Director seems to have been trying to cut some expenses meow. Or is the manager taking advantage meow?
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
最近协会负责人好像在想办法削减开支，喵。还是说管理员在趁机捞好处，喵？

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Regular snacks for our players have been reduced meow. You should go get 30 Rat Tails, and give them to our Cat Gamers Director meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
队员们的日常零食被削减了，喵。去找30条鼠尾，交给猫玩家协会负责人吧，喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Then, we shall find out if our manager is being greedy or not meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
这样就能查出我们的管理员是不是在贪便宜了，喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
I am having a slump these days meow. I can't give my 100% to the game meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
我最近状态不太好，比赛时总是发挥不出全部实力，喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
It is the lemon we need in times like this meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
这种时候就需要柠檬，喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Get 5 lemons for me meow. Don't forget, I need 5 Lemons meow... Our Cat Gamers Director should know what to do with them meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
给我拿5个柠檬，喵。别忘了，是5个，喵……猫玩家协会负责人应该知道怎么处理，喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Malangdo is a good place for a cat to live meow. But, it gets very hot when we play games meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
绵绵岛很适合猫咪生活，喵。不过比赛时会热得受不了，喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
When we are playing a lot, it gets really crazy hot, hard for us to bear meow. You know how hysterical we cats can be, right meow?
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
比赛打得久了，简直热得发狂，让猫都受不了，喵。你也知道猫有多容易激动吧，喵？

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Get me either 10 Ice Pieces or 10 Ice Creams. Our Cat Gamers Director should know what to do with them meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
给我拿10块冰块或10个冰淇淋，喵。猫玩家协会负责人应该知道怎么处理，喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
I can see that you also need some rest meow. Feel free to relax for a while meow. How about taking a walk around the village meow? I insist meow~!
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
看起来你也需要休息，喵。放松一会儿吧，喵。去村里散散步怎么样，喵？我坚持这么认为，喵～！

scripts.text:
[Paa]
But, it is no fun to just walk around the village meow. Hmm... Right meow!! Why don't you go ahead and meet a cat named Eryu meow?
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
不过光在村里散步也没意思，喵。嗯……对了，喵！！去见一只叫埃留的猫怎么样，喵？

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Oh! And when you meet the cat, make sure to say 'Come back' meow. That is the password meow. And don't forget to tell our Director I was with you all the time meow!!
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
哦！见到那只猫时，记得说“回来”，喵。这是暗号，喵。还有，别忘了告诉协会负责人，我一直都和你在一起，喵！！

哦！见到那只猫时，记得说“回来”，喵。这是暗号，喵。还有，别忘了告诉协会负责人，我一直都和你在一起，喵！！

scripts.text:
[Paa]
I can see that you also need some rest meow. Feel free to relax for a while meow. How about taking a walk around the village meow? I insist meow~!
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
看起来你也需要休息，喵。放松一会儿吧，喵。去村里散散步怎么样，喵？我坚持这么认为，喵～！

scripts.text:
[Paa]
But, it is no fun to just walk around the village meow. Hmm... Right meow!! Why don't you go ahead and meet a cat named Eff meow?
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
不过光在村里散步也没意思，喵。嗯……对了，喵！！去见一只叫埃夫的猫怎么样，喵？

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Oh! And when you meet the cat, make sure to say 'Come back' meow. That is the password meow. And don't forget to tell our Director I was with you all the time meow!!
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
哦！见到那只猫时，记得说“回来”，喵。这是暗号，喵。还有，别忘了告诉协会负责人，我一直都和你在一起，喵！！

scripts.text: Your inventory is too heavy to proceed. Come back after lightening your load.

scripts.text: Your inventory is too full to proceed. Come back after reducing your load.
scripts.translation: 你的背包已满，无法继续。请整理背包后再来。

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
You haven't done what we asked you for yo~. A promise is a promise, you know yo~.
scripts.translation:
[库卡]
你还没完成我们拜托的事呢～答应过的事就要做到，知道吗～

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
When you are done, please get checked by the Cat Gamers Director over there yo.~
scripts.translation:
[库卡]
做完后请去那边找猫玩家协会负责人确认哦～

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
You seem like a first timer yo~ Where did you get the certificate yo~ You better give that back yo~
scripts.translation:
[库卡]
你看起来是第一次来～证书是从哪儿弄来的？最好把它还回去哦～

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
The Cat Gamers Director said a practicing partner is coming yo~ But, that human didn't show up yo~ I am bored yo~
scripts.translation:
[库卡]
猫玩家协会负责人说练习搭档要来了～可是那个人类没出现～我好无聊哦～

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
Oh great member you, ^0000FF{0}^000000~ Let's play ChamChamCham yo~
scripts.translation:
[库卡]
哦，了不起的成员^0000FF{0}^000000～来玩“猜猜看”吧～

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
But, you don't have the certificate yo~ Certificate helps you save the game record yo~ You must have it! yo~
scripts.translation:
[库卡]
不过你没有证书哦～证书能保存游戏记录～一定要带着哦～

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
Please go get the certificate yo~
scripts.translation:
[库卡]
请先去拿到证书哦～

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
Is it not tomorrow yet yo~ You can play one game a day yo~ Come back tomorrow yo~
scripts.translation:
[库卡]
还没到明天哦～一天只能玩一局～明天再来吧～

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
Oh great member you, ^0000FF{0}^000000~ Let's play ChamChamCham yo~
scripts.translation:

哦，了不起的成员^0000FF{0}^000000～来玩“猜猜看”吧～

scripts.text: Ask who is 1st place.

scripts.text: Ask about the game rules.
scripts.translation: 询问游戏规则

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
Good choice yo~
scripts.translation:
[库卡]
选得好哦～

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
No one holds a record for the ChamChamCham game yo~
You could be the first yo~
scripts.translation:
[库卡]
“猜猜看”目前还没有人创下纪录哦～
你可以成为第一个哦～

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
Current 1st place for the ChamChamCham game is
^0000FF{0}^000000 with ^DE2B21{1}^000000 winning streak yo~
Never know when someone else would break the record yo~
scripts.translation:
[库卡]
“猜猜看”目前的第一名是
^0000FF{0}^000000，连胜^DE2B21{1}^000000局哦～
不知道什么时候会有人打破纪录呢～

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
Current 1st place for the ChamChamCham game is
^0000FF{0}^000000 with ^DE2B21{1}^000000 winning streak yo~
I expect that you, {2}, can beat ^0000FF{3}^000000 sometime yo~

[Kuka]
ChamChamCham game rules are very simple yo~
Just direct your hand towards the direction where I direct my face yo~
scripts.translation:
[库卡]
“猜猜看”的规则很简单哦～
只要把手指向我转头的方向就行了～

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
Like this yo~
scripts.translation:
[库卡]
像这样哦～

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
Or like that yo~
scripts.translation:
[库卡]
或者像那样哦～

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
A present is available for 3 wins yo~
If you beat the previous record, you get a bigger present yo~
scripts.translation:
[库卡]
连胜三局就有礼物哦～
打破之前的纪录，还能拿到更大的礼物哦～

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
See you at the practice yo~
scripts.translation:
[库卡]
练习时见哦～

scripts.text:

Cham!

[库卡与{0}]
猜！

scripts.text:
[Kuka & {0}]
Cham! Cham!

[库卡与{0}]
猜！猜！

scripts.text:
[Kuka & {0}]
Cham! Cham! Cham!

猜！猜！猜！

scripts.text: Hand towards left

scripts.text: Hand towards right
scripts.translation: 手指向右

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
Hehe~ I won yo~ I feel good yo~
scripts.translation:
[库卡]
嘿嘿～我赢了～真开心～

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
Well~ I lost yo~ Let's practice more yo~
scripts.translation:
[库卡]
哎呀～我输了～再多练练吧～

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
{0} has won {1} times yo~ Next game starts yo~
scripts.translation:
[库卡]
{0}赢了{1}局～开始下一局～

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
After the practice, {0} has won {1} in a row yo~
Present is for 3 wins or more yo~ Nothing for today yo~ But, come again tomorrow yo~
scripts.translation:
[库卡]
练习结束，{0}连胜{1}局～
至少连胜三局才有礼物～今天没有奖励哦～明天再来吧～

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
Congrats yo~ You won ^DE2B21{0}^000000 in a row yo~
You won ^DE2B21{1}^000000 more than the recent ^DE2B21{2}^000000 record yo~ Congrats yo~

[Kuka]
Congrats yo~ You won ^DE2B21{0}^000000 in a row yo~
And you have won ^DE2B21{1}^000000 more than ^0000FF{2}^000000's ^DE2B21{3}^000000 winning streak yo~ New record yo~ Congrats yo~

[Kuka]
Congrats yo~ You won ^DE2B21{0}^000000 in a row yo~
A new record yo~ Congrats yo~
scripts.translation:
[库卡]
恭喜～你连胜了^DE2B21{0}^000000局～
新纪录哦～恭喜～

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
I'll give you 1 random coin pocket as a special present yo~ Well done yo~ Come back tomorrow yo~
scripts.translation:
[库卡]
我会送你一个随机硬币袋作为特别礼物～干得好～明天再来吧～

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
Congrats yo~ For winning {0} times I'll give you {1} cans yo~ Well done yo~ Come back tomorrow yo~
scripts.translation:
[库卡]
恭喜～赢了{0}局，我就送你{1}罐罐头～干得好～明天再来吧～

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
{0} didn't win at all yo~ You must work it out yo~
scripts.translation:
[库卡]
{0}一局都没赢哦～
得多练练才行哦～

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
Kuka wants you to catch delicious Phens yo~
scripts.translation:
[库卡]
库卡想吃美味的水母哦～

scripts.text:
- Chrub -
Kuka wipes the drool from his mouth.
scripts.translation:
- 咕噜 -
库卡擦掉嘴边的口水。

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
Catch 30 Phens yo~ And also get me 10 Fish Tails yo~ Get them to our Director Cat, and he will make a delicious dish with them yo~
scripts.translation:
[库卡]
去抓30只水母，再拿10条鱼尾给我哦～把它们交给猫玩家协会负责人，他会做成美味料理哦～

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
Lately, I've felt powerless and that there's too much weight on me yo~ I should take care of my health yo~
scripts.translation:
[库卡]
最近我总觉得提不起劲，身上的担子也太重了～得好好保养身体哦～

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
Now it's time for some healthy food yo~
scripts.translation:
[库卡]
现在该吃点健康的东西了哦～

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
Get 50 Marse and 25 Milk to our Cat Gamers Director yo~. He has excellent knowledge on healthy foods yo~.
scripts.translation:
[库卡]
给猫玩家协会负责人送50只乌贼和25瓶牛奶哦～他很懂健康饮食哦～

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
We have a rival yo~ 'Dog n Waltz' yo~
scripts.translation:
[库卡]
我们有个对手哦～他们叫“狗与华尔兹”哦～

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
I want to harass similar goons yo~
scripts.translation:
[库卡]
我想去骚扰那些和他们长得像的家伙哦～

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
There is an archer among Kobolds yo~ Harass 30 Kobold Archers and report to our Cat Gamers Director yo~
scripts.translation:
[库卡]
犬妖里有个弓箭手哦～去骚扰30只犬妖弓箭手，再向猫玩家协会负责人汇报哦～

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
Quickness is very important for winning the game yo~ Work on quickness yo~
scripts.translation:
[库卡]
速度对赢得比赛很重要哦～要好好练习速度哦～

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
Mouse catching is the best work out for quickness training yo~
scripts.translation:
[库卡]
抓老鼠是训练速度最好的方法哦～

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
Catch 10 blue and chubby Cramps, and report to our Cat Gamers Director yo~
scripts.translation:
[库卡]
抓10只蓝色胖乎乎的蓝鼠，再向猫玩家协会负责人汇报哦～

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
I crave bird cuisine yo~ Bird cuisine is so delicious yo~
scripts.translation:
[库卡]
我好想吃鸟肉料理哦～鸟肉料理真好吃哦～

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
Picky is too small and Condor is not tasty yo~ How about Peco Peco yo~?
scripts.translation:
[库卡]
小鸡太小，秃鹰又不好吃～大嘴鸟怎么样？

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
Ok yo~ Catch 50 Peco Pecos and report to our Cat Gamers Director yo~ Tonight, we will have a bird cuisine party yo~
scripts.translation:
[库卡]
好哦～抓50只大嘴鸟，交给猫玩家协会负责人～今晚我们要开鸟肉料理派对～

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
I get too nervous before the game yo~. And I don't play well when I am nervous yo~. I need something to calm down before the game starts yo~.
scripts.translation:
[库卡]
我每次赛前都特别紧张～一紧张就发挥不好～比赛开始前，我得找点东西让自己冷静下来～

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
Yarn is very useful for relaxing yo~
scripts.translation:
[库卡]
毛线球很适合放松哦～

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
Get 20 Yarns yo~ There are many other cats with the same issue yo~ The Cat Gamers Director will take care of them yo~
scripts.translation:
[库卡]
去找20团毛线哦～还有很多猫也有同样的问题～猫玩家协会负责人会处理的～

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
Recently, our Director seems to have been trying to cut some expenses yo~ Or maybe the Manager Cat is taking advantage yo~
scripts.translation:
[库卡]
最近协会负责人好像在想办法削减开支～还是猫管理员在趁机捞好处呢～

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
Regular snacks for our players have been reduced yo~ {0} should go get 30 Rat Tails, and report to our Cat Gamers Director yo~
scripts.translation:
[库卡]
队员们的日常零食被削减了～{0}去找30条鼠尾，再向猫玩家协会负责人汇报哦～

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
Then, we shall find out if our manager is being greedy or not yo~
scripts.translation:
[库卡]
这样我们就能查出管理员是不是在贪便宜了～

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
I am having a slump these days yo~ I can't give my 100% to the game.
scripts.translation:
[库卡]
我最近状态不太好哦～比赛时总是发挥不出全部实力。

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
It is the lemon we need in times like this yo~
scripts.translation:
[库卡]
这种时候就需要柠檬哦～

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
Get 5 lemons for me yo~ Don't forget, I need 5 Lemons yo~ Our Cat Gamers Director should know what to do with them yo~
scripts.translation:
[库卡]
给我拿5个柠檬哦～别忘了，是5个哦～猫玩家协会负责人应该知道怎么处理哦～

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
Malangdo is a good place for a cat to live yo~ But, it gets very hot when we play games yo~
scripts.translation:
[库卡]
绵绵岛很适合猫咪生活哦～不过比赛时会热得受不了～

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
When we are playing a lot, it gets really crazy hot yo~ Crazy cats are scary yo~ We need Ice Pieces or Ice Cream yo~
scripts.translation:
[库卡]
比赛打得久了，会热得发狂哦～发狂的猫很可怕～我们需要冰块或冰淇淋哦～

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
Get us either 10 Ice Pieces or 10 Ice Creams, and report to our Cat Gamers Director yo~
scripts.translation:
[库卡]
给我们拿10块冰块或10个冰淇淋，再向猫玩家协会负责人汇报哦～

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
Cat Gamers Director's order yo~ Find Eryu who is afraid of the Director yo~
scripts.translation:
[库卡]
这是猫玩家协会负责人的命令哦～去找害怕他的埃留哦～

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
You must find Eryu, and tell him 'Come back' yo~ report to our Cat Gamers Director yo~

[库卡]
找到埃留，告诉他“回来”，再向猫玩家协会负责人汇报哦～

scripts.text:

Cat Gamers Director's order yo~ Find Stew who is afraid of the Director yo~

[库卡]
这是猫玩家协会负责人的命令哦～去找害怕他的斯图哦～

scripts.text:

You must find Stew, and tell him 'Come back' yo~ report to our Cat Gamers Director yo~
scripts.translation:
[库卡]
找到斯图，告诉他“回来”，再向猫玩家协会负责人汇报哦～

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
Cat Gamers Director's order yo~ Find Ketchup who is afraid of the Director yo~
scripts.translation:
[库卡]
这是猫玩家协会负责人的命令哦～去找害怕他的番茄酱哦～

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
You must find Ketchup, and tell him 'Come back' yo~ report to our Cat Gamers Director yo~
scripts.translation:
[库卡]
找到番茄酱，告诉他“回来”，再向猫玩家协会负责人汇报哦～

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
Cat Gamers Director's order yo~ Find Eff who is afraid of the Director yo~
scripts.translation:
[库卡]
这是猫玩家协会负责人的命令哦～去找害怕他的埃夫哦～

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
You must find Eff, and tell him 'Come back' yo~ report to our Cat Gamers Director yo~
scripts.translation:
[库卡]
找到埃夫，告诉他“回来”，再向猫玩家协会负责人汇报哦～

scripts.text: Your inventory is too heavy to proceed. Come back after lightening your load.
scripts.translation: 你的负重过高，无法继续。请减轻负重后再来。

scripts.text: Your inventory is too full to proceed. Come back after reducing your load.
scripts.translation: 你的背包已满，无法继续。请整理背包后再来。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
You didn't keep your promise. I have no business with you.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
你没遵守约定，我没什么可跟你说的。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
You are not qualified. Hmm... I am not sure how you got this, but we cannot practice with you. Go back.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
你不符合资格。嗯……不知道你是怎么弄到这张证书的，但我们不能和你练习。回去吧。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
Do not bother me. I am waiting for my practicing partner.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
别来烦我，我在等练习搭档。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
Are you the practice partner? You are late. Let's start right away.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
你就是练习搭档吗？来晚了。我们马上开始。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
... ... ...

[KungKung]
Where is your certificate? You cannot practice with us unless you have that certificate. Go get it.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
你的证书呢？没有证书就不能和我们练习。先去拿证书吧。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
You don't have a watch? Or can't read the time? It's not the time yet.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
你没带表吗？还是不会看时间？现在还没到呢。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
Are you the practice partner? You are late. Let's start right away.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
你就是练习搭档吗？来晚了。我们马上开始。

scripts.text: Play the game.
scripts.translation: 开始游戏

scripts.text: Ask current 1st place.
scripts.translation: 询问当前第一名

scripts.text: Ask about the game rules.
scripts.translation: 询问游戏规则

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
Before the game, we will decide the turn by rolling a dice.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
比赛开始前，我们会掷骰子决定谁先出手。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
Why do you want to know the 1st place? KongNyangKong is a brutal and tough match game. Kuka should know such thing!
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
你打听第一名做什么？“碰碰撞”可是场激烈又残酷的比赛。这种事该问库卡才对！

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
You want to learn the game rules?
You seem to have a polite way of asking things.
Listen carefully.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
想了解游戏规则？
你问得还挺有礼貌。
仔细听好了。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
KongNyangKong has different play rules when attacking and defending.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
“碰碰撞”在进攻和防守时有不同的规则。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
When attacking, you must turn your hand to the same side as your opponent in order to complete the attack.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
进攻时，你必须把手转向和对手相同的一边，才能成功攻击。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
If we turn our hands the same way like this, then your attack is successful.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
像这样把手转向同一边，你的攻击就成功了。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
For defending, you must turn your hand to the opposite side of your opponent in order to defend yourself.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
防守时，你必须把手转向和对手相反的一边，才能保护自己。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
Yes! If you turn your hand opposite to mine like that, you have succeeded defending yourself.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
没错！像这样把手转向和我相反的一边，就成功防守了。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
If you are clever enough, you should know that the bottom hand is the attacker's hand.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
聪明的话，你应该看得出来，下面那只手属于进攻方。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
Last!! Most important rule.
Once you succeed attacking, you can continue attacking your opponent.
When you fail, then you are on the defending side.
Do not forget this!
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
最后，也是最重要的规则：
进攻成功后，可以继续攻击对手。
如果失败，就轮到你防守。
千万别忘了！

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
You can ask about the KongNyangKong rules anytime you want!
Our Manager Cat also knows all about the KongNyangKong rules.
That is all!
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
随时都可以来问我“碰碰撞”的规则！
猫管理员也很熟悉这游戏的规则。
就这些！

scripts.text:

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
I lost. It was good game indeed.
A win would have been better, but I am too busy to look back at the past.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
我输了。这场比赛确实打得不错。
虽然赢了更好，不过我很忙，没空纠结过去。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
Sob...
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
呜……

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
Hmm... That wasn't necessary, I guess.
This is for you, Human!
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
嗯……看来没必要这样。
这个给你，人类！

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
Come again tomorrow. I will beat you next time.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
明天再来。下次我一定会赢你。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
I won. It was a boring match.
You need to practice more. Maybe some extra work will help.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
我赢了。这场比赛真无聊。
你得多练习。也许多做点额外训练会有帮助。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
Catch the delicious fish Phen.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
去抓美味的水母。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
Go catch 30 Phens. And also get me 10 Fish Tails. Give them to our Director cat, and he will make a delicious dish with them.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
去抓30只水母，再拿10条鱼尾给我。把它们交给猫玩家协会负责人，他会做成美味料理。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
I may have worked out too much... I feel powerless and that there's too much weight on me. I should take care of my health.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
我可能练习过度了……浑身无力，肩上的担子也很重。得好好保养身体。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
I am already 10 years old, so it's time for some healthy food.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
我已经十岁了，该吃点健康的东西了。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
Get 50 Marse and 30 Milk to our Cat Gamers Director. He has excellent knowledge on healthy foods.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
给猫玩家协会负责人送50只乌贼和30瓶牛奶。他很懂健康饮食。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
We have a rival. The 'Dog n Waltz' team... Everything goes wrong when they come around.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
我们有个对手，就是“狗与华尔兹”队……他们一来就没好事。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
I want to ask you to bully them, but that's illegal...
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
我本想让你去欺负他们，但那样违法……

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
Go harass 30 Kobold Archers instead of 'Dog n Waltz', and report to our Cat Gamers Director.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
去骚扰30只犬妖弓箭手，就当替“狗与华尔兹”出气吧，然后向猫玩家协会负责人汇报。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
Quickness is most important for winning the game. For better quickness...
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
想赢比赛，速度最重要。要提高速度的话……

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
Catching mice is best. It's Cramp hunting time.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
抓老鼠最好。该去抓蓝鼠了。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
Catch 10 Cramps, and report to our Cat Gamers Director.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
抓10只蓝鼠，再向猫玩家协会负责人汇报。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
I want some bird cuisine. Have you tasted any before?
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
我想吃鸟肉料理。你尝过吗？

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
Peco Peco sounds delicious to me. I don't like eating alone, so...
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
大嘴鸟听起来很好吃。我不喜欢一个人吃，所以……

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
Catch 50 Peco Pecos, and report to our Cat Gamers Director. We all can have a dinner party with Peco Peco cuisine.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
抓50只大嘴鸟，再向猫玩家协会负责人汇报。我们可以一起开大嘴鸟料理派对。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
Being calm is the key to winning important matches.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
想赢重要比赛，保持冷静是关键。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
There's not a single cat who hasn't played with Yarn when they were young.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
没有哪只猫小时候没玩过毛线球。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
Get 20 Yarns, and report to our Cat Gamers Director. It will help improve our team's ability.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
找20团毛线，再向猫玩家协会负责人汇报。这会提升我们队伍的整体实力。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
I have a strong belief that our Manager Cat is taking advantage of our snacks.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
我敢肯定，猫管理员在克扣我们的零食。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
All we need is evidence... Get 30 Rat Tails, and report to our Cat Gamers Director.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
我们只需要证据……找30条鼠尾，再向猫玩家协会负责人汇报。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
Then, we shall find out whether or not Manager Cat was doing something wrong.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
这样就能查清猫管理员有没有做手脚。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
Practice was ok, but I seem to be having a slump these days.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
练习还算顺利，不过我最近状态不太好。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
We need to have some Lemon in times like this.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
这种时候就需要柠檬。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
Get 5 Lemons to our Cat Gamers Director. He'll know what to do.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
给猫玩家协会负责人送5个柠檬。他知道怎么处理。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
Malangdo is a good place for a cat to live. But, it gets hot easily.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
绵绵岛很适合猫咪生活，不过天气很容易变热。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
On a hot days like this, we could use some Ice Pieces or Ice Cream.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
这么热的天，我们需要冰块或冰淇淋。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
Get either 10 Ice Pieces or 10 Ice Creams. Our Cat Gamers Director should know what to do with them.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
拿10块冰块或10个冰淇淋来。猫玩家协会负责人应该知道怎么处理。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
Our Cat Gamers Director asked this. I should make you do this errand.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
这是猫玩家协会负责人的要求，我就派你去跑一趟吧。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
Find Eryu the cat from Malangdo, and say 'Come back' loud and clear.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
去绵绵岛找猫咪埃留，大声清楚地对他说“回来”。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
Afterwards, you can report to our Cat Gamers Director. Off you go!!
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
之后向猫玩家协会负责人汇报。快去吧！！

scripts.text:
[KungKung]

[Leader]
You cannot challenge this Flag Game unless you are done with your assigned work.
scripts.translation:
[首领]
完成分配给你的任务后，才能挑战夺旗游戏。

scripts.text:
[Leader]
Not everyone can challenge just because they have the certificate.
scripts.translation:
[首领]
不是拿到证书就能挑战的。

scripts.text:
[Leader]
Ok, let's practice until a challenger comes!!
scripts.translation:
[首领]
好，我们就练习到有挑战者来为止！！

scripts.text:
[Leader]
Do you want to challege?
scripts.translation:
[首领]
要挑战吗？

scripts.text:
[Leader]
You cannot challenge this Flag Game unless you are wearing our certificate item. Please come back later.
scripts.translation:
[首领]
必须装备我们的证书才能挑战夺旗游戏，请之后再来。

scripts.text:
[Leader]
The Flag Game is only available once a day.
scripts.translation:
[首领]
夺旗游戏一天只能参加一次。

scripts.text:
[Leader]
Do you want to challege?
scripts.translation:
[首领]
要挑战吗？

scripts.text: Challenge.
scripts.translation: 发起挑战

scripts.text: Who are you?
scripts.translation: 你是谁？

scripts.text: Ask about the rules.
scripts.translation: 询问游戏规则

scripts.text:
[Leader]
Let's challenge the Flag Game. Please wait while our cats get prepared.
scripts.translation:
[首领]
来挑战夺旗游戏吧。请稍等，我们的猫咪正在准备。

scripts.text:
[Leader]
Oh! I retired from 'Cat Gamers', and am working on a national game referee license. Licenses are the new trend these days.
scripts.translation:
[首领]
哦！我已经退出“猫玩家”了，现在正在考国家级游戏裁判证。最近考证很流行。

scripts.text:
[Leader]
A referee must use standard language... So it was very hard for me to stop crying meow meow~ like other cats.
scripts.translation:
[首领]
裁判必须使用标准用语……所以我很难像其他猫那样喵喵叫。

scripts.text:
[Leader]
I know the game rules for players for sure, but refereeing the game is a lot harder than it seems.
scripts.translation:
[首领]
我当然懂选手要遵守的规则，但当裁判可比看起来难多了。

scripts.text:
[Leader]
Sometimes I do make mistakes, and people go crazy like it's the end of world. What a hard job this is.
scripts.translation:
[首领]
有时我也会犯错，大家却像天塌了一样闹起来。这工作真不容易。

scripts.text:
[Leader]
But, I want to finish this course, and be the world's best referee ever.
scripts.translation:
[首领]
不过我想完成这门课程，成为有史以来最出色的裁判。

scripts.text:
[Leader]
You can bet on it!!
scripts.translation:
[首领]
你就等着看吧！！

scripts.text:
[Leader]
Allow me to explain the rule for the Flag-Waving Game.
scripts.translation:
[首领]
让我来说明夺旗游戏的规则。

scripts.text:
[Leader]
You play with 5 other cats.
Wait and wave the flag when no others are waving it.
scripts.translation:
[首领]
你会和另外五只猫一起比赛。
等其他猫都没挥旗时，再挥动你的旗子。

scripts.text:
[Leader]
You start with 5 Flag Points, and each time you wave the flag 1 point vanishes.
When your points hit 0, the game ends.
scripts.translation:
[首领]
开始时你有五点旗分，每挥一次旗就会扣一点。
旗分归零时，游戏结束。

scripts.text:
[Leader]
There's a special rule for this Flag Game. For more thrill, we reduce 1 point if you do not wave your flag for 10 games.
scripts.translation:
[首领]
夺旗游戏还有一条特别规则：为了增加刺激感，如果连续十局不挥旗，就会扣一点旗分。

scripts.text:
[Leader]
You will get bigger presents as you win with less Flag Points used.
scripts.translation:
[首领]
获胜时剩下的旗分越多，奖品就越丰厚。

scripts.text:
[Leader]
Come back anytime if you need more help with the game rules. Our Manager Cat is also available for some help with the game rules.
scripts.translation:
[首领]
如果还想了解游戏规则，随时可以回来问我。猫管理员也能为你解答。

scripts.text:

Cats are now all prepared.

scripts.translation:
[首领]
不过你在比赛中没怎么参与，所以奖品只有3罐罐头食品。

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

希望你明天还能赢到更多罐头。

scripts.text: Leader gives you a note without hesitation. You must follow the order now.

scripts.text:
[Seichi]
Ah~ I'm hungry. Any rats wandering around?
scripts.translation:
[诚一]
啊～我饿了。附近有老鼠吗？

scripts.text:
[Seichi]
Ah~ I think I could eat 100 cramps at once.
scripts.translation:
[诚一]
啊～我觉得一口气能吃下一百只蓝鼠。

scripts.text:
[Seichi]
Hey, why don't you look around? Who knows? Maybe we can find a delicious canned food~
scripts.translation:
[诚一]
喂，四处找找看吧。说不定能找到好吃的罐头呢～

scripts.text:
[Seichi]
Then, you can give me one. Hehe~
scripts.translation:
[诚一]
到时候分我一罐吧。嘿嘿～

scripts.text:
[Seichi]
I am hungry~ Any leftover canned food there?
scripts.translation:
[诚一]
我饿了～还有剩下的罐头吗？

scripts.text:
[Row]
Hut! Human, you came to see me, Row the Great? What? No?
scripts.translation:
[罗]
嘿！人类，你是来看伟大的罗的吗？什么？不是？

scripts.text:
[Row]
What do want then? Get lost. Ah...!!
scripts.translation:
[罗]
那你想干什么？快滚。啊……！！

scripts.text:
[Row]
You want to play the Flag Game? I see. Show me what you've got.
scripts.translation:
[罗]
想玩夺旗吗？知道了，让我看看你的本事。

scripts.text:
[Row]
But, you know you can never beat me, the great Row.
scripts.translation:
[罗]
不过你知道吧？你绝不可能赢过伟大的罗。

scripts.text:
[Row]
Flag waving is a serious game. Only special cats like me can compete. Meow~
scripts.translation:
[罗]
夺旗可是很认真的比赛。只有我这样的特别猫咪才有资格参加，喵～

scripts.text:
[Debong]
Hair picking is my best hobby meow.
scripts.translation:
[德邦]
拔毛是我最喜欢的消遣，喵。

scripts.text:
[Debong]
When picking hair meow~
Time really flies meow~
scripts.translation:
[德邦]
拔毛的时候，喵～
时间过得真快，喵～

scripts.text:
[Debong]
Come here, you, meow. I'll pick your hair meow.
scripts.translation:
[德邦]
过来，喵。我来帮你拔毛，喵。

scripts.text: The cat is picking your hair.
scripts.translation: 猫咪正在拔你的毛。

scripts.text:
[Libs]
Arrgg!! Why should I play this stupid flag waving game here?
scripts.translation:
[利布斯]
啊啊！！我为什么要在这里玩这种蠢透了的夺旗游戏？

scripts.text:
[Libs]
Hey you. What do you think? I know you've hearing me!
scripts.translation:
[利布斯]
喂，你在想什么？我知道你一直在听！

[利布斯]
……

scripts.text:
[Libs]
Well, I'm sure you won't have a clue why this is happening. I forgive you.
scripts.translation:
[利布斯]
我猜你也不明白这是怎么回事。算了，我原谅你。

scripts.text:
[Libs]
How can a human understand the overwhelming heart of cats.
scripts.translation:
[利布斯]
人类怎么可能理解猫咪那颗强烈的心呢？

scripts.text:
[Libs]
A human? What are you doing here?
scripts.translation:
[利布斯]
人类？你在这里做什么？

scripts.text:
[Libs]
Oh! I see. Our director is looking a practicing partner, why don't you apply?
scripts.translation:
[利布斯]
哦，原来如此。协会负责人正在找练习搭档，你怎么不去报名？

scripts.text:
[YongYong]
Meow~ I'm annoyed meow~
scripts.translation:
[勇勇]
喵～烦死了，喵～

scripts.text:
[YongYong]
Annoying meow~
scripts.translation:
[勇勇]
烦死了，喵～

scripts.text:
[YongYong]
You're annoying meow~
scripts.translation:
[勇勇]
你真烦人，喵～

scripts.text:
[YongYong]
What are you, a dog? Meow~!
scripts.translation:
[勇勇]
你是狗吗，喵～！

scripts.text:
[YongYong]
Do not mess with the drooping cat.
Or you will regret it.
scripts.translation:
[勇勇]
别去招惹那只无精打采的猫。
否则你会后悔的。

scripts.text:
z..Z..z..Z
The cat is sleeping.
scripts.translation:
呼……呼……
猫咪正在睡觉。

scripts.translation: 一块小牌子。

scripts.text:
[Uneet]
Wow Wot~ What a busy day~
Oh, you are the one who won the honorable certificate?
scripts.translation:
[乌尼特]
哇哦～今天真忙啊～
哦，你就是拿到荣誉证书的那位？

scripts.text:
[Uneet]
There are more orders coming every day. Ahh!! Give me some more manpower!!
scripts.translation:
[乌尼特]
每天都有更多订单。啊啊！！再多给我派些人手吧！！

scripts.text:
[Uneet]
Nyah~ Ong~ Certificate complete!!
scripts.translation:
[乌尼特]
喵～哦～证书做好了！！

scripts.text:
[Uneet]
I already gave your certificate to the Cat Gamers Director! Go check it out~
scripts.translation:
[乌尼特]
我已经把证书交给猫玩家协会负责人了！去找他看看吧～

scripts.text:
[Uneet]
Please... Keep this wherever you go.
scripts.translation:
[乌尼特]
请……无论去哪儿都把它带在身上。

scripts.text:
[Uneet]
I am a cat. Nyah~ Ong~
I look like a sheep because I was so busy I didn't have time to shave.
It is not my fault...
scripts.translation:
[乌尼特]
我可是猫，喵～哦～
我看起来像只羊，是因为忙得没时间剃毛。
这可不是我的错……

scripts.text:
[Uneet]
Nyah~ Ong~ Do not interrupt my resting.
Usually, I am very busy...
Don't touch me.
scripts.translation:
[乌尼特]
喵～哦～别打扰我休息。
我平时可是很忙的……
别碰我。

scripts.text:
[Uneet]
I'm a bit fat now, but you should look at yourself too. Haha...
scripts.translation:
[乌尼特]
我现在是有点胖，不过你也该照照镜子。哈哈……

scripts.text:
[Interview Cat]
I want join 'Cat Gamers'.
But it seems the Cat Gamers Director is busy now. Should I just leave?
scripts.translation:
[面试的猫]
我想加入“猫玩家”。
不过协会负责人好像很忙，我要不要直接走掉？

scripts.text:
[Interview Cat]
What? You also want join this group?
scripts.translation:
[面试的猫]
什么？你也想加入这个组织？

scripts.text:
[Waiting Cat]
Why did someone put that vase inside of a glass?
The Cat Gamers Director did that?
scripts.translation:
[等候的猫]
为什么有人把花瓶放进玻璃罩里？
是猫玩家协会负责人干的吗？

scripts.text:
[Waiting Cat]
What strange taste.
Maybe I should rethink joining 'Cat Gamers', huh?
scripts.translation:
[等候的猫]
品味真奇怪。
我是不是该重新考虑要不要加入“猫玩家”？

scripts.text: ^0000FFThere's a hastily written message on this bulletin board.^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000FF公告板上贴着一张匆忙写下的告示。^000000

scripts.text: A fallen angel within will unlock a hidden enchantment to Archangel Wings.
scripts.translation: 里面的堕天使可以为大天使之翼解锁隐藏附魔。

scripts.text: You are carrying too many items, please reduce them and come back!
scripts.translation: 你的物品带得太多了，请整理后再来！

scripts.text: You have overweight, please reduce it and come back!
scripts.translation: 你的负重过高，请减轻负重后再来！

scripts.text:
[Fallen Angel]
You seem like a poor guy!
scripts.translation:
[堕天使]
你看起来很穷啊！

scripts.text:
[Fallen Angel]
If you have an Archangel Wing, I will enchant my capability into the useless 4th slot. Would you like me to do so?
scripts.translation:
[堕天使]
如果你有大天使之翼，我可以把自己的力量附魔到那个没用的第四栏位上。要我这么做吗？

scripts.text: What is that?
scripts.translation: 那是什么？

scripts.text: Enchant Initialization
scripts.translation: 重置附魔

scripts.text: Stop speaking
scripts.translation: 别说了

scripts.text: What are you going to do?
scripts.translation: 你要做什么？

scripts.text:
[Fallen Angel]
What did you say?
scripts.translation:
[堕天使]
你说什么？

scripts.text:
[Fallen Angel]
I can enchant my capability into your Archangel Wing if you pay 1,000,000 zeny. But you can't enchant it again without resetting it.
scripts.translation:
[堕天使]
支付1,000,000 Zeny，我就能把自己的力量附魔到你的大天使之翼上。不过不先重置的话，就不能再次附魔。

scripts.text:
[Fallen Angel]
The enchantment is dangerous, so ^ff0000the wing might be damaged^000000! Nevertheless, my good blessing will retain the ^0000ffcard and refine level^0000ff!
scripts.translation:
[堕天使]
附魔很危险，^ff0000翅膀可能会损坏^000000！不过在我的祝福下，^0000ff卡片和精炼等级会保留下来^0000ff！

scripts.text:
[Fallen Angel]
I can't do it if you can't pay!
scripts.translation:
[堕天使]
没钱的话我可没法帮你！

scripts.text:
[Fallen Angel]
There are 2 important notices. First, the enchantment requires ^0000ff1,000,000 zeny^000000.
scripts.translation:
[堕天使]
有两点要特别说明。第一，附魔需要^0000ff1,000,000 Zeny^000000。

scripts.text:
[Fallen Angel]
Second, ^ff0000although the rate is not high, the Archangel Wing might be damaged^000000! This is very unlucky!
If you can accept these conditions, I will enchant the wing for you.
scripts.translation:
[堕天使]
第二，^ff0000虽然概率不高，大天使之翼仍有可能损坏^000000！运气实在不好！
如果你能接受这些条件，我就为你附魔。

scripts.text: Let me consider...
scripts.translation: 让我考虑一下……

scripts.text: I accept, let's enchant!
scripts.translation: 我接受，开始附魔吧！

scripts.text:
[Fallen Angel]
Ok! Take your time to consider!
scripts.translation:
[堕天使]
好！你慢慢考虑！

scripts.text:
[Fallen Angel]
The Archangel Wing has been taken out!
scripts.translation:
[堕天使]
大天使之翼已经取下来了！

scripts.text:
[Fallen Angel]
Don't take off the item!
scripts.translation:
[堕天使]
不要把装备脱下来！

scripts.text:
[Fallen Angel]
This Archangel Wing is enchanted! Please initialize it or bring another Archangel Wing for me!
scripts.translation:
[堕天使]
这件大天使之翼已经附魔了！请先重置，或者再带一件大天使之翼来！

scripts.text:
[Fallen Angel]
Be merciful to the survivor,
Send flowers to the dead.
scripts.translation:
[堕天使]
善待幸存者，
为逝者献花。

scripts.text:
[Fallen Angel]
Help for justice,
Elimination of evil.
scripts.translation:
[堕天使]
扶助正义，
铲除邪恶。

scripts.text:
[Fallen Angel]
But the important point is... the Archangel Wing is damaged!
scripts.translation:
[堕天使]
不过最重要的是……大天使之翼损坏了！

scripts.text:
[Fallen Angel]
Take it!
I believe that you will become the dominator of the new world!
scripts.translation:
[堕天使]
拿着吧！
我相信你会成为新世界的霸主！

scripts.text:
[Fallen Angel]
Initialization requires ^0000ff3 units of Silvervine Fruit^000000. The wing will not be damaged except for the enchanted capability.
scripts.translation:
[堕天使]
重置需要^0000ff3个猕猴桃果实^000000。除了附魔的能力外，翅膀不会受损。

scripts.text: Let me consider...
scripts.translation: 让我考虑一下……

scripts.text: Ok, I want initialize it.
scripts.translation: 好，我要重置。

scripts.text:
[Fallen Angel]
Ok! Take your time to consider!
scripts.translation:
[堕天使]
好！你慢慢考虑！

scripts.text:
[Fallen Angel]
The Archangel Wing has been taken out!
scripts.translation:
[堕天使]
大天使之翼已经取下来了！

scripts.text:
[Fallen Angel]
Oh... you have unequipped the Archangel Wing!
scripts.translation:
[堕天使]
哦……你把大天使之翼脱下来了！

scripts.text:
[Fallen Angel]
I can't do it if you can't pay!
scripts.translation:
[堕天使]
没钱的话我可没法帮你！

scripts.text:
[Fallen Angel]
This equipment has not been enchanted, please check it again!
scripts.translation:
[堕天使]
这件装备尚未附魔，请再确认一下！

scripts.text:
[Fallen Angel]
Take it!
scripts.translation:
[堕天使]
拿着吧！
